**About the company**

Our client is a fast-growing, VC-funded identity security startup headquartered in Berlin, with sales teams across the USA, Europe and India. Its AI-powered platform secures human, machine and AI identities across AWS, Azure, GCP, Okta, Entra ID and SaaS applications. It connects via APIs and shows customers their identity risk within minutes. Customers include Fortune 500 enterprises.

We’re hiring a Solutions Engineer in Bengaluru to own the technical win in complex enterprise sales cycles. You’ll partner with Account Executives from first discovery call to closed deal, and you’ll regularly present to CISOs and security leaders. You’ll be one of the early members of the Solutions Engineering team.

* Strong discovery skills: ask the right questions, uncover pain points, map them to solutions

* Solid understanding of IAM, PAM, IGA, least privilege, Zero Trust, and SSO/SAML/OIDC/SCIM

**Nice to have**

* AWS / Azure / GCP IAM knowledge, or experience with cloud security tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)

12f376bc.description:
**Greetings!!!**

  

**Please find below Job Description:**

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams.

The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design**

* Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks.
* Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs.
* Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
* Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team.
* Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.

**Enterprise System Architecture**

* Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems.
* Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends.
* Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to architect AI workloads on cloud platforms (Azure preferred: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML) with appropriate cost and performance optimisation.

**Data Engineering & AI Data Architecture**

* Design and govern data pipelines supporting AI model inference and (where applicable) fine-tuning: ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and versioning.
* Define data architecture for AI: vector databases, knowledge graphs, embedding stores, and structured/unstructured data integration patterns.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data pipelines meet quality, freshness, and compliance requirements for AI use cases.

**Responsible AI, Governance & Security**

* Embed AI fairness, transparency, explainability, and accountability principles into solution designs from inception.
* Define and enforce AI security architecture: prompt injection protection, data leakage prevention, model access controls, and audit logging.
* Ensure compliance with applicable AI governance frameworks, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and enterprise AI policies.
* Conduct AI risk assessments for new solutions and advise teams on responsible deployment practices.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate closely with executive stakeholders, product managers, business analysts, and engineering leads to align AI architecture with business strategy and product roadmaps.
* Present complex AI architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences; produce architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts.
* Actively contribute to the broader IAIS architecture community sharing learnings, patterns, and innovations across teams and programs.

  

**Mandatory Qualifications & Skills**

**Architecture & Engineering Foundation**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5+ years), with a track record of designing large-scale, production enterprise systems.
* Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, cloud-native patterns.
* Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management).

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Expertise**

* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain-of-thought design.
* Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.
* Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, FAISS, Chroma, or similar).
* Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA) and when to apply them versus prompt-based adaptation.

**Programming & Technical Skills**

* Strong Python proficiency able to prototype, review, and guide implementation of GenAI components.
* Working knowledge of software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Sound knowledge of Safe AI principles, AI security patterns, AI governance frameworks, and data privacy compliance.
* Ability to conduct AI risk assessments and embed governance into architecture decisions.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and drive consensus across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Effective at communicating architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience mentoring developers and guiding teams through complex AI implementation challenges**.**

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading AI architecture across multiple concurrent teams.
* Familiarity with MLOps tooling and platforms (MLflow, Azure ML Pipelines, Weights & Biases).
* Exposure to multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech-to-text, document AI).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or equivalent).
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or custom coding agents).

b6357e82.description:
**Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Cloud & Kubernetes) — Freelance / Part-Time Technical Support**

**Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time / Contract

**Engagement:** Approximately 20–30 hours per week**Duration:** Ongoing, based on project requirements**Work Mode:** Remote (Pan-India)

**Experience Required:** 6–10 years

**Opportunity:** Suitable for experienced DevSecOps Engineers, Cloud Security Engineers, and Kubernetes Security Specialists seeking additional freelance income or part-time consulting opportunities alongside their existing employment.

We are seeking experienced professionals with strong hands-on expertise in Kubernetes Security, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Terraform, AWS Security Services, GitHub Actions, Python, and Enterprise Cloud Security Architecture.

**1. Core DevSecOps & Application Security Technologies**

* Kubernetes Security – Securing Kubernetes clusters, workloads, namespaces, service accounts, RBAC, and containerized applications.
* Trivy – Container image scanning, vulnerability detection, SBOM generation, and Infrastructure as Code security scanning.
* Snyk – Open-source dependency scanning, container security, license compliance, and vulnerability remediation.
* SonarQube – Static Application Security Testing (SAST), code quality analysis, security hotspots, and automated quality gates.
* Checkov – Infrastructure as Code security scanning, cloud misconfiguration detection, and policy enforcement.
* Terraform – Secure infrastructure provisioning, reusable modules, state management, and automated cloud resource deployment.
* AWS IAM / GuardDuty – Identity and access management, threat detection, and cloud security monitoring.
* GitHub Actions – Secure CI/CD workflows, automated security scanning, and DevSecOps pipeline integration.
* Python – Security automation, vulnerability reporting, cloud security scripting, and incident response utilities.

**2. Security Architecture, Threat Modeling & Risk Management**

* Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA) – Implementing identity-based access control, continuous verification, and least-privilege security.
* Defense-in-Depth – Designing layered security controls across applications, infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments.
* Threat Modeling – Applying STRIDE and PASTA methodologies to identify threats, attack surfaces, and mitigation strategies.
* Shift-Left DevSecOps – Integrating security testing into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) – Identifying cloud misconfigurations, compliance gaps, and infrastructure security risks.
* Security Architecture Reviews – Evaluating application architecture, infrastructure design, and security controls.
* Incident Command – Coordinating security incidents, incident escalation, response procedures, and stakeholder communication.
* Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) – Investigating security incidents, analyzing evidence, and supporting recovery.
* MITRE ATT&CK – Mapping adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures to enterprise security controls.
* Risk Assessment & Remediation – Prioritizing vulnerabilities based on exploitability, severity, and business impact.

3fc2de2d.description:
**Staff Data Platform Architect (Snowflake + dbt) — Freelance / Part-Time Technical Support**

**Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time / Contract

**Engagement:** Approximately 20–30 hours per week**Duration:** Ongoing, based on project requirements**Work Mode:** Remote (Pan-India)

**Experience Required:** 8–12 years

**Opportunity:** Suitable for experienced Data Platform Architects, Staff Data Engineers, and Data Engineering Leads seeking additional freelance income or part-time consulting opportunities alongside their existing employment.

We are seeking experienced professionals with strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake, dbt (Data Build Tool), Apache Airflow, Fivetran, Python, SQL, Enterprise Data Architecture, DataOps, and Production Data Platform Engineering.

**1. Core Data Platform & Engineering Technologies**

* Snowflake – Cloud data warehousing, Virtual Warehouses, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and scalable analytical workloads.
* dbt (Data Build Tool) – SQL-based transformations, reusable models, incremental processing, testing, documentation, and data lineage.
* Apache Airflow – Workflow orchestration, DAG development, scheduling, dependency management, and automated pipeline monitoring.
* Fivetran – Automated data ingestion, source connectors, schema evolution, and managed ELT pipelines.
* Python – Data engineering automation, reusable transformation libraries, API integrations, and platform utilities.
* Advanced SQL – Complex queries, analytical functions, query optimization, and cross-platform SQL development.
* Snowpark – Python, SQL, and Scala-based data processing within Snowflake.
* Snowflake Cortex – Enterprise AI capabilities, LLM integration, and AI-powered data applications.

**2. Data Architecture, Modeling & Transformation Patterns**

* Medallion Architecture – Designing Landing, Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Semantic data layers.
* Enterprise Data Modeling – Dimensional modeling, Kimball Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Data Vault 2.0.
* dbt Project Architecture – Organizing staging, intermediate, and mart models using modular and reusable SQL transformations.
* Incremental Data Processing – Incremental models, watermarking, change data capture (CDC), and efficient data refresh strategies.
* Slowly Changing Dimensions – Implementing SCD Type 1 and Type 2 for historical data tracking.
* Data Vault 2.0 – Hubs, Links, Satellites, business keys, and historized enterprise data modeling.
* Metadata-Driven Pipelines – Parameterized ingestion frameworks, control tables, dynamic configurations, and reusable orchestration.
* Data Contracts & Schema Evolution – Managing source schema changes, backward compatibility, and data interface standards.
* Semantic Data Modeling – Building governed analytical models and business-ready datasets for downstream BI and AI workloads.

**3. Data Integration, Storage & Messaging Platforms**

* Fivetran Connectors – Integrating SaaS applications, databases, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
* Snowflake External Stages – Integrating Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Snowpipe / Snowpipe Streaming – Continuous data ingestion and low-latency data loading.
* Apache Kafka – Event streaming, data replication, and real-time data integration.
* PostgreSQL / SQL Server / Oracle – Enterprise relational database integration and source data extraction.
* REST APIs – API ingestion, pagination, authentication, throttling, and JSON data processing.
* AWS S3 / Azure Data Lake Storage / GCS – Cloud storage integration, data lake architecture, and lifecycle management.
* Spark / PySpark – Distributed data processing, large-scale transformations, and complex data engineering workloads.
* Delta Lake / Apache Iceberg – Open table formats, transactional data storage, and interoperable analytical architectures.

**4. Cloud, Infrastructure as Code & Data Orchestration**

* AWS / Microsoft Azure / GCP – Cloud architecture, networking, IAM, storage, compute, and enterprise data platform deployment.
* Snowflake Cloud Infrastructure – Warehouse sizing, resource monitoring, workload isolation, and multi-environment management.
* Apache Airflow – Production DAG management, task orchestration, retries, scheduling, and dependency handling.
* dbt Cloud / dbt Core – Transformation orchestration, job scheduling, environment management, and CI/CD integration.
* Terraform – Infrastructure as Code, Snowflake resource provisioning, cloud infrastructure automation, and environment management.
* Docker – Containerization of Python applications, data utilities, and orchestration components.
* Kubernetes – Deploying scalable data platform services, workload management, and infrastructure orchestration.
* GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps – Automated testing, deployment workflows, and data platform release management.
* GitOps / CI/CD – Version-controlled infrastructure, automated deployment, and environment promotion.
* Secrets Management – AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, and secure credential management.

**5. Data Observability, Security & Quality Engineering**

* dbt Tests – Generic tests, singular tests, custom data quality checks, and transformation validation.
* Great Expectations / Soda – Data quality validation, anomaly detection, and automated data testing.
* Elementary / Monte Carlo – Data observability, freshness monitoring, anomaly detection, and pipeline health monitoring.
* Snowflake Query Profile – Query execution analysis, warehouse utilization, and performance troubleshooting.
* Snowflake Resource Monitors – Credit consumption monitoring, workload governance, and cost control.
* Data Lineage – dbt lineage, dependency graphs, impact analysis, and enterprise data traceability.
* Snowflake RBAC – Role-based access control, least-privilege access, and secure data sharing.
* Dynamic Data Masking – Protecting sensitive data through masking policies and role-based access.
* Snowflake Row Access Policies – Row-level security and governed access to sensitive datasets.
* Snowflake Horizon / Microsoft Purview – Data governance, classification, lineage, and compliance management.
* OpenTelemetry / Prometheus / Grafana – Infrastructure observability, pipeline metrics, alerting, and operational monitoring.

**6. Advanced Data Platform Architecture, Leadership & Governance**

* System Architecture RFCs / ADRs – Technical design documentation, architecture decisions, and platform engineering standards.
* Data Platform Modernization – Migrating legacy data warehouses to Snowflake and modern cloud-native data architectures.
* Zero-Downtime Migrations – Parallel-run validation, phased cutover, backward-compatible schema changes, and rollback strategies.
* FinOps Optimization – Snowflake credit management, warehouse auto-suspend, workload optimization, and cloud cost governance.
* Capacity Planning – Workload forecasting, concurrency planning, warehouse sizing, and resource utilization optimization.
* Production Reliability – SLA management, incident response, root-cause analysis, and pipeline recovery.
* DataOps Automation – Automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and data pipeline lifecycle management.
* Technical Mentorship – Guiding data engineering teams, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices.
* Cross-Squad Leadership – Providing asynchronous architectural guidance to distributed teams across India and global time zones.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Minimum 8–12 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Data Platform Architecture, or Enterprise Data Consulting.
* Strong hands-on production experience with Snowflake, dbt, Apache Airflow, Python, and advanced SQL.
* Proven expertise designing scalable enterprise data platforms and modern cloud data warehouse architectures.
* Deep understanding of dbt project architecture, incremental models, snapshots, testing, documentation, and data lineage.
* Practical experience with Apache Airflow DAGs, production scheduling, pipeline orchestration, and failure recovery.
* Experience integrating multiple enterprise databases, SaaS applications, APIs, and cloud storage platforms using Fivetran and custom ingestion frameworks.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data modeling, dimensional modeling, Data Vault 2.0, and Medallion Architecture.
* Experience implementing metadata-driven ETL/ELT frameworks and reusable data transformation pipelines.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot Snowflake performance bottlenecks, optimize warehouse utilization, and reduce compute costs.
* Strong knowledge of data governance, security, access control, data quality, and observability.
* Experience with end-to-end data platform migrations, production cutovers, automated reconciliation, and operational support.
* Ability to explain complex data architecture and platform engineering concepts through real-world production scenarios.
* Excellent English communication and technical documentation skills.
* Experience mentoring data engineers, leading architecture reviews, and conducting technical interviews is an advantage.
* Based in India and available for approximately 20–30 hours per week of remote freelance/part-time consulting.
* Comfortable supporting multiple Snowflake, dbt, Data Engineering, and Data Platform Architecture-related job positions within their areas of expertise.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

284e5d5d.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

49db5517.title: Program Manager III, Amazon Cross Border, Amazon Cross Border
49db5517.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team is growing, and we are looking for a Program Manager III to own selection quality improvement across our global stores. In this role, you will start by building the data foundation — designing metrics, writing SQL queries, and creating dashboards that give the team clear visibility into selection throughput and item data quality. From there, you will use those insights to drive programs that remove barriers to cross-border selection growth and improve the customer shopping experience. You will partner with compliance, localization, catalog, product, and sales teams across multiple countries to align priorities and deliver measurable results. If you are someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at turning raw data into action, and excited to work on problems with global customer impact, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and build data pipelines, dashboards, and metrics using SQL, Excel, and AI tools to provide actionable visibility into selection throughput and item data quality across global stores.
* Partner with compliance, localization, catalog, and product teams across multiple countries to identify and remove barriers to selection growth, improving the speed and volume of selection onboarded.
* Drive programs to improve item data quality — titles, descriptions, attributes, and images — to directly impact product discoverability, conversion, and sales for customers worldwide.
* Coordinate with global stakeholders to align priorities, define roadmaps, and communicate progress through clear narratives and automated reporting for leadership audiences.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and introduce scalable mechanisms that improve operational efficiency across the selection and sales funnel.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning pulling up your selection quality dashboards, checking for new trends or bottlenecks in the data. By mid-morning, you are on a call with compliance and localization partners in another country, working through a plan to unblock a batch of listings. After lunch, you write a summary of program progress and trade-off recommendations for a director review. Later, you dig into SQL to investigate a data quality issue a teammate flagged, then wrap up by updating your roadmap ahead of a stakeholder sync the next day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team helps sellers expand internationally and works to bring customers the broadest selection at the lowest price. We operate across geographies and functions to remove barriers to cross-border trade, making it easier for sellers to list, comply, and succeed in stores around the world. Our team is expanding, and this role offers global exposure — you will collaborate with teams across countries and gain visibility with leadership. As you grow, you will build strong analytical and written communication skills and take on increasingly strategic responsibilities.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. f50f7a1e.description:
**Job Description: PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing**

**Attribute**

  

**Detail**

Job title

  

PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing

Function

  

Presales / Solution Consulting, Manufacturing Industry Practice

Location

  

Bengaluru, India (hybrid). Travel to client sites in India and abroad up to 30-40%

Experience

  

12-18 years total. 8+ years in SAP manufacturing. 4+ years in presales or solution architecture

Reports to

  

Head of Presales / Practice Head, Manufacturing

Works with

  

Account Executives, Delivery Leads, SAP Alliance team, Industry Principals

Employment type

  

Full-time, permanent

Deal size supported

  

Typically USD 1M-15M transformation and rollout deals

**Role purpose**

This role wins SAP manufacturing deals by linking Lean principles to SAP solutions. You will turn plant-floor problems into clear, costed SAP solution designs. You will show clients how SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing cut waste, lift OEE and shorten lead times.

You are the trusted technical voice in the sales cycle. You lead discovery, build the solution, run demos and POCs, and defend the architecture in front of CXOs, plant heads and IT leaders. You then hand over a deliverable, de-risked scope to delivery.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and solution design**

* Lead discovery workshops with plant heads, operations, quality, maintenance and IT teams.
* Map current-state processes using value stream mapping (VSM) and identify the 8 wastes (TIMWOODS).
* Translate Lean goals into SAP solution architecture across S/4HANA PP, QM, PM, MM, EWM and SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM).
* Design future-state processes for pull production, Kanban, JIT/JIS supply, takt-based scheduling and line balancing.
* Define integration architecture across SAP, MES, PLM, SCADA, historians and IIoT platforms using SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite and OPC UA / MQTT.
* Produce solution blueprints, high-level architecture diagrams, scope documents and assumptions.

**2. Demos, POCs and solution showcases**

* Build and run tailored demos of SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing, SAP DM, SAP IBP and SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Design and lead POCs and pilots with clear success criteria, such as OEE uplift, scrap reduction or WIP reduction.
* Maintain reusable demo environments, storyboards and industry scenarios for discrete and process manufacturing.

**3. RFP, RFI and proposal ownership**

* Own the solution response for RFPs and RFIs. This covers architecture, scope, approach, effort and risks.
* Build effort estimates, staffing models and phased roadmaps with the delivery team.
* Shape commercial models such as fixed price, T&M and outcome-based pricing with sales and finance.
* Write executive summaries and value narratives that tie the solution to measurable business outcomes.

**4. Business case and value engineering**

* Build ROI and TCO models showing savings in inventory, lead time, downtime, quality cost and labour.

05713d54.title: Cloud AI Security - AWS - Senior Consultant
05713d54.description:
**Cyber**

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

**Position Summary**

**Job Title:**Senior Consultant - Cloud AI Security - AWS

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.

  

**Work you’ll do**

As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.

Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**

Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.

  

**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.

* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.

* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.

* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.

* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.

* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.

* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:

* **AWS Certified Security – Specialty**

* **Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate**

* **Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer**

* **Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate**

* **Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer**

* **AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)**

* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

**How you’ll grow**

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.

**Benefits**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

  

**Deloitte’s culture**

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

  

**Corporate citizenship**

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

  

**Recruiter tips**

We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

  

**Education:**

B.Tech / M.Tech / MS / MCA / MBA or equivalent (Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or related field)

  
  

**Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

In the **HPE Hybrid Cloud**, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. * **Cloud-Native Technologies:** Build working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, orchestration, and cloud-native technologies relevant to modern private cloud platforms.

* **Continuous Learning:** Build deeper product and architecture knowledge while developing expertise across infrastructure, automation, AI, and private cloud technologies.

* Servers, compute, storage, and networking fundamentals
* Linux and/or Windows administration
* Virtualization technologies

* Infrastructure deployment and configuration
* Monitoring, logs, and system troubleshooting

* REST APIs
* Test automation frameworks

* Containers and Kubernetes fundamentals

* High availability and resiliency concepts

**AI**

* Understanding of generative AI and LLM concepts
* Effective use of AI coding and engineering assistants
* Ability to leverage AI for test-case generation, automation development, log analysis, and troubleshooting

* Independently execute well-defined technical assignments.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned features or validation areas with appropriate guidance.
* Demonstrate strong debugging and analytical skills.
* Proactively identify automation opportunities rather than relying only on manual execution.
* Develop broader infrastructure and product knowledge.

72a729eb.title: Senior Group Technical Architect
72a729eb.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic architecture design and hands-on technical credibility: reviewing API contracts, challenging data models, understanding event-driven and microservices patterns, and engaging directly with engineering teams, while ensuring every decision remains aligned to Ingka's company-wide architectural principles, reference models, and technology strategy.

The successful candidate will act as the primary architectural authority across all seven order flows, ensuring consistency, reusability, and coherence of the six core component parts that underpin each flow, while also acting as a trusted advisor and thought leader to senior stakeholders across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Architecture Leadership**
---------------------------

* Own the end-to-end target-state architecture for all six order flows, ensuring each of the six component parts is designed consistently and re-uses shared capabilities rather than creating channel-specific silos. This must include the oversight for future configuration over development for additional future workflows .
* Translate complex business requirements from merchandising, supply chain, store operations, and digital teams into coherent, scalable architectural designs.
* Ensure every design decision is explicitly aligned to Ingka's company-wide architectural principles, reference architectures, technology radar, and enterprise data standards.
* Co-chair and contribute to architecture review boards, ensuring solution designs from delivery squads are assessed against enterprise standards before build.
* Own and maintain architectural roadmaps, capability maps, and target-state blueprints for the order management domain, keeping them current as the program evolves.

**Engineering Depth & Technical Credibility**
---------------------------------------------

* Bring genuine hands-on engineering understanding — API design, event-driven architecture, integration patterns, data modelling, cloud-native and microservices architecture — sufficient to challenge and support engineering teams directly, not just at a conceptual level.
* Review and provide technical guidance on system design documents, API contracts, data schemas, and integration specifications produced by delivery teams.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risk, and non-functional requirement gaps (performance, resilience, scalability, security) across the order flows, and drive remediation.
* Partner closely with Product teams, engineering leads, solution architects, and platform teams to ensure designs are not just theoretically sound but practically buildable and operable.

**Program & Stakeholder Engagement**
------------------------------------

* Act as the primary architectural point of contact for the Order Management Program, engaging with program leadership, product owners, and delivery teams.
* Provide clear, well-reasoned architectural trade-off analysis to senior stakeholders and steering committees, balancing speed of delivery against long-term architectural integrity.
* Ensure architecture decisions are documented, communicated, and traceable, using appropriate governance frameworks (e.g. TOGAF-aligned or equivalent Ingka standards).

**Thought Leadership & Client Guidance**
----------------------------------------

* Bring external market awareness and thought leadership on order management, unified commerce, and retail technology trends, proactively identifying where emerging approaches, platforms or architectural patterns could benefit the program.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders — going beyond "order taking" to actively shape, challenge, and improve the direction of the program based on evidence and experience.
* Represent the architecture function in front of senior client and business stakeholders, articulating complex technical concepts in business-relevant terms and building confidence in the architectural approach.
* Mentor and upskill architects and senior engineers within the program, raising the overall architectural maturity of the wider team.
* Actively contribute to Ingka's broader architecture community of practice, sharing lessons learned from the Order Management Program to influence architecture standards beyond this program alone.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Essential**
-------------

* Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect or Principal/Chief Solution Architect on large-scale, complex Order Management System (OMS) programs, ideally within retail, home furnishings, or comparable multi-channel businesses.
* Demonstrable engineering background (e.g. former senior software engineer, technical architect, or platform engineer) giving credible, hands-on technical depth alongside architectural strategy.
* Strong knowledge of order management, inventory/ATP, fulfilment orchestration, and omnichannel retail architecture patterns.
* Experience working with modern integration patterns: event-driven architecture, API-first design, microservices, and composable commerce approaches.
* Experience defining and governing architecture within a large enterprise, using recognised frameworks (e.g. TOGAF) and enterprise architecture tooling.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to senior business and technology leadership.
* Experience aligning program-level architecture to a broader, company-wide architectural strategy and standards.

322b4f41.title: Cloud AI Security - GCP - Manager
322b4f41.description:
**Cyber**

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

**Job Title:** Manager - Cloud AI Security - GCP

  

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.

  

**Work you’ll do**

As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.

Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.

**The team**

Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.

  

**Required:**

* 9+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.

* Demonstrated experience leading client-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI-related programs.

* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.

* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.

* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.

* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.

* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.

* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.

**Preferred:**

* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go-to-market offerings, and practice-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior-level cloud and security credentials.

**How you’ll grow**

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.

**Benefits**

**Deloitte’s culture**

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

The architect will be responsible for designing future-state reference architectures, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with EY’s data modernization strategy. Sales and Business Development

0669a5d2.description:
About the job

**Program Manager, Strategy & Ops**

**SPIRE Lab, Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru**
· Full-time, project position · 3 to 4 years of experience

**About the project**

SPIRE Lab at IISc is hiring a Program Manager to run day-to-day operations, partner coordination and oversee the project for a new two-year, philanthropy-funded research program in rural Bihar.

The programme asks a simple question: can voice AI help a state government genuinely listen to rural women? Millions of women in self-help groups have views on livelihoods, nutrition and local services, but little of it reaches decision makers in a usable form.

We will build and field-test voice AI that holds conversations with these women in Hindi and local languages, and turns what they say into insights a government can act on. Alongside it, we will build an open evaluation sandbox that tests how voice AI actually performs in the field, with rural accents and real phone lines, rather than in the lab.

The work brings together an academic AI lab, a state government livelihoods mission, a community media organisation, a policy and data governance institute, and a global philanthropic funder.

**Why this role**

This is a rare chance for someone from public policy or the development sector to work inside an AI research lab.

You will sit with speech and AI researchers at IISc every day. You will see how AI systems are built, evaluated and deployed for public good, and you will shape how that work meets the field. If you want a career at the meeting point of government, development and technology, this role gives you a front-row seat.

**What you will do**

You will own operations and partner coordination for the programme. A separate programme manager leads technical delivery, and you will work closely with them.

* **Run the timeline.**
  Plan and own the project plan, milestones and dependencies across all partners, and keep them current.
* **Coordinate partners.**
  Be the day-to-day point of contact for all stakeholder.
* **Get ahead of delays.**
  Spot bottlenecks early, follow up before things slip, and escalate with options, not just problems.
* **Documentation.**
  Ensure agreements with right clauses are in place, data-sharing documents, approvals, vendor processes and project administration through to closure.
* **Report and document.**
  Ensure meeting logs, progress reports and funder updates that are accurate and ready to send.
* **Track the numbers.**
  Monitor budget use, field targets and project metrics, and flag gaps early.
* **Support the field.**
  Plan and join visits to Bihar, and help coordinate work with community cadres and field teams.

This is not a role for moving files from one inbox to another. We want someone who holds the full context of the project and goes deep into it.

**What success looks like**

**By 6 months**

* You own the end-to-end project timeline.
* You anticipate bottlenecks and reach out to partners before delays happen.
* The team relies on you as the anchor for project context.

**By 12 months**

* The project runs on schedule.
* You hold the full context of the project and have trusted relationships with every partner.
* Your documentation and reports are precise and reliable enough to send out without review.
* You also own and track the budgets for the project

**Must have**

* 3-5 years of work experience in either public policy, government programmes, the development sector or program management in startups/industry.
* Strong quantitative aptitude. You are comfortable with numbers, budgets, targets and tracking data.
* A track record of building working relationships with government officials and multiple partners is a plus.
* Strong operations skills: planning, follow-through and attention to detail.
* Fluent spoken and written Hindi and English, and comfort working in rural Bihar.
* Proficiency with Google suite.
* Proficiency with Claude/Assistant in your daily work. Please share your GitHub profile, examples of AI workflows or example account of how you use AI tools.
* Willingness to be based at IISc Bengaluru, with regular travel to Bihar.
* Experience in managing budgets.

**Good to have**

* Preparation for the UPSC Civil Services or a state civil services examination, or an ambition to pursue public service.
* Ex-entrepreneur, shows you can own problems and solutions, you take decisions.
* An academic or research orientation, such as a master's degree, policy writing or published work, it shows you go deep into problems.
* Bhojpuri, Magahi or Maithili, or prior fieldwork in Bihar or Uttar Pradesh.
* Experience with self-help groups, rural livelihoods missions or community institutions.
* Experience managing grant-funded projects, including funder reporting.

**Position details**

Location

SPIRE Lab, IISc Bengaluru

Type

Full-time project position, tied to the program's duration (about two years).

Compensation

Up to ₹18 lakh per annum, based on experience

Reports to

Head of Program at SPIRE Lab

Apply to this Google form. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

dotSolved drives digital transformations for enterprises by defining, automating, and optimizing complex business processes for the digital era and engineering modern, data & analytic driven, applications that deliver intended business value. With hundreds of successful implementations and experience in Big Data, ERP, and Supply Chain, dotSolved can guarantee the creation of measurable business value from project engagements leading to accelerated business growth and profitability for customers.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position - Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
  
  
Exp – 5+ Years
  
  
Location – Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune/Gurgaon/Bangalore - Hybrid
  
  
Shift timing - 2.00PM to 11.00PM IST
  
  
About the role: We are seeking an accomplished Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) – Incident to Resolve Functional Consultant for a support engagement. The ideal candidate will have over 5 years of functional experience specifically in EAM and Incident to Resolve processes within the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment. The focus will be on providing business-as-usual (BAU) support, system troubleshooting, ongoing improvements, and user enablement for the EAM suite and related modules across global operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Application Support & Troubleshooting:
  
  
Provide comprehensive functional support for Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, focusing on Incident to Resolve processes, including maintenance requests, work order management, asset tracking, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis.
  
  
Analyze and resolve user-raised incidents, system issues, and service requests in line with agreed SLAs.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and work with technical teams and Oracle Support for complex/systemic challenges.
  
  
Support asset lifecycle management, from incident creation and assessment through resolution and closure.
  
  
**System Enhancements & Change Management**
Assess and implement minor enhancements and configuration updates in line with evolving business requirements.
  
  
Participate in testing activities (unit, integration, regression, UAT) for Oracle quarterly releases, upgrades, and new feature roll-outs.
  
  
Support interfaces/integrations with related modules, such as Inventory, Procurement, Projects, and Supply Chain applications.
  
  
**Documentation & User Training**
Create and maintain user manuals, functional specifications, process documentation, and quick reference guides for Incident to Resolve processes.
  
  
Lead training sessions and knowledge transfer workshops for business users and support staff.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**
Act as the primary contact for business users seeking EAM functional support, ensuring effective communication and follow-up for incident resolution, enhancements, and process queries.
  
  
Collaborate closely with business process owners, IT, operations, and vendor/partner teams to address issues and ensure end-to-end process efficiency.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Best Practices**
Proactively identify process gaps and system improvement opportunities, leveraging best practices and the latest Oracle Cloud EAM enhancements.
  
  
Recommend process optimizations for asset reliability, maintenance scheduling, and data quality within the EAM suite.
  
  
Stay current on Oracle Fusion Cloud updates and their impact on EAM and cross-functional processes.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
  
  
Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, including direct exposure to Incident to Resolve processes.
  
  
Comprehensive understanding of asset management, maintenance planning & execution, incident management, preventive maintenance, and work order processes.
  
  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.
  
  
Experience working in support engagements or managed services, including incident, problem, and change management.
  
  
Excellent communication skills for user support, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration.
  
  
Oracle Cloud EAM certification (preferred, not mandatory).
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Experience with related Oracle Fusion Cloud modules (Inventory, Procurement, Projects, Supply Chain).
  
  
Familiarity with enterprise support tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and ITIL best practices.
  
  
Exposure to process reengineering, integration points, and reporting/dashboard solutions.
  
  
Managed services or Application Maintenance & Support (AMS) background.
