8b958f66.title: Senior Program Manager
8b958f66.description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Seniority level: Mid-Senior Level

  

Experience: 10–12 Years  
Travel Requirement: Approximately 40% across India  
Reporting To: Executive Director – Programmes  
Qualification: Ph.D. (Mandatory)

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to provide strategic, academic and operational leadership for an institute focused on disability, rehabilitation, research and professional education.

The incumbent will be responsible for driving academic excellence, strengthening institutional partnerships, ensuring regulatory compliance, promoting research and developing sustainable institutional growth strategies. The role involves overseeing academic administration, curriculum development, faculty management, research initiatives and multi-stakeholder collaborations.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in higher education, rehabilitation sciences, healthcare, disability services or academic programme management, along with a strong understanding of academic governance and regulatory frameworks.

The position requires regular travel across India, particularly to district and rural locations, to engage with educational institutions, hospitals, universities, government agencies and community programmes.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

1. Strategic Leadership & Institutional Development

* Develop and implement the institute's long-term strategic roadmap, ensuring alignment with its academic and organisational objectives.
* Drive institutional growth through new academic programmes, strategic partnerships, research initiatives and innovation.
* Lead organisational development and change management initiatives to improve academic quality and institutional effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to expand professional education, rehabilitation training and research activities.

2. Academic Leadership & Administration

* Oversee academic planning, curriculum development, programme delivery and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage academic administration, including student admissions, examinations, academic calendars and governance processes.
* Ensure high standards of teaching, learning and student engagement across academic programmes.
* Strengthen faculty capabilities through mentoring, professional development and performance management.
* Establish effective academic quality assurance and evaluation mechanisms.

3. Research & Knowledge Development

* Promote interdisciplinary research, evidence-based rehabilitation practices and academic innovation.
* Develop collaborations with universities, research institutions, healthcare organisations and academic partners.
* Encourage research publications, grant applications, conferences and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Establish institutional knowledge repositories and digital learning resources.

4. Programme & Operational Management

* Lead the day-to-day academic, administrative and operational functions of the institute.
* Ensure effective utilisation of financial, human and infrastructure resources.
* Develop annual operational plans, budgets, progress reports and institutional performance reviews.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate programme effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

5. Accreditation & Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and professional requirements, including Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI), university regulations and other relevant statutory frameworks.
* Lead accreditation processes, regulatory inspections and institutional quality assurance initiatives.
* Maintain academic policies, institutional records, governance documentation and compliance reports.

6. Institutional Partnerships & External Engagement

* Build and strengthen strategic partnerships with universities, hospitals, NGOs, CSR organisations, government agencies and research institutions.
* Represent the institute at national and international academic forums, conferences and professional events.
* Strengthen industry-academia relationships, institutional networks and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Undertake field visits to partner institutions, rehabilitation centres and community programmes to support institutional initiatives.

7. Student Development & Success

* Ensure a positive and high-quality student learning experience.
* Oversee student welfare, academic support systems and hostel administration, wherever applicable.
* Promote internships, placements, career development and professional learning opportunities.
* Establish systems to monitor student progress, academic performance and overall development.

8. Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary academic and administrative teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations, accountability structures and reporting mechanisms.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performance work environment.
* Drive employee engagement, professional development and continuous learning.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* Ph.D.
* Academic Administration
* Higher Education Management
* Academic Programme Management
* Curriculum Development
* Institutional Development
* Faculty Management
* Regulatory Compliance & Accreditation
* Research Management
* Strategic Partnerships
* Programme Operations
* Team Leadership

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Ph.D. is mandatory.
* Master's degree in Rehabilitation Sciences, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech and Hearing, Special Education, Inclusive Education, Social Work or another relevant discipline from a recognised institution.
* Valid registration with the relevant professional body, such as RCI, IAP, AIOTA or an equivalent regulatory organisation, is mandatory.
* 10–12 years of progressive professional experience in higher education, rehabilitation, healthcare, disability services or academic programme management.
* At least 4–5 years of experience in a senior leadership or programme management position.
* Demonstrated experience in academic administration, curriculum management, faculty leadership and institutional development.
* Strong understanding of university systems, accreditation processes and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in research management, grant development and institutional partnerships will be an added advantage.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management and strategic planning capabilities.
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the work time across India, including rural and district locations.

Preferred Candidates: Applications from persons with disabilities (PwD) and female candidates are particularly encouraged.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Successful implementation of the institute's academic and institutional growth strategy.
* Improved academic quality, curriculum standards and student outcomes.
* Effective academic administration and faculty development.
* Successful regulatory compliance, accreditation and quality assurance.
* Increased research collaborations, publications and grant opportunities.
* Strong institutional partnerships and stakeholder engagement.
* Effective resource utilisation, operational management and team performance.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Title: Sales Engineer / Solutions Engineer – (US/Europe)

Location: Remote, India

**About Simbian:**

Simbian is at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, leveraging purpose-built AI Agents to deliver 10x security outcomes for global enterprises and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs). Our AI SOC Agents work 24x7x365 to autonomously investigate and respond to alerts, conduct threat hunts, and prioritize vulnerabilities, freeing security teams from manual, repetitive tasks. Simbian's platform integrates seamlessly with over 70 popular enterprise and security tools, providing rapid deployment and measurable value. We are committed to data privacy and security, utilizing our proprietary TrustedLLM™ to keep customer data private and safe, and adhering to stringent standards like SOC 2 Type II certification. Our customers consistently praise the precision, accuracy, and efficiency Simbian brings to their security operations, significantly reducing workload and accelerating response times.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sales Engineer/Solutions Engineer to join our growing team in India. In this critical role, you will be the primary technical expert, partnering with our sales team to showcase the transformative power of Simbian's Agentic AI SOC platform to prospective enterprises and MSSP customers. Your expertise will be crucial in demonstrating how Simbian can significantly enhance their security posture, multiply analyst capacity, and achieve superior security outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Technical Sales Leadership: Collaborate closely with the sales team to provide deep technical expertise throughout the sales cycle, serving as a trusted advisor to customers.

• Product Demonstrations & Presentations: Deliver compelling, tailored product demonstrations and presentations that highlight how Simbian's AI Agents autonomously triage, investigate, and respond to alerts from various sources (SIEMs, XDRs, endpoint, identity, cloud, network).

• Proof of Value (POV) Engagements: Design, plan, and execute in-depth Proof of Value (POV) engagements, working directly with customer security teams to demonstrate measurable benefits such as reduced investigation times, higher accuracy, and increased SOC efficiency.

• Technical Diligence & Integration: Understand customer security architectures and challenges, mapping Simbian's extensive integration capabilities (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, AWS, Okta, Jira, Slack) to their existing tool stack.

• Problem Solving: Address complex technical questions regarding AI-driven security, data privacy, deployment models (on-premises or cloud), and compliance, ensuring customer confidence in Simbian's secure-by-design approach.

• Market & Product Intelligence: Stay continuously updated on the latest cybersecurity threats, AI advancements, and Simbian's evolving product features to effectively position our solutions.

• Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer success teams to relay customer feedback and ensure successful implementations.

**Qualifications:**

We are hiring a
**Systems Engineer**

**Gujarat & Mumbai India.**

You will design and win switching and WiFi solutions, built on NETGEAR managed switches, access points and Insight cloud management.

You will work alongside sales, partners and product teams. You turn customer requirements into secure, scalable network designs, prove them through demos and proofs of concept, and support customers through deployment.

Key responsibilities

* Solution design: Gather requirements and design LAN and wireless networks for campus, branch and SMB environments, including topology, VLAN, routing, PoE and RF plans.
* Presales leadership: Lead technical discovery, solution presentations, live demos and proofs of concept with customers and partners.
* Bids and documentation: Prepare bills of materials, high-level and low-level designs, and responses to RFPs and RFQs, including compliance statements.
* Wireless design: Run predictive and on-site WiFi surveys, capacity planning and post-deployment validation.
* Deployment support: Guide partners through installation, configuration, migration and troubleshooting; escalate complex issues to engineering and TAC.
* Partner enablement: Train system integrators and distributors through workshops, technical sessions and certification support.
* Competitive positioning: Position NETGEAR against competitors and others with clear technical differentiators.
* Security integration: Build network security best practices into every design, such as segmentation, NAC, 802.1X and secure management.
* Voice of the customer: Feed market and customer requirements back to product management to shape the roadmap.
* Opportunity management: Keep technical engagements and opportunity records up to date in Salesforce.



Mandatory skills

**Switching**

* Deep hands-on knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching: VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, stacking and MLAG
* Routing protocols such as static, OSPF and BGP, plus VRRP, inter-VLAN routing and ACLs
* QoS, multicast (IGMP snooping, PIM) and PoE/PoE++ power budgeting
* Campus design across access, distribution and core layers, including 10G to 100G uplinks
* Configuring and troubleshooting switches through CLI and web or cloud management



**WiFi**

* Strong knowledge of 802.11ac, 802.11ax (WiFi 6/6E) and 802.11be (WiFi 7)
* RF fundamentals: channel planning, power, interference, roaming (802.11k/v/r) and high-density design
* WiFi site surveys with tools such as Ekahau or Hamina (predictive, active and passive)
* Wireless security: WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise, 802.1X/RADIUS, guest access and captive portals
* Cloud-managed and controller-based WLAN architectures



**Presales**

* Proven track record in presales or solution architecture for enterprise or IT customers
* Strong presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills

Also Valued

* Experience with NETGEAR Insight, Cisco Meraki, Aruba Central or Juniper Mist cloud platforms
* Exposure to network automation and scripting (Python, REST APIs)
* Familiarity with government and PSU procurement, including GeM tenders
* Knowledge of IP-based AV or ProAV networks is a plus



Qualifications And Certifications

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related field (B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent)
* 8–10 years in enterprise networking, with at least 4 years in a presales, solution architect or systems engineer role
* Professional-level networking certification preferred: CCNP Enterprise, Aruba ACCP/ACSP, JNCIP or equivalent
* Wireless certification preferred: CWNA, CWDP or ECSE (Ekahau)
* Security certification is an advantage: Fortinet NSE 4 or higher, PCNSA/PCNSE, CompTIA Security+ or CCNP Security

Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Advisory and Thought Partnership**

* Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
* Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.

* Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.

**Solution Design and Architecture**

* Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
* Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.

* Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
* Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
* Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
* Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
* Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.

**Prototyping and Demonstrations**

* Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
* Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
* Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.

**Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
* Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
* Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
* Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience** in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
* Proven expertise architecting **large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms**, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
* Hands-on experience delivering **production-grade AI solutions**, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
* Strong understanding of **Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
* Proven ability to lead **technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids**, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
* Experience with **enterprise learning technology** including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
* Excellent **technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum**, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
* **Bachelors degree** in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and **TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture** certification or equivalent experience preferred.

This role is responsible for defining the strategic direction, standards, and architectural frameworks for network and cloud connectivity across the organization's products, platforms, and services. The successful candidate will provide architecture leadership for complex, business-critical solutions spanning on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.

As a senior member of the architecture team, you will drive technology decisions, establish reference architectures and blueprints, and ensure secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient network solutions that support the company’s long-term technology strategy

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Define and maintain enterprise network and cloud networking standards, architecture principles, reference models, and governance frameworks.
* Lead the design and architecture of complex network solutions across on-premises, hybrid-cloud, and public cloud environments.
* Establish network architecture roadmaps aligned with business, product, security, and operational objectives.
* Design secure and scalable cloud connectivity solutions leveraging Azure networking services and hybrid integration patterns.
* Collaborate with Product, Platform, Security, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to ensure architectural consistency and alignment.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance throughout solution design, implementation, and operational transition phases.
* Review and approve solution architectures, ensuring compliance with enterprise standards, security requirements, and operational best practices.
* Define and maintain network security architectures including segmentation, Zero Trust principles, VPN, SD-WAN, firewall strategies, and cloud-native security controls.
* Lead strategic initiatives related to cloud transformation, network modernization, automation, and infrastructure evolution.
* Conduct architecture assessments and technology evaluations, identifying risks, opportunities, and innovation areas.
* Collaborate with vendors, partners, and cloud providers to assess technologies and influence product roadmaps.
* Promote Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), automation, and DevSecOps practices within network and cloud environments.
* Provide expert-level support and guidance for complex network and cloud-related incidents and design challenges.
* Develop and maintain architecture documentation, standards, decision records, and reference designs.

Qualifications:

**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
---------------------

* Minimum 10+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Network Architecture, or Infrastructure Architecture roles.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud networking solutions, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure.
* Proven experience acting as a Network Architect, Cloud Architect, or Solution Architect in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience designing hybrid-cloud and multi-cloud architectures.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology strategy, architecture governance, and cross-functional architecture reviews.
* Experience working within highly available, globally distributed, and security-sensitive environments.
* Aviation, transportation, telecommunications, or mission-critical industry experience is highly desirable.
* Expert analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design solutions for complex business and technical challenges.
* Strong understanding of enterprise networking technologies and modern cloud networking architectures.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and technical levels.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Experience managing multiple architecture initiatives simultaneously.
* Advanced understanding of cloud operating models, FinOps, DevOps, and Platform Engineering concepts.
* Ability to balance business requirements, security controls, operational resilience, and cost optimization.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES:

* Demonstrate expert-level knowledge of enterprise networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, NAT, VLANs, and WAN optimization.
* Possess extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure networking services and architecture, including Azure Virtual Networks (VNets), Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Azure DNS, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Load Balancer, and Azure Front Door, with the ability to design, implement, configure, and optimize secure, scalable, and highly available cloud network solutions.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Professional Development**: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning**, **Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative**, and **Airport Council International**—available to all employees—to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. 488a5515.description:
Job Description JOB DESCRIPTION Restaurant Technology (RTC) & OXP/Digital Engineering | Azure & GCP Cloud-Native Department: Technology / Platform Engineering Reports to: [Director, Platform Engineering] Role Summary Company is investing in a modern, cloud-native foundation for the applications that run our restaurants and delight our customers. We're looking for a hands-on Cloud Architect from a platform engineering background to design and architect that foundation on Azure and GCP. You'll be the technical authority for the infrastructure that the Restaurant Technology (RTC) and OXP/Digital Engineering portfolios are built on, and you'll set the best-in-class practices and frameworks that teams use to build on it: IaC, next-generation CI/CD pipelines, AI engineering, and SRE engineering. You'll partner closely with application teams, SRE, security, and business stakeholders to make the platform resilient, active-active, and a joy for developers to use. The Programs You Will Support RTC – Restaurant Technology The Restaurant Technology portfolio is the set of restaurant and business applications that power day-to-day operations across our restaurants and the business behind them. You will architect the cloud and platform foundation that these applications run on today and as the portfolio modernizes, with a focus on reliability, performance, and security for systems that restaurants depend on every hour they are open. OXP / Digital Engineering The Digital Engineering portfolio is made up of our customer-facing Company digital applications, including: • The Company mobile app (iOS and Android) • Company.com • Loyalty • Other applications and services that sit under the digital portfolio These applications are built, or will be built, on top of the infrastructure and platform you will design and architect. Key Responsibilities Cloud-Native Architecture & Design • Lead architecture and design conversations for the RTC and OXP/Digital portfolios with engineering, product, security, and business stakeholders. • Design cloud-native reference architectures on Azure and GCP using containers, managed Kubernetes (AKS, GKE), serverless, and managed data and messaging services. • Architect and guide the build of active-active, multi-region platforms, including global traffic management, data replication, failover, and resiliency patterns that meet defined RTO/RPO and SLO targets for mobile app, web, loyalty, and restaurant-facing systems. • Run architecture reviews and design authority checkpoints, and drive tradeoff decisions across cost, performance, resilience, security, and portability between Azure and GCP. Platform Engineering & Developer Experience • Design and evolve the internal developer platform: self-service provisioning, golden paths, service templates, and a developer portal (e.g., Backstage) used by RTC and Digital application teams. • Define multi-tenant Kubernetes platform standards, including cluster topology, networking, ingress, service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity. • Build the platform as a product: set a roadmap, gather feedback from engineering teams, and measure adoption and developer productivity. • Provide build oversight to ensure delivery teams follow architectural standards and platform best practices. CI/CD & Engineering Frameworks • Define and evolve the next-generation CI/CD strategy: pipeline standards, release patterns (blue/green, canary, progressive delivery), and environment promotion models. • Design and oversee reusable pipeline frameworks and templates across Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Cloud Build / Cloud Deploy, or equivalent tooling. • Embed automated quality, security (DevSecOps), supply chain controls, and policy-as-code gates (e.g., Azure Policy, GCP Organization Policy, OPA/Gatekeeper) into pipelines. Infrastructure as Code & GitOps • Establish IaC standards and modular patterns (Terraform preferred; Bicep and Crossplane or equivalent as needed) with strong governance, testing, and drift detection. • Champion GitOps (Argo CD, Flux) and automation-first practices across provisioning, configuration, and operations. • Design landing zones and multi-subscription / multi-project structures with consistent guardrails for identity, networking, and security. SRE Engineering • Partner with SRE to embed reliability into the platform: SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, observability (OpenTelemetry-based), alerting, and incident response practices. Help building the best-in-class SRE Dashboards both from business and Technology standpoint to view everything in single-pane of glass. • Design resilience testing, including chaos engineering and failover exercises, and contribute to DR/BCP planning and operational readiness for production launches. • Build reliability and operability standards into golden paths so every application inherits them by default. AI Engineering • Apply AI and GenAI tooling to accelerate architecture, IaC and pipeline authoring, code review, incident analysis, and operational insights. • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted platform and SRE capabilities (e.g., intelligent pipeline optimization, anomaly detection and AIOps, automated documentation, self-service assistants) with appropriate guardrails. • Design the cloud foundation for AI workloads using Azure AI / Azure OpenAI and GCP Vertex AI where programs require it. Security & Cost • Partner with security and FinOps to build identity, data protection, compliance, and cost optimization into every design. Required Qualifications • [8–12+] years in cloud, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with [3+] years in a cloud architect role. • Deep, hands-on expertise in Azure and GCP, including core services for compute, networking, identity, storage, and managed data. • Strong cloud-native experience: Kubernetes (AKS and GKE), containers, microservices, service mesh, and event-driven architectures. • Proven experience designing and delivering active-active / multi-region architectures for high-volume, customer-facing platforms. • Strong IaC skills (Terraform required) and experience building modular, reusable code at scale. • Hands-on experience designing CI/CD platforms and frameworks, with GitOps practices (Argo CD or Flux). • Working knowledge of SRE practices: SLOs, observability, incident management, and resilience engineering. • Experience building or operating an internal developer platform with a platform-as-a-product mindset. • Demonstrated experience applying AI/GenAI tools to engineering or operations workflows. • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with restaurant/QSR, retail, e-commerce, or omnichannel digital ordering, mobile, and loyalty platforms. • Experience supporting restaurant-facing or edge-connected systems alongside cloud platforms. • Experience with API management and gateways (Azure API Management, Apigee), and distributed data stores (Cosmos DB, Spanner, or similar). • Familiarity with observability stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Cloud Operations). • Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Terraform Associate, or CKA/CKAD. • Experience with Backstage or similar developer portal tooling. What Success Looks Like • RTC and OXP/Digital applications (mobile app, Company.com, loyalty, and the wider portfolio) run on resilient, active-active, cloud-native infrastructure that meets availability and performance targets and any Infrastructure builds which are versioned and automated from all use cases standpoint. • A self-service internal developer platform and standardized CI/CD frameworks adopted across teams, with measurable gains in deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate. • SRE and AI engineering practices are built into the platform, improving reliability, incident response, and developer productivity. • IaC, GitOps, and AI-assisted practices become the default way teams build and operate on Azure and GCP.

At Hitachi Energy, we are driving the digital transformation of our global business landscape through robust and scalable ERP solutions. As an ERP Enterprise Architect, you will play a pivotal role in defining and governing the ERP architecture strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and business objectives. You will collaborate with cross-functional architecture teams, delivery organizations, and strategic partners to shape the future ERP landscape, support S/4HANA transformation initiatives, and drive technology standardization across the organization.

This is an exciting opportunity to influence strategic technology decisions, establish architecture best practices, and lead the evolution of a modern, secure, and sustainable ERP ecosystem.

  

**How you'll make an impact**

* Define, maintain, and continuously evolve ERP architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps.
* Ensure ERP architecture alignment with broader enterprise architecture frameworks by collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data, Integration, and Archetype Architecture teams.
* Evaluate incoming business and IT demands to ensure architectural integrity, technical feasibility, and alignment with approved standards.
* Provide strategic ERP architecture direction and guidance across IT delivery teams and external implementation partners.
* Participate in demand triage activities and assess technology implications of new business requirements and transformation initiatives.
* Validate adherence to technology standards, approved platforms, security requirements, and lifecycle management principles.
* Deliver early-stage architecture guidance and high-level solution recommendations before project execution begins.
* Partner with ERP leadership to define ERP roadmaps, release planning, upgrade strategies, and key technology decisions.
* Represent the ERP architecture function in governance boards, steering committees, and strategic decision-making forums.
* Drive ERP technology rationalization, simplification, modernization, and retirement of obsolete technologies.
* Support resolution of complex architectural challenges across internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
* Foster architecture governance practices that encourage consistency, scalability, maintainability, and business value realization.
Lead and mentor senior technical experts while promoting architectural excellence and knowledge sharing across the organization.  

  

**Your background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience across IT functions within large, geographically distributed global organizations.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior SAP Architecture or SAP Enterprise Architecture leadership role.
* Extensive expertise in SAP Enterprise Architecture across complex, multinational SAP environments.
* Strong experience leading S/4HANA transformation programs and implementing Clean Core architecture principles.
* Deep understanding of SAP technologies including S/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Integration Suite, and data management solutions.
* Broad knowledge of cloud platforms, infrastructure architecture, cybersecurity principles, and integration with non-SAP applications.
* Proven experience establishing architecture governance frameworks and managing SAP technology lifecycles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and influence senior technical professionals and architecture communities.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology functions.
* Experience managing relationships with SAP, system integrators, and strategic technology partners.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and decision-making skills in complex global environments.

* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

31bd3c7a.title: SAP Technical Lead-SAP Technical Architect
31bd3c7a.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Technical Lead / SAP Technical Architect (Assistant Director)**
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Lead / SAP Technical Architect with 10-15 years of experience designing, developing and delivering scalable SAP solutions. The role will provide end-to-end technical leadership across SAP application development, integration, SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), e-invoicing and SAPUI5/Fiori solutions. The successful candidate will translate business and regulatory requirements into secure, supportable and future-ready technical designs, while leading delivery teams and working with functional, integration, infrastructure, security and external partner stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture and solution design for SAP initiatives, enhancements, integrations and modernization programs.
* Translate business, functional, regulatory and non-functional requirements into robust solution blueprints, technical specifications and implementation roadmaps.
* Lead SAP development across ABAP and modern SAP technologies, including code quality, design reviews, performance optimization, technical standards and reusable development patterns.
* Design and govern solutions on SAP BTP, including integration, extension and application services, with appropriate security, monitoring, scalability and operational support considerations.
* Provide technical leadership for e-invoicing and statutory compliance solutions, including integration with SAP and external tax, clearance or service-provider platforms.
* Architect and oversee SAPUI5/Fiori applications and user experiences, ensuring alignment with SAP standards, accessibility, security and performance expectations.
* Design integrations across SAP and non-SAP platforms using OData Services, SOAP and REST Web Services, APIs, events, middleware and established enterprise integration patterns.
* Assess solution options, identify technical gaps, dependencies and risks, and recommend pragmatic approaches aligned with enterprise architecture and product roadmaps.
* Lead technical delivery through design, build, test, deployment, hypercare and transition to operations.
* Guide and mentor developers and technical specialists; coordinate work across internal teams, managed-service providers and external vendors.
* Validate estimates, delivery plans and technical proposals, and constructively challenge solutions that create unnecessary complexity, cost or support risk.
* Ensure solutions meet development, testing, release, security, documentation, disaster recovery and production-support standards.
* Lead technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex application, performance and integration issues.
* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical design documents, interface specifications, runbooks and decision records.
* Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks and status clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deep hands-on expertise in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, forms, debugging, code review and performance optimization.
* Strong SAP technical architecture experience across application, integration, data, security and operational considerations.
* Hands-on experience with SAP BTP services and extension patterns; experience with SAP Integration Suite is highly desirable.
* Experience designing and delivering e-invoicing or electronic tax-document solutions, including integration with government platforms or third-party service providers.
* Strong experience in SAPUI5 and SAP Fiori solution design and development, including the design, development, configuration and consumption of SAP OData Services.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP integration technologies and patterns, including OData Services, SOAP and REST Web Services, APIs, IDocs, RFC/BAPI, proxies, files and event-based integration.
* Experience integrating SAP with cloud and on-premises applications and working within hybrid enterprise landscapes.
* Strong understanding of secure development, authorization concepts, transport and release management, monitoring, error handling and recovery procedures.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture with hands-on technical delivery and production support.
* Excellent analytical, stakeholder-management, documentation and communication skills in a global delivery environment.

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* 10-15 years of progressive SAP technical experience, with substantial hands-on development and solution-design responsibility.
* Proven experience as an SAP Technical Lead, SAP Solution Architect or SAP Technical Architect on complex SAP implementations, transformations or global support programs.
* Demonstrated experience designing and developing SAP solutions across ABAP, OData Services, Web Services, integration and user-experience technologies.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and at least one modern SAP extension or integration delivery model.
* Experience with e-invoicing, digital tax reporting or statutory compliance integrations.
* Experience with SAPUI5/Fiori development and technical design.
* Experience leading technical teams, reviewing solution quality and coordinating delivery across multiple stakeholders and suppliers.
* Ability to work independently, make informed technical decisions and escalate material risks appropriately.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, clean-core principles and side-by-side extensibility.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance or comparable e-invoicing and statutory-reporting platforms.
* Experience designing, publishing, securing, testing and monitoring OData Services and SOAP/REST Web Services for SAP and external application integrations.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Application Programming Model, SAP HANA Cloud, API Management, Event Mesh or related SAP BTP capabilities.
* Experience with DevOps, automated testing, code-quality tooling and continuous integration/continuous delivery for SAP solutions.
* SAP certification in ABAP, SAP BTP, integration, SAP Fiori/UI5 or SAP architecture.
* International delivery experience and the flexibility to collaborate across time zones.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can connect architecture with delivery. You will be expected to design clear and supportable SAP solutions, guide development teams, maintain strong engineering standards and work effectively across business, functional and technology groups. Success in this role requires sound technical judgment, ownership, collaboration and the ability to simplify complex SAP and integration challenges.
  
  
**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

76a14371.title: Cloud Developer
76a14371.description:
**Hi**

**We are hiring for Cloud Developer**

**Location: Bangalore**

**We are looking for a Cloud Developer with 3–5 years of software development experience to design, build, deploy, and support cloud-native applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with either AWS or Microsoft Azure, along with practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, and basic DevOps practices.**

**The role involves collaborating with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, QA teams, and IoT specialists to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. Exposure to connected devices, telemetry, event-driven systems, or real-time data processing is an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud-native applications on AWS or Microsoft Azure.

Develop backend services, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven components.

Containerize applications using Docker and deploy workloads on Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, or another Kubernetes platform.

Create and maintain Kubernetes resources including Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress resources, and health probes.

Integrate applications with object storage, managed databases, message queues, event services, monitoring, and identity services.

Apply microservice principles such as independent deployment, API versioning, fault handling, observability, and service-to-service communication.

Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or GitLab CI/CD.

Use Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, or ARM templates.

Support IoT integrations involving device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, messaging, and device-to-cloud communication.

Implement authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, or Keycloak.

Monitor and troubleshoot applications across application, container, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure layers.

Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and contribute to Agile delivery.

Mandatory Skills and Experience

Cloud Development

3–5 years of software or cloud application development experience.

Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS or Microsoft Azure.

Development experience with Java/Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or Go.

Experience building and consuming REST APIs and understanding cloud-native application architecture.

Containers and Kubernetes

Hands-on Docker experience, including Dockerfiles, image builds, runtime configuration, and troubleshooting.

Working knowledge of Kubernetes and practical deployment experience with Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, or another distribution.

Understanding of container registries such as Amazon ECR, Azure Container Registry, or Docker Hub.

Microservices

Good understanding of microservice architecture and distributed-system fundamentals.

Knowledge of synchronous and asynchronous communication, API gateways, configuration management, centralized logging, retries, health checks, and observability.

Basic knowledge of Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Service Bus, or Azure Event Hubs.

DevOps

Basic practical knowledge of DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or Bitbucket.

Understanding of build, test, security scan, container image, and deployment stages in a delivery pipeline.

Familiarity with Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code tool, plus rolling, blue-green, or canary deployment concepts.

Databases

Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database.

Basic knowledge of DynamoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, or Redis.

Understanding of connections, transactions, indexing, and schema design.

IoT Knowledge

Candidates should have at least a basic understanding of:

Device-to-cloud and cloud-to-device communication.

Device registration, identity, authentication, and certificate-based security.

Telemetry ingestion, processing, storage, and monitoring.

Protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, or AMQP.

AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub.

Intermittent connectivity, retries, idempotency, and duplicate-message handling.

Note: Commercial IoT delivery experience is preferred but not mandatory when the candidate demonstrates sound conceptual understanding.

Monitoring and Security

Familiarity with Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

Understanding of logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts.

Basic security knowledge covering least privilege, role-based access control, encryption, secrets, certificates, network security, and dependency or image scanning.

Ability to troubleshoot using application logs, Kubernetes events, metrics, and distributed traces.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, or equivalent certification.

Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) is an advantage.

Experience with Helm, Amazon API Gateway, Azure API Management, Kong, or NGINX.

Knowledge of domain-driven design, clean architecture, or twelve-factor application principles.

Exposure to Agile/Scrum delivery and high-availability or 247 production systems.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross-functional teams.

Ownership mindset with a focus on quality, security, and operational reliability.

Willingness to learn new cloud services, frameworks, and IoT technologies.**

b7bac05a.title: Architect - Red Hat OpenShift
b7bac05a.description:
Role Purpose

  

The architect will own architecture and technical governance for modernization engagements that move suitable workloads and application platforms from VMware-based environments to Red Hat OpenShift. The role combines discovery, target-platform design, containerization, migration execution, automation, security, validation, and customer enablement. The architect must be capable of distinguishing between workloads that can be rehosted, replatformed, refactored, or should remain on virtual machines, and translating that decision into a practical migration plan.

  
  

Architecture Leadership and Responsibilities

* Lead discovery and architecture assessments of VMware vSphere estates, including vCenter, ESXi clusters, virtual machines, networking, storage, dependencies, backup, disaster recovery, security controls, licensing, and operational processes.
* Perform application discovery and readiness analysis covering operating systems, middleware, databases, stateful services, data flows, integrations, performance profiles, availability requirements, and technical debt.
* Define workload disposition using rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain, or replace strategies, with clear business rationale, risk, effort, dependencies, and migration sequencing.
* Own HLD, LLD, reference architecture, sizing, capacity, availability, and design governance for Red Hat OpenShift target platforms for on-premises, public cloud, hybrid, or hosted deployments, including compute, storage, networking, ingress, identity, observability, security, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Define end-to-end migration strategy and govern execution from VMware to OpenShift using approaches such as application containerization, CI/CD-based redeployment, data migration, and OpenShift Virtualization where virtual-machine continuity is required.
* Set engineering standards for container images, Kubernetes/OpenShift manifests, Helm charts or Kustomize overlays, Operators, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Routes, persistent volumes, resource limits, probes, and autoscaling policies.
* Define automation and platform-engineering patterns using Ansible, Terraform, GitOps, Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management, OpenShift Pipelines/Tekton, Argo CD, and scripting.
* Govern migration factories and approve runbooks covering pilot, wave planning, pre-migration checks, cutover, rollback, validation, hypercare, and operational handover.
* Architect platform guardrails, including RBAC, Security Context Constraints, network policies, image scanning, secrets management, certificate management, audit logging, and policy enforcement.
* Define architecture acceptance criteria and oversee performance, resilience, failover, backup-restore, security, and business validation tests; document evidence and obtain stakeholder sign-off.
* Provide design authority and escalation leadership for migration and platform issues across Linux, containers, Kubernetes, DNS, load balancing, storage, networking, application connectivity, and VMware dependencies.
* Lead executive and technical workshops, defend architecture decisions, manage design risks and exceptions, review estimates and proposals, and mentor architects and engineering teams.

Required Architecture and Technical Skills

  

* Expert-level knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.x administration, installation, upgrades, cluster operations, Operators, projects, quotas, RBAC, Routes, registry, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Deep architecture experience across VMware with vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, virtual-machine lifecycle, vMotion, HA/DRS concepts, distributed switching, datastore/storage concepts, snapshots, templates, and dependency assessment.
* Practical experience with Kubernetes, CRI-O or container runtimes, Linux/RHEL, container image creation, registries, Helm, YAML, Bash or Python, Git, and REST APIs.
* Experience modernizing Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar enterprise applications; familiarity with middleware, web servers, messaging platforms, and relational or NoSQL databases.
* Knowledge of OpenShift Virtualization/KubeVirt and migration tooling such as Migration Toolkit for Virtualization; ability to evaluate VM-to-container versus VM-to-VM migration patterns.
* Working knowledge of OpenShift networking and storage, including CNI, Multus, ingress, service exposure, CSI, persistent volumes, storage classes, and data protection.
* Experience with CI/CD and GitOps practices using Tekton/OpenShift Pipelines, Argo CD, Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
* Understanding of enterprise security and compliance controls, vulnerability management, image signing/scanning, secrets, encryption, identity federation, and least-privilege access.
* Proven ownership of enterprise HLD/LLD, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, migration factory artefacts, migration factory artefacts, effort estimates, dependency maps, test plans, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.

  
  

Preferred Skills and Certifications

* Red Hat Certified OpenShift Administrator (EX280) or Red Hat Certified OpenShift Application Developer (EX288); Red Hat Certified Architect is advantageous.
* VMware VCP-DCV or equivalent practical VMware infrastructure experience.
* Exposure to Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management, Advanced Cluster Security, Quay, OpenShift Data Foundation, Ansible Automation Platform, and Service Mesh.
* Experience deploying OpenShift on bare metal, VMware, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, including disconnected or regulated environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, Agile delivery, FinOps considerations, platform SRE practices, and enterprise change management.

  
  

Education and Experience

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10-15 years of infrastructure, cloud, platform, or application modernization experience, including at least 5 years of OpenShift architecture and delivery leadership.
* Demonstrated architecture leadership in at least three production migrations or modernization programs involving VMware-hosted workloads and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Experience presenting to architecture review boards and working directly with customers and cross-functional teams across infrastructure, application, database, security, network, and operations functions.

Success Measures for the Role

* Approved target architecture, accurate discovery, and migration-wave planning with risks and dependencies identified early.
* Architecture decisions translated into migrations completed within approved change windows, with tested rollback and minimal business disruption.
* Applications meeting agreed functional, performance, security, resilience, and operational acceptance criteria on OpenShift.
* Reusable automation, runbooks, and documentation that reduce manual effort and enable effective customer handover.

  

Professional Competencies

Architecture leadership; consultative problem-solving; clear written and verbal communication; ownership under delivery pressure; structured troubleshooting; stakeholder management; estimation and planning; attention to security, quality, and documentation; willingness to travel or support planned cutovers outside standard business hours when required.

6ca7faec.title: Lead Architect, IoT Cloud Platform
6ca7faec.description:
*Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world have helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes, Corporate Knights and others.*

  

*KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embedding sustainability even deeper across our operations.*

  

KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem

  

**Role purpose**

We are seeking a **Lead Architect** to define and govern the **end-to-end architecture** of our **global industrial IoT** and **digital platform ecosystem**.

  

The role connects physical equipment, gateway runtimes, device connectivity, cloud platforms, digital applications, enterprise identity, and AI-enabled capabilities into a coherent, evolvable architecture.

  

The architect will establish architecture-first delivery practices in which business capabilities, quality attributes, system boundaries, contracts, security requirements, and operational models are defined before implementation.

  

You will translate complex technical decisions into clear recommendations for engineering and business stakeholders, connecting choices to customer value, cost, risk, reliability, delivery timelines, and operational readiness.

  

**What you will do**

        Own target architectures, system boundaries, contracts, quality requirements, and technical roadmaps. Document alternatives, assumptions, failure modes, and trade-offs before implementation.

        Design multi-region routing, tenant and workload isolation, data placement, replication, failover and failback. Define RTO, RPO, availability objectives, and recovery validation for each workload.

        Enable repeatable regional expansion through reusable infrastructure, automated onboarding, configuration-driven deployment, and application designs that avoid regional forks.

        Govern industrial edge connectivity, device provisioning, certificate lifecycle, offline behavior, secure OTA updates, and command handling with embedded and safety specialists.

        Architect cloud services, APIs, real-time integrations, messaging, and data platforms with explicit ownership, compatibility, tenant isolation, and failure behavior.

        Embed security, observability, capacity planning, cost management, upgrade paths, and operational readiness into every architecture.

        Establish practical architecture standards, ADRs, reusable platform capabilities, repository boundaries, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery checks.

        Communicate through clear diagrams, business-focused narratives, and decision options. Lead cross-team reviews, mentor engineers, and build trust with stakeholders.

        Evaluate AI-assisted engineering and AI-enabled applications with specialist teams, considering business value, privacy, permissions, security, limitations, evaluation, and human oversight.

  

**PKI, device identity, and cryptographic architecture**

**Architecture focus:** PKI is a foundational device trust system, not merely a subtopic within general identity and security. The role must govern identity from factory provisioning through operational use, renewal, revocation, retirement, and long-lived hardware replacement.

        Define hardware-backed device identity using IEEE 802.1AR concepts, including factory identity and operational identity, with TPM 2.0 or secure-element roots of trust.

        Design zero-touch enrollment and renewal using appropriate protocols such as EST, SCEP, or CMPv2, with explicit bootstrap, recovery, renewal, revocation, and offline behavior.

        Author X.509 certificate profiles aligned with RFC 5280, including subject naming, SAN conventions, EKU constraints, key usage, validity periods, policy OIDs, CRL distribution points, and validation rules.

        Design CA hierarchies, trust domains, signing boundaries, key ceremonies, offline root protection, intermediate CA operations, HSM integration, and delegated issuance.

        Govern certificate rotation at fleet scale, including clock drift, intermittent connectivity, dual-certificate overlap, compromised-device recovery, factory reset, ownership transfer, and end-of-life handling.

        Define cryptographic agility and long-term migration strategies for algorithm changes, including assessment of post-quantum standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA where appropriate.

  

**Standards, RFCs, and normative specifications**

Establish a reference architecture and standards catalogue that distinguishes mandatory requirements from recommendations. Use RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 terminology consistently when writing normative specifications.

        Use MUST and MUST NOT for binding requirements; use SHOULD and SHOULD NOT for strong recommendations with documented exceptions; use MAY for permitted options.

        Maintain versioned specifications for identity, certificate profiles, TLS, MQTT topics, API contracts, event schemas, command semantics, error handling, and regional deployment.

        Reference applicable standards such as RFC 5280 for X.509 certificates, RFC 7030 for EST, RFC 8446 for TLS 1.3, RFC 6455 for WebSockets, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect specifications, OpenAPI, and the OASIS MQTT specification.

        Use ADRs to record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security impact, operational impact, and conditions for revisiting the decision.

        Keep C4, deployment, sequence, threat, and data-flow models versioned with the systems they describe.

  

**Required experience**

        14+ years in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or systems architecture, including 6+ years leading architecture for complex enterprise, industrial, or mission-critical systems.

        Proven production delivery and operational experience with multi-region systems, disaster recovery, incident response, and recovery validation.

        Strong system design judgment and hands-on ability to validate decisions through prototypes, code reviews, performance testing, load testing, and operational evidence.

        Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders.

        Experience creating standards and governance that enable delivery rather than introducing unnecessary process.

  

**Preferred experience**

        Industrial equipment, fleet management, OT cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, digital twins, or large-scale multi-tenant platforms.

        Platform engineering, technology modernization, and practical exposure to AI-assisted development or enterprise AI integration.

        Experience with long-lived devices, constrained connectivity, safety-related command paths, and supplier or partner integration.

  

**Certifications**

Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. They do not replace demonstrated system design expertise and production experience.

        AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Security – Specialty.

        Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist.

        TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture qualification.

        Relevant Microsoft identity, security, industrial cybersecurity, or cryptography certifications.

  

**What success looks like**

        Architecture decisions are clear, trusted, documented, and adopted by delivery teams.

        Multi-region applications meet agreed availability, RTO, and RPO objectives, with recovery regularly tested.

        Device identity and PKI operations are automated, observable, recoverable, and secure throughout the asset lifecycle.

        Platforms remain secure, operable, and maintainable as devices, tenants, integrations, and capabilities grow.

        Normative standards and reusable platform capabilities reduce duplication, incompatible changes, and operational toil.

        AI experimentation is practical, governed, privacy-aware, and separated from unsafe or unverified control of physical equipment.

  

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

  

*At KONE, we believe in fair and competitive pay that recognizes performance and supports employee engagement. Our approach covers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits. We are committed to fostering a culture of fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion.*

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

680e349e.title: Architect | Jacobs - Navi Mumbai/Pune
680e349e.description:

**Location** - Navi Mumbai/ Pune

* Core competency in Architectural designs and should have ability and hands on experience to work on schematic/statutory/ working drawings and 2D /3D, Presentation, along with architectural BOQ & specifications.

Pune/Gondia, MH/ Noida/Dehradun

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Architect to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Define enterprise AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures.

• Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments.

• Architect CI/CD pipelines for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure.

• Establish Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation.

• Design containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR.

• Define deployment strategies including Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback.

• Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments.

• Implement DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement.

• Design AWS networking patterns involving VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.

• Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.

• Implement observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana.

• Design IAM and security models following least-privilege and Zero Trust principles.

• Implement secrets and encryption management using AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS.

• Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity.

• Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators.

• Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS.

• Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging.

• Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams.

• Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership.

Required Experience

• 10+ years of overall IT experience with 5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience.

• 3+ years in a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer role.

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including:

• EC2, S3, IAM, VPC

• Lambda

• ECS/EKS

• ECR

• API Gateway

• Route 53

• ALB/NLB

• CloudWatch and CloudTrail

• Secrets Manager and KMS

• EventBridge, SNS and SQS

• Step Functions

• Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience with AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation.

• Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.

• Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild.

• Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.

• Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.

• Experience implementing enterprise DevSecOps and security automation.

• Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions.

• Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion.

Integration Modernization Experience – Preferred

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:

• Amazon API Gateway for API management and exposure.

• AWS Lambda for serverless processing and integration.

• Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS for event-driven integration.

• AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration.

• AWS Transfer Family for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration.

• AWS B2B Data Interchange for EDI transformation and processing.

• Amazon S3 for enterprise file and message storage.

• AWS Batch for large-scale batch processing.

• Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.

• Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems.

DevSecOps Responsibilities

The architect should establish automated controls for:

• SAST/DAST and dependency scanning

• Container image scanning

• Infrastructure vulnerability scanning

• Terraform/IaC security validation

• Secrets detection

• IAM and policy validation

• Automated compliance checks

• Artifact and container security

• Audit logging and traceability

Role Expectations

The AWS DevOps Architect will own the end-to-end DevOps and cloud automation architecture, ensuring that AWS workloads can be provisioned, built, tested, secured, deployed, monitored, scaled, recovered, and operated through standardized and highly automated processes.

This is an architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role, not simply a CI/CD administration position.
