* You will lead customer technical engagements across your portfolio, owning solution design, customer success outcomes, and repeatable achievement of net new revenue and consumption targets.
* You will analyze usage, business priorities, technical blockers, and competitive dynamics to identify growth opportunities, drive optimization, and accelerate cloud consumption.
* You will orchestrate across DCSAs, sales specialists, customer success teams, engineering, and partners to remove blo

**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8-10+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales; OR
* Relevant certifications from Microsoft or competitive platforms AND 8+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales OR 8+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales; OR equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technical architecture, consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales.
* Hands-on expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security (e.g. landing zones, hub-and-spoke / Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute and VPN, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Zero Trust, resiliency and BCDR).
* Proven experience leading cloud migrations of Windows and Linux workloads to Azure, including from on-premises and other cloud platforms.

* Application development skills are welcome (e.g. AKS, App Service, API Management, modern application architectures), as is knowledge of AI and data services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric), or a strong appetite to grow in these areas.
* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), ideally complemented by Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), AI or data certifications or Microsoft Applied Skills credentials.
* Experience engaging customer technical and business stakeholders, collaborating across teams and partners, and delivering measurable outcomes.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Job description:

Job Description – Delivery Manager (Electronics R&D)

Company: Computronics Lab
  
Location: Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Department: Engineering – R&D & Product Development
  
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
  
Experience Required: 6–10 Years
  
Preferred Salary Range: ₹50,000–₹75,000 per month, depending on experience and capabilities
  
Reporting To: CEO / CTO

About Computronics Lab

Computronics Lab is an industrial engineering and product development company specializing in Electronics R&D, Embedded Systems, PCB Design, Firmware Development, IoT Solutions, Industrial Automation, and Product Prototyping.

We help businesses, startups, and OEMs transform innovative ideas into functional, reliable, and production-ready electronic products.

We are looking for a technically strong, execution-oriented Delivery Manager (Electronics R&D) who can lead engineering teams, resolve project bottlenecks, maintain engineering quality, and ensure projects are delivered within committed timelines and budgets.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Execution

Take end-to-end ownership of multiple Electronics R&D and product development projects, from project kickoff to final client acceptance.
  
Prepare and maintain realistic project execution plans, milestones, deliverables, and schedules.
  
Ensure projects progress according to approved technical requirements, budgets, and committed timelines.
  
Identify delays, dependencies, and technical risks proactively and implement corrective actions.
  
Ensure engineering deliverables are completed, tested, documented, and delivered on time.
  
Manage project priorities based on client commitments, urgency, technical complexity, and available resources.

2. Technical Leadership & Problem-Solving

Provide technical guidance in electronic circuit design, PCB development, embedded systems, firmware integration, and hardware testing.
  
Review technical designs, schematics, PCB layouts, component selection, and engineering approaches.
  
Help engineers overcome technical challenges through structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  
Make timely technical decisions to prevent unnecessary project delays.
  
Ensure prototypes are functionally tested and validated before client demonstrations or delivery.
  
Support design optimization for manufacturability, reliability, cost, and production readiness.

3. Engineering Team Management

Lead, coordinate, and monitor multiple engineers working on parallel projects.
  
Allocate resources according to project priorities, workload, and skill requirements.
  
Conduct regular project reviews to evaluate completed work, pending activities, and delivery risks.
  
Establish clear accountability for individual deliverables and milestones.
  
Ensure engineers maintain project plans, technical documentation, and daily progress updates.
  
Coach team members to improve technical competence, productivity, ownership, and problem-solving capabilities.
  
Address performance gaps and ensure projects do not remain dependent on constant senior-management intervention.

4. Quality Assurance & Product Validation

Establish and enforce engineering quality standards throughout the development lifecycle.
  
Ensure hardware, firmware, and integrated systems undergo appropriate functional and reliability testing.
  
Review test plans, test reports, and validation results before delivery.
  
Minimize repeated design errors, rework, and client complaints.
  
Ensure prototypes are professionally assembled, properly documented, and suitable for client testing.
  
Coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring technical or quality issues.

5. Client Coordination & Communication

Work closely with Sales and Engineering teams to understand and finalize project requirements.
  
Participate in technical client meetings when required.
  
Ensure clients receive regular and accurate updates on project progress.
  
Resolve technical clarifications and ensure scope changes are documented and approved.
  
Manage client expectations regarding deliverables, technical limitations, and schedules.
  
Ensure project completion includes successful demonstration, documentation, and formal client acceptance.

6. Cross-Department Coordination

Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Finance, and Operations to remove project execution bottlenecks.
  
Ensure components, PCBs, mechanical parts, and other materials are planned and procured ahead of requirements.
  
Work with Procurement to prevent delays caused by component shortages or vendor dependencies.
  
Coordinate with Sales and Finance regarding project milestones, client acceptance, and payment-linked deliverables.
  
Escalate critical risks to management with a proposed solution and recovery plan.

7. Cost Control & Engineering Productivity

Monitor engineering manpower utilization and project execution costs.
  
Reduce avoidable rework, idle time, procurement delays, and inefficient engineering practices.
  
Improve overall project throughput and delivery capacity.
  
Maintain visibility of planned versus actual engineering effort.
  
Ensure efficient use of available resources without compromising engineering quality.

Required Technical Skills

Strong understanding of Analog and Digital Electronics.
  
Electronic Circuit Design, PCB Design, and Hardware Debugging.
  
Embedded Systems and Microcontrollers such as STM32, ESP32, AVR, PIC, or ARM-based systems.
  
Familiarity with Embedded C/C++, firmware development, and hardware–software integration.
  
Experience with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS485, Modbus, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth.
  
Experience with laboratory testing equipment including Oscilloscopes, Multimeters, Power Supplies, and Logic Analyzers.
  
Understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly, prototype testing, and electronics manufacturing processes.
  
Familiarity with IoT, industrial control systems, and HMI/PLC integration will be an advantage.

Required Qualifications & Experience

B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics, ECE, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
6–10 years of relevant experience in Electronics R&D, Embedded Systems, or Product Development.
  
Minimum 2–3 years of experience leading engineering teams or managing technical projects.
  
Proven experience delivering multiple hardware/embedded product development projects.
  
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues rather than depending entirely on individual engineers.
  
Strong planning, decision-making, communication, and team-management skills.
  
Experience working in an Electronics Design House, Product Development Company, OEM, or Engineering Services Company preferred.

What We Expect from the Candidate

We are not looking for someone who merely tracks project status or forwards instructions to engineers.

We need a leader who:

Takes ownership: Accepts responsibility for project execution and committed deliveries.
  
Solves problems: Identifies technical and operational bottlenecks and drives solutions.
  
Makes decisions: Prevents delays caused by indecision or unnecessary escalations.
  
Builds accountability: Ensures engineers deliver results without requiring continuous supervision.
  
Plans proactively: Anticipates requirements, risks, and resource constraints.
  
Focuses on outcomes: Measures progress through completed, tested, and accepted deliverables rather than activity alone.

Why Join Computronics Lab?

Work on diverse industrial electronics and embedded product development projects.
  
Lead engineers across multiple technical disciplines.
  
Take ownership of complete product development cycles.
  
Contribute to building a scalable, high-performance engineering organization.
  
Opportunity to grow into senior engineering leadership as the company expands.

Benefits:

Flexible schedule
  
Health insurance

Experience:

Managing technical projects: 6 years (Required)
  
Work Location: In person

a869e35a.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
10044
  
  
221100
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi-workstream delivery programs ($5M+/year in professional services revenue) end-to-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
* MBA, or 6+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka

ad22dcde.title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
ad22dcde.description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

2ac1c00a.description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Cloud Security Manager you will lead cybersecurity client support work focused on protecting systems and data through security architecture, vulnerability review, and proactive defense strategies within our Cybersecurity practice. As a Manager you will motivate and develop teams, guide work across client engagements, and use sound judgment to address complex issues while keeping quality, timing, and delivery in view. In this role at PwC, you will help shape cloud security activities within Enterprise & Cloud Security and apply broad cybersecurity knowledge to support secure solutions, coordinate workstreams, and contribute to client trust and business outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading AWS cloud security workstreams across client engagements and aligning delivery with cybersecurity objectives
* Managing project plans, budgets, milestones, and resource coordination for cloud security initiatives
* Advising on security architecture for AWS environments, including identity, access, encryption, and network controls
* Reviewing cloud configurations, security monitoring outputs, and vulnerability findings to identify control gaps and prioritize remediation
* Directing the design and implementation of cybersecurity controls for cloud workloads and managed services environments
* Coaching team members on security review methods, technical documentation, and issue resolution approaches
* Interpreting cybersecurity requirements, policies, and compliance obligations to support secure cloud adoption
* Driving collaboration across technical and business stakeholders to address risks, escalations, and delivery blockers
* Applying Agile methodology and digital tooling to coordinate workstreams and track progress
* Developing client-facing deliverables that communicate cloud security posture, control recommendations, and remediation paths

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Studies, Computer and Information Science, Information CyberSecurity, Information Technology, Management Information Systems
* At least one of the following: One or more certifications aligned to enterprise cybersecurity governance and operations, including CISSP, CISM, or equivalent security credentials
* Demonstrating AWS cloud security knowledge in client-facing workstreams
* Managing cybersecurity projects across planning, budgeting, execution, completion
* Leading team coaching, mentoring, and performance development activities
* Applying security architecture, monitoring, and control review skills

4f8ce63f.title: Sr. Project Manager- Technical Program Manager
4f8ce63f.description:
Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress. With double-digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver scalable outcomes than Extreme.

  

Inclusion is one of our core values and in our DNA. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that embraces our differences and creates an atmosphere where all our employees thrive because of their differences, not in spite of them.

  

Become part of Something big with Extreme! As a global networking leader, learn why there’s no better time to join the Extreme team.

  

**Job Description**

  

What you will do (Job Specific Details on the nature of the job and responsibilities).

  

The individual will own program visibility and governance, identify and drive resolution of complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams, ensure customer commitments are met, manage compliance/certification critical paths, maintain executive stakeholder alignment, and escalate risks early with clear impact analysis and mitigation options.

  

**Experience** : 5-10 Years

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Executive Stakeholder Management & Program Governance**

* Own program governance structure; establish and maintain executive steering committee cadence with clear decision-making authority
* Provide weekly executive reporting on program health, milestone status, critical risks, and pending decisions
* Communicate program status to SVP-level leadership and the customer steering committee with clear, actionable insights
* Escalate risks and resource conflicts to leadership with impact analysis, mitigation options, and recommended actions
* Ensure executive visibility into program timeline, customer commitments, and go/no-go readiness
* Manage executive decision-making on trade-offs (scope vs. schedule vs. quality) with full context

**Release & Program Management**

* Manage multiple concurrent software and hardware release programs across cloud management, security, controller, networking software, and manufacturing components
* Drive releases through development completion, QA, release readiness, and GA milestones
* Track release scope, feature readiness, must-fix defects, testing completion, and release criteria
* Lead release readiness meetings, ensuring actions, risks, dependencies, and decisions are documented
* Ensure release artifacts (release notes, technical documentation, customer guides) are completed before GA
* Identify schedule risks early and drive mitigation plans with responsible teams

**Hardware NPI & Manufacturing Coordination**

* Manage new hardware platform NPI program through development, manufacturing, QA verification, and GA
* Track development, firmware/image readiness, QA verification, manufacturing readiness, and GA milestones
* Ensure hardware engineering and software feature commitments remain aligned with manufacturing timeline
* Coordinate hardware-firmware-software dependencies required for platform launch
* Drive BOM finalization, manufacturing-image readiness, and ODM partner coordination to ensure hardware ships with appropriate firmware
* Coordinate dependencies across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software teams, Manufacturing, ODM partners, and other supporting organizations

**Quality & Defect Management**

* Participate in recurring defect/bug scrubs across multiple software platforms and hardware validation
* Track must-fix defects and ensure critical issues are resolved before release
* Work with Engineering and QA to prioritize defects based on release impact and schedule
* Monitor automated and manual test results; escalate failures threatening release readiness
* Ensure comprehensive end-to-end testing for features spanning multiple platforms (cloud management, security, controller, networking software)

**Dependency, Risk & Escalation Management**

* Maintain visibility into complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
* Proactively identify schedule, resource, technical, testing, compliance, and manufacturing risks
* Maintain a centralized risk register with probability/impact assessment and mitigation tracking
* Drive owners toward resolution of blocking issues rather than simply reporting status
* Escalate unresolved risks and resource conflicts to leadership with clear impact, options, and recommended actions
* Coordinate commitments when multiple programs compete for shared Engineering or QA resources
* Ensure critical dependencies have clearly defined owners, dates, and closure criteria

**International Compliance & Certification Management**

* Coordinate compliance deliverables required for government product release
* Track regulatory and international compliance dependencies (FCC, CE, telecom certifications, government security requirements)
* Ensure compliance requirements and certifications do not block customer deployment
* Coordinate dependencies involving external certification bodies and ODM partners
* Track certification timelines and identify delays or blockers early
* Assess and communicate release impact of delayed certifications or compliance deliverables

**Program Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and status using Jira and portfolio management tools
* Use Jira epics, features, defects, and dashboards to assess program health across all workstreams
* Develop concise program status reports for PMO and executive leadership
* Clearly communicate milestone health, risks, decisions required, and leadership attention areas
* Use AI tools to generate automated reports, trend analysis, and program health dashboards
* Leverage AI-driven monitoring tools to track program metrics and flag risks proactively
Manage program coordination and reporting across multiple time zones to support global teams and customers  

  

**Job Description Summary**

  
The Technical Program Manager will join the Project Management Office and drive a complex, multi-year strategic government program involving hardware platform NPI, concurrent software releases, private cloud infrastructure deployment, and international compliance certification. The role requires strong technical program management skills, disciplined execution, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Networking Software (cloud management, security, controller platforms), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, International Compliance, and government customer teams across multiple time zones.  
  

**Qualifications**

  

Basic Requirements and Preferred Qualifications for the job.

  
  

We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Come Advance with us! In keeping with our values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” Extreme Networks also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our organization. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Extreme Networks.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human oversight. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed —or to exercise any applicable privacy rights—please contact us at privacyinquiries@extremenetworks.com.

  

Our full privacy statement is available here: Privacy Statement

66a214be.title: Strategic Program Manager
66a214be.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

### **\*\*This position will be based on-site in our Bangalore office, working overnight IST hours to support the US Pacific Standard Time zone.\*\***

### **Impact In This Role**

As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at Fictiv, you will collaborate with some of the world's leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches while maintaining the highest quality standards. Serving as a trusted advisor, you will leverage your expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every phase of the product lifecycle—from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) to mass production.

You will play a critical role in ensuring customers' products are launched on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, you will scope, plan, and execute customer programs, consistently delivering exceptional service and tangible value throughout the product lifecycle.

With a focus on continuous improvement, you will help refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that improve the customer experience. You will also mentor and guide Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs), sharing knowledge and best practices to strengthen program execution and support the team's overall success.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Champion the customer experience: Act as the primary customer advocate, building trusted relationships and delivering exceptional experiences that foster long-term customer loyalty.
* Lead cross-functional program execution: Collaborate with pre- and post-sales teams, including Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, to scope, plan, and execute customer programs, ensuring on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Apply technical and program management expertise: Leverage your knowledge of engineering and manufacturing processes, combined with strong program management skills, to identify risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and manage changes to keep programs on track.
* Serve as a trusted subject matter expert: Provide technical and operational insights to customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on requirements, manufacturing feasibility, quality expectations, and program objectives.
* Drive program performance and accountability: Track and report on program milestones, timelines, deliverables, and key performance indicators, making necessary adjustments to maintain progress and meet customer expectations and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen operational efficiency, and enhance the overall customer experience in collaboration with cross- functional teams.
* Facilitate effective program communication: Lead regular status meetings with customers and internal stakeholders to communicate requirements, timelines, deliverables, and quality standards, maintain alignment, and proactively resolve blockers.
* Mentor and support Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs): Share expertise, provide guidance, and reinforce program management best practices to strengthen execution capabilities and support the team's overall success.
* Support quality management: Adhere to and contribute to Fictiv's Quality Management System (QMS), supporting compliance with established quality standards and continuous improvement initiatives.

### **Desired Traits**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Program management experience: 5+ years of experience managing complex projects or programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* NPD and NPI expertise: Hands-on experience supporting New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and transitions into high-volume manufacturing.
* Manufacturing process knowledge: Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC machining, 3D printing, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, or assembly.

5ce641b4.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
5ce641b4.description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
**About The Role**
We're hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager for our Product & Engineering organization. You'll own two areas:
  
  

* Product delivery and release readiness for Seismic software (including Highspot by Seismic): making sure features ship on time, at quality, with go-to-market teams ready on day one.
* Technical programs that span teams, such as localization workflows, architecture upgrades, and other technical initiatives.

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Design, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams. You'll turn ambitious goals into clear plans, make tradeoffs visible, and keep programs moving without needing formal authority.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**Required**

* 5+ years as a Technical Program Manager or in a similar role in B2B SaaS, leading complex cross-functional programs.
* Experience managing the full software development lifecycle and go-to-market readiness for product launches. Critically, you have delivered not only internal projects, but you have overseen feature/product delivery to external customers.
* Deep experience with agile/scrum, and judgment about when to adapt process for a large, complex organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Data-driven: you use metrics to make decisions, surface risks and measure success. You're comfortable getting data yourself with tools like Amplitude, SQL and Snowflake.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate workflows, speed up delivery and remove manual work. Please share examples in your application.
* Flexibility working across time zones, in particular coordinating across North America and sometimes China.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading change management or new technology adoption across an organization.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence, LaunchDarkly, Salesforce, and sales enablement products.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

**What you’ll be doing:**
**Product delivery & release readiness**

* Own end-to-end program management for a core product feature area across multiple engineering teams in different geos, keeping a predictable delivery cadence.
* Run the release readiness process: drive sign-off from Engineering, QE, Security and other functions, and make sure features are high quality and well documented.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and Technical Account Managers so customer-facing teams are enabled and customers are set up for success at launch.

**Technical programs**

* Lead internal and/or customer-facing technical programs from definition through delivery: set scope, build the plan, line up owners and drive adoption.
* Lead change management for new processes and tools, including stakeholder alignment, communication, training and measuring adoption.

**Across both**

* Define and track program metrics and business KPIs, and give stakeholders and leadership clear, concise status.
* Spot risks and dependencies early, raise them with options, and drive them to resolution.
* Find manual, repetitive program work and automate it, including with AI tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 90 days: Own the release calendar for a major product area (to be determined), establish relationships across functions and run at least one release end to end.
* First year: Releases are predictable and GTM teams are consistently ready at launch. At least one technical program is delivered with measurable adoption.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

21dabd75.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
Senior Principal Program Manager - Interface Controllers
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager who will be responsible for the overall coordination of R&D Development Projects and Key Customer Engagements within the Design IP Group. The candidate must have solid, hands-on experience with PCIe, UCIe and/or Ethernet controllers and implementation in SoC with a history in successfully leading or managing designs with end customers. We are looking for an individual with an entrepreneurial mindset with strong leadership skills and “assume ownership” to ensure flawless execution. Someone who is passionate, and enjoys and thrives on coordinating all the facets of the design project in a matrix organizational structure to deliver successful results. Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate with R&D and marketing in defining the scope, and ability to collaborate with teams with clear communication skills, are the must-have attributes in this role.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Program Manager you are responsible for driving the various internal teams to deliver Controller IP based products and services. You must be knowledgeable and proficient with Ethernet and PCIe standards, MAC and protocols. Additionally, proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification to understand Interoperability and Compliance test suites. This position is responsible for creating and executing project plan, proactively mitigating risks, and managing the Project life cycle from inception to project delivery and post-production support. You will also be responsible for managing external stakeholders as customer facing Program Manager.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with internal & external customers, stakeholders to define project objectives and requirements.
* Prioritize requirements and define scope to meet customer needs in a timely manner given available resources.
* Develop, maintain, and distribute (as appropriate) standard project management deliverables for the successful implementation of the project, including: implementation plan, project schedule, project budget and variances, issues & action items log, meeting minutes, risks assessment and contingencies.
* Manage deliverables (including SOWs, change management, approval of deliverables).
* Partner with internal and external development teams to deliver on time and with the quality required.
* Serve as the project owner in development process; maintaining quality checklists, Jira tickets, schedule tracker etc.
* Manage each release through the quality checker process.
* Partner with various teams to identify areas in need of improvement to increase customer satisfaction and decrease support requests.
* Anticipate problems and complications and formulate solutions so as not to impede the progress of the project.
* Assume responsibility and drive ownership for issue resolution.
* Holding status update meetings with technical teams and updating higher management on the project progress.
* Create and maintain scorecards to track project performance.
* Accountable for on time project delivery, product quality, cost, and operations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution.
* 15+ years of experience out of which at least 2+ years of Program Management or Technical Product Management experience in a technology-oriented organization.
* Physical Layer and Protocol layer experience on AT LEAST ONE High speed SERDES on Ethernet/PCIe/CXL/UCIe
* Experience in PCIe/UCIe LTSSM states / UCIe Interfaces / Ethernet standards
* Proficient with Ethernet, PCIe, UCIe standards and Protocols. Proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification reg. Protocol, Interoperability and Compliance test suites
* Strong project management skills with the ability to work on and track multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically when executing the project and solving problems.
* Familiar with mixed-signal IP design flow and methodologies, Verilog/RTL coding & Verification

Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical individuals.

Sales Specialist - Hybrid Cloud SolutionsThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**Global Sales** at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

***Job Family Definition:***

Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.

***Management Level Definition:***

Applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle most unique situations. May seek advice in order to make decisions on complex business issues.

**What you’ll do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Drive direct sales of HPE Hybrid Cloud solutions, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships across assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to position HPE GreenLake solutions, Hybrid Cloud offerings, and consumption-based IT services to enterprise customers.
* Identify, qualify, and develop opportunities for HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Private Cloud, and Storage as a Service (STaaS) solutions.
* Build and manage a strong sales pipeline for Hybrid Cloud and as-a-Service offerings, ensuring alignment with Account Managers and business objectives.
* Work closely with Account Managers to identify customer requirements, develop account-specific sales strategies, and drive revenue growth through specialized Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Engage directly with customers, including CXOs, IT leaders, infrastructure heads, and decision-makers, to understand their business challenges and present relevant Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Drive consultative selling by understanding customers' existing IT infrastructure, cloud adoption strategies, data management requirements, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Position HPE GreenLake's consumption-based model and flexible IT solutions as alternatives to traditional infrastructure procurement and ownership models.
* Drive sales of Storage as a Service, Hybrid Cloud Storage, data management, and infrastructure modernization solutions, aligning offerings with customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cloud transformation, workload modernization, hybrid IT infrastructure, and migration from traditional on-premises environments to hybrid cloud models.
* Develop customer-specific proposals, solution value propositions, commercial models, and business cases in collaboration with technical specialists and solution architects.
* Lead customer discussions, negotiations, commercial presentations, and deal closures for Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake opportunities.
* Collaborate with Presales, Solution Architects, Product Teams, and delivery teams to develop comprehensive solutions that address customer business and technical requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, channel partners, and strategic technology partners to accelerate Hybrid Cloud business growth.
* Analyze competitor offerings across Hybrid Cloud, cloud infrastructure, storage, and as-a-Service solutions to strengthen HPE's competitive positioning.
* Drive strategic account penetration by identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities across HPE's Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake portfolio.
* Support Account Managers in developing pursuit strategies, forecasting opportunities, managing deal progression, and achieving assigned sales quotas.
* Maintain accurate opportunity management, sales forecasting, and pipeline updates through CRM tools such as Salesforce/Siebel.
* Stay updated on emerging Hybrid Cloud technologies, cloud consumption models, infrastructure-as-a-Service, Storage as a Service, and industry trends to strengthen customer engagement and sales effectiveness.

**What you need to bring**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, preferably in Hybrid Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, Storage, or IT Infrastructure solutions.
* Proven experience in direct sales, consultative selling, account management, and business development within enterprise or commercial accounts.
* Demonstrated success in achieving sales quotas, developing new business opportunities, and closing complex technology deals.
* Experience selling HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud solutions, Storage as a Service, Infrastructure as a Service, or similar consumption-based IT solutions is preferred.
* Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments, IT infrastructure, and cloud transformation requirements.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Strong understanding of Hybrid Cloud architecture, including private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid IT environments.
* Good knowledge of HPE GreenLake offerings, consumption-based IT models, and as-a-Service business models.
* Understanding of Storage as a Service (STaaS), enterprise storage solutions, data management, and storage modernization.
* Knowledge of Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud management solutions.
* Ability to position and sell infrastructure solutions based on customer business requirements, operational efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Strong direct sales and consultative selling capabilities, with the ability to independently identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities.
* Ability to work closely with Account Managers to drive account penetration, pipeline development, customer engagement, and revenue growth.
* Understanding of enterprise cloud adoption strategies, workload migration, infrastructure modernization, and IT transformation initiatives.
* Ability to articulate the business value of HPE GreenLake and Hybrid Cloud solutions against traditional CAPEX-based infrastructure models.
* Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and closing strategies.
* Ability to engage with senior customer stakeholders, including CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, and IT infrastructure decision-makers.
* Strong understanding of competitive offerings from major Hybrid Cloud, storage, and infrastructure providers.
* Experience working with channel partners, strategic alliances, and technology partners to drive sales opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Strong pipeline management, sales forecasting, opportunity tracking, and CRM management skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical solutions into measurable business outcomes and customer value.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

5480843a.title: Presales Director
5480843a.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control - helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
  
  
The Opportunity Ahead
  
  

* Shape and lead the presales function of a fast-growing B2B fintech from an early stage, with a direct line to the founders.
* Work with top banks and cutting-edge credit infrastructure on high-visibility, high-value deals.
* Own the story behind products that run for millions of end users.
* Fast-paced, high-learning environment with strong growth opportunities.

86bca5eb.description:
**Job Purpose**
Plan, monitor and provide technical services and training to Key Customers across the region to ensure customized concrete solutions, value added services, and brand leadership.
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
UltraTech Cement is the largest cement manufacturer in India with an installed capacity of about More than 200 MTPA. The company has production facilities in 63 locations spread across the country and has plans to grow further than acquisition and green field expansion. The Ultratech brand occupies a premium position. The Indian cement industry has a capacity of more than600 million tonnes. The market has strong regional Indian and MNC players in each Zone and has strong brand competition. The challenge will be to create compelling differentiation in Cement sales for achieving premium in pricing & exceeding Customers' expectations through service excellence. Align & adopt a "One UltraTech" approach and leverage on strong relationship with channel partners to provide end to end construction solutions and stay ahead of the competition.
  
  
The entry of multinationals augurs robust SOP and technology driven solutions and hence the ability to foresee and comply with all of those for customer delight in highly competitive environment . Key Accounts Business was a pioneer initiative that aimed to provide focused attention to the top 100 institutional customers (mainly construction companies in India). The aim was to provide them with a dedicated sales force responsible for identifying customer needs and understanding emerging trends so as to ensure effective brand positioning and building market share. In this segment, it is vital to nurture strong relationships with clients and consultants to understand their specific needs and act as a trusted advisor to the business. Although it is an established business with 3000 crore revenue and 18% of total cement sales, the major challenges being to serve Key Customers across India, complex supply chain and strong customer interface. The increasing complexity of construction practices, demanding application for infrastructure projects like metros, highways, ports & airports and meeting specifications of international standards pose a constant challenge to provide the required quantity and quality of cement.
  
  
**Key Result Areas**

Plan, monitor and provide technical services and training to Key Customers across the region to ensure customized concrete solutions, value added services, and brand leadership.

#### **Job Context & Major Challenges**

UltraTech Cement is the largest cement manufacturer in India with an installed capacity of about More than 200 MTPA. The company has production facilities in 63 locations spread across the country and has plans to grow further than acquisition and green field expansion. Although it is an established business with 3000 crore revenue and 18% of total cement sales, the major challenges being to serve Key Customers across India, complex supply chain and strong customer interface. e5f1dee4.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Global Sales**
at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle most unique situations. May seek advice in order to make decisions on complex business issues.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
***Responsibilities:***

* Drive direct sales of HPE Hybrid Cloud solutions, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships across assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to position HPE GreenLake solutions, Hybrid Cloud offerings, and consumption-based IT services to enterprise customers.
* Identify, qualify, and develop opportunities for HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Private Cloud, and Storage as a Service (STaaS) solutions.
* Build and manage a strong sales pipeline for Hybrid Cloud and as-a-Service offerings, ensuring alignment with Account Managers and business objectives.
* Work closely with Account Managers to identify customer requirements, develop account-specific sales strategies, and drive revenue growth through specialized Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Engage directly with customers, including CXOs, IT leaders, infrastructure heads, and decision-makers, to understand their business challenges and present relevant Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Drive consultative selling by understanding customers' existing IT infrastructure, cloud adoption strategies, data management requirements, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Position HPE GreenLake's consumption-based model and flexible IT solutions as alternatives to traditional infrastructure procurement and ownership models.
* Drive sales of Storage as a Service, Hybrid Cloud Storage, data management, and infrastructure modernization solutions, aligning offerings with customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cloud transformation, workload modernization, hybrid IT infrastructure, and migration from traditional on-premises environments to hybrid cloud models.
* Develop customer-specific proposals, solution value propositions, commercial models, and business cases in collaboration with technical specialists and solution architects.
* Lead customer discussions, negotiations, commercial presentations, and deal closures for Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake opportunities.
* Collaborate with Presales, Solution Architects, Product Teams, and delivery teams to develop comprehensive solutions that address customer business and technical requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, channel partners, and strategic technology partners to accelerate Hybrid Cloud business growth.
* Analyze competitor offerings across Hybrid Cloud, cloud infrastructure, storage, and as-a-Service solutions to strengthen HPE's competitive positioning.
* Drive strategic account penetration by identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities across HPE's Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake portfolio.
* Support Account Managers in developing pursuit strategies, forecasting opportunities, managing deal progression, and achieving assigned sales quotas.
* Maintain accurate opportunity management, sales forecasting, and pipeline updates through CRM tools such as Salesforce/Siebel.
* Stay updated on emerging Hybrid Cloud technologies, cloud consumption models, infrastructure-as-a-Service, Storage as a Service, and industry trends to strengthen customer engagement and sales effectiveness.

**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, preferably in Hybrid Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, Storage, or IT Infrastructure solutions.
* Proven experience in direct sales, consultative selling, account management, and business development within enterprise or commercial accounts.
* Demonstrated success in achieving sales quotas, developing new business opportunities, and closing complex technology deals.
* Experience selling HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud solutions, Storage as a Service, Infrastructure as a Service, or similar consumption-based IT solutions is preferred.
* Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments, IT infrastructure, and cloud transformation requirements.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong understanding of Hybrid Cloud architecture, including private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid IT environments.
* Good knowledge of HPE GreenLake offerings, consumption-based IT models, and as-a-Service business models.
* Understanding of Storage as a Service (STaaS), enterprise storage solutions, data management, and storage modernization.
* Knowledge of Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud management solutions.
* Ability to position and sell infrastructure solutions based on customer business requirements, operational efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Strong direct sales and consultative selling capabilities, with the ability to independently identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities.
* Ability to work closely with Account Managers to drive account penetration, pipeline development, customer engagement, and revenue growth.
* Understanding of enterprise cloud adoption strategies, workload migration, infrastructure modernization, and IT transformation initiatives.
* Ability to articulate the business value of HPE GreenLake and Hybrid Cloud solutions against traditional CAPEX-based infrastructure models.
* Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and closing strategies.
* Ability to engage with senior customer stakeholders, including CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, and IT infrastructure decision-makers.
* Strong understanding of competitive offerings from major Hybrid Cloud, storage, and infrastructure providers.
* Experience working with channel partners, strategic alliances, and technology partners to drive sales opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Strong pipeline management, sales forecasting, opportunity tracking, and CRM management skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical solutions into measurable business outcomes and customer value.

**Accessibility**
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
**Personal & Professional Development**
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
  
  
**Unconditional Inclusion**
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
