eb096cdb.title: Strategic Program Manager
eb096cdb.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  

* This position will be based on-site in our Bangalore office, working overnight IST hours to support the US Pacific Standard Time zone.\*\*

**Impact In This Role**
As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at Fictiv, you will collaborate with some of the world’s leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches while maintaining the highest quality standards. Serving as a trusted advisor, you will leverage your expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every phase of the product lifecycle—from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) to mass production.
  
  
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers’ products are launched on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, you will scope, plan, and execute customer programs, consistently delivering exceptional service and tangible value throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
With a focus on continuous improvement, you will help refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that improve the customer experience. You will also mentor and guide Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs), sharing knowledge and best practices to strengthen program execution and support the team’s overall success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Champion the customer experience: Act as the primary customer advocate, building trusted relationships and delivering exceptional experiences that foster long-term customer loyalty.
* Lead cross-functional program execution: Collaborate with pre- and post-sales teams, including Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, to scope, plan, and execute customer programs, ensuring on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Apply technical and program management expertise: Leverage your knowledge of engineering and manufacturing processes, combined with strong program management skills, to identify risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and manage changes to keep programs on track.
* Serve as a trusted subject matter expert: Provide technical and operational insights to customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on requirements, manufacturing feasibility, quality expectations, and program objectives.
* Drive program performance and accountability: Track and report on program milestones, timelines, deliverables, and key performance indicators, making necessary adjustments to maintain progress and meet customer expectations and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen operational efficiency, and enhance the overall customer experience in collaboration with cross- functional teams.
* Facilitate effective program communication: Lead regular status meetings with customers and internal stakeholders to communicate requirements, timelines, deliverables, and quality standards, maintain alignment, and proactively resolve blockers.
* Mentor and support Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs): Share expertise, provide guidance, and reinforce program management best practices to strengthen execution capabilities and support the team's overall success.
* Support quality management: Adhere to and contribute to Fictiv's Quality Management System (QMS), supporting compliance with established quality standards and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Desired Traits**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Program management experience: 5+ years of experience managing complex projects or programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* NPD and NPI expertise: Hands-on experience supporting New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and transitions into high-volume manufacturing.
* Manufacturing process knowledge: Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC machining, 3D printing, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, or assembly.
* Customer-facing leadership: Experience leading complex, consultative customer engagements, using technical and operational expertise to align stakeholders, solve problems, and deliver successful outcomes.
* Program and risk management: Strong program planning, risk management, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and consistently meet deadlines.
* Tools and systems proficiency: Proficiency with program management tools and software for tracking milestones, managing deliverables, communicating updates, and reporting progress across distributed teams.
* Business and customer orientation: A self-starter with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving complex problems and building meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset: A demonstrated commitment to process optimization, operational excellence, service enhancement, and customer success.
* Mentorship and collaboration: A willingness to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and promote best practices while working effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Growth mindset: A passion for continuous learning, developing innovative solutions, and tackling challenging problems in dynamic environments.
* Communication skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multicultural, cross-functional, and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong program management, risk management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines within a structured framework.
* Proficiency in standard program management tools and software used for tracking, communication, and reporting across distributed teams.
* Self-starter, with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving problems and building deep, meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrates a focus on process optimization, service enhancement, and driving customer success.
* Passionate about learning, building solutions, and tackling challenges.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with experience working across multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
  
  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

b7f80bd1.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
b7f80bd1.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager for our Product & Engineering organization. You'll own two areas:

* **Product delivery and release readiness** for Seismic software (including Highspot by Seismic): making sure features ship on time, at quality, with go-to-market teams ready on day one.
* **Technical programs** that span teams, such as localization workflows, architecture upgrades, and other technical initiatives.

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Design, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams. You'll turn ambitious goals into clear plans, make tradeoffs visible, and keep programs moving without needing formal authority.

Who you are::

**Required**

* 5+ years as a Technical Program Manager or in a similar role in B2B SaaS, leading complex cross-functional programs.
* Experience managing the full software development lifecycle and go-to-market readiness for product launches. Critically, you have delivered not only internal projects, but you have overseen feature/product delivery to external customers.
* Deep experience with agile/scrum, and judgment about when to adapt process for a large, complex organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Data-driven: you use metrics to make decisions, surface risks and measure success. You're comfortable getting data yourself with tools like Amplitude, SQL and Snowflake.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate workflows, speed up delivery and remove manual work. Please share examples in your application.
* Flexibility working across time zones, in particular coordinating across North America and sometimes China.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading change management or new technology adoption across an organization.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence, LaunchDarkly, Salesforce, and sales enablement products.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

What you'll be doing::

**Product delivery & release readiness**

* Own end-to-end program management for a core product feature area across multiple engineering teams in different geos, keeping a predictable delivery cadence.
* Run the release readiness process: drive sign-off from Engineering, QE, Security and other functions, and make sure features are high quality and well documented.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and Technical Account Managers so customer-facing teams are enabled and customers are set up for success at launch.

**Technical programs**

* Lead internal and/or customer-facing technical programs from definition through delivery: set scope, build the plan, line up owners and drive adoption.
* Lead change management for new processes and tools, including stakeholder alignment, communication, training and measuring adoption.

**Across both**

* Define and track program metrics and business KPIs, and give stakeholders and leadership clear, concise status.
* Spot risks and dependencies early, raise them with options, and drive them to resolution.
* Find manual, repetitive program work and automate it, including with AI tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First** **90 days****:** Own the release calendar for a major product area (to be determined), establish relationships across functions and run at least one release end to end.
* **First year:** Releases are predictable and GTM teams are consistently ready at launch. At least one technical program is delivered with measurable adoption.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

You will move a continuous pipeline of product launches, partner integrations, and marketplace expansions from ready-to-launch through pilot, GA, and worldwide scale — directly increasing the volume of capabilities in customers' hands.
  
  
As launch and integration volume grows across the 2027 portfolio, this role scales with that activity. Your output is measured in launches delivered, partner integrations completed, and marketplaces enabled — with monthly productivity tracked against launches per PgM. You will work alongside product and engineering leaders who define capabilities, converting their roadmaps into executed, live-in-region launches.
  
  
You will operate across multiple concurrent launch workstreams, coordinating UAT, instrumentation, KPI monitoring during rollout, merchant/partner onboarding, and launch documentation. This role requires strong program management fundamentals, launch-execution discipline, and comfort operating across teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Key job responsibilities,
  
  

* Drive product launches from ready-to-launch through worldwide rollout — own launch execution across a portfolio of new external-facing returns capabilities and pilots, moving each from pilot to GA to worldwide scale.

* Run the launch pipeline across concurrent workstreams — prioritize competing launches, set and communicate realistic timelines, and manage dependencies across engineering, product, BD, and operations in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
* Scale proven launches across WW marketplaces and improve throughput over time — sequence and execute marketplace expansions, capture repeatable launch mechanics, and drive measurable productivity gains (reduced cycle time per launch) as launch volume grows

You will work closely with engineering, design, and partner teams to define and deliver product capabilities and customer-facing experiences. 9e68e160.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
9e68e160.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
  
  
  
  
**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  
  
  
At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
  
  
  
  
***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us***

**Job Description**

Freshservice is expanding what “AI-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.

This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post-sale. You'll be the AI subject-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.

You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs-of-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof-of-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business-case models that the wider SE team can self-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go-to expert.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM-based solutions in a customer-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one-size-fits-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof-of-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX-leader audience or down to a hands-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42) and how it feeds AI-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

* **This job gets more hands-on every quarter, not less.** The volume of code goes up while the time you spend typing it goes down, so the value moves to the two ends of it: what you specify, and what you verify. You will stay close to production, run the AI harness daily, read code you did not write, and keep your technical judgment current rather than remembered.
* **Whoever ships it owns it, regardless of what wrote it.** Most code is AI-generated now, so the judgment moved to either side of it: specifying exactly what to build, and verifying that what came back is correct, secure and operable. An agent wrote it is not a defense. Your name is on the merge.
* **You do not need to own the roadmap to know why the work matters.** You will not be the Product counterpart at this level and you are not expected to be. You are expected to understand what the customer gets and what the business gains from the thing you are building, and to ask before you build the wrong thing correctly. The engineers who move fastest here are the ones who ask that question early rather than at the review.
* **You go on call for what you build,** and you take your turn on the rotation. Engineering declares risk and timelines in writing for the business to accept, and that includes yours: when a date is at risk you say so early, with evidence, rather than quietly.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own platform features end to end within the Private Cloud Solutions domain.** Take work from specification through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support across Nutanix and VMware environments.
* **Design, deploy, and maintain private cloud infrastructure.** Work with Nutanix platforms and related virtualization technologies to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure customer environments.
* **Build and operate multi-tenant Nutanix environments.** Support cluster design, deployment, administration, lifecycle management, and ongoing maintenance in shared production environments.
* **Improve platform reliability and operational efficiency.** Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, standardize configurations, and reduce operational risk.
* **Translate requirements into clear technical specifications.** Identify dependencies, capacity needs, failure scenarios, and operational risks early and resolve ambiguity before implementation begins.
* **Verify changes before they reach production.** Validate platform changes, exercise failure scenarios, and provide clear evidence that changes are safe and production-ready.
* **Use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of your daily workflow.** Apply agentic tooling to implementation, automation, and review while remaining accountable for the quality and operability of the final result.
* **Review infrastructure and technical changes from other engineers.** Identify design, scalability, reliability, and operational risks early and provide clear, actionable feedback.
* **Own the systems you run.** Participate in on-call rotation, respond to incidents, document root causes and follow-up actions, and continuously reduce operational toil.
* **Work safely in existing and unfamiliar environments.** Understand complex or legacy infrastructure, make incremental improvements without unnecessary redesigns, and leave systems better documented and instrumented than you found them.
* **Mentor other engineers.** Share technical knowledge, explain design and operational decisions, and support less experienced engineers through implementation and review.
* **Coordinate dependencies across teams.** Identify cross-team requirements early andwork directly with the relevant engineers to avoid delivery blockers.

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience with **Nutanix administration**, including initial cluster design, deployment, and setup.
* 5+ years of experience with **Nutanix multi-tenant environments**, including installation, administration, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of virtualization, compute, storage, networking, and production infrastructure.
* Experience building, operating, and supporting highly available private cloud or virtualized environments.
* Experience troubleshooting complex issues across multiple infrastructure layers.
* Experience planning and executing infrastructure changes in production environments.
* Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
* Ability to work effectively in unfamiliar or legacy environments and make safe, incremental improvements.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools as part of day-to-day technical work.
* Clear written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed team across multiple time zones.

**Preferred**

* 5+ years of experience with **Linux administration**.
* Experience with **VMware** administration and virtualization environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management.
* Experience with multi-tenant private cloud platforms.
* Experience in managed hosting, cloud platforms, or another high-availability service
* environment.
* Experience reviewing infrastructure changes and mentoring other engineers.

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
5,000 - 6,000 EUR per month(SDC Cyprus)  
4,000 - 5,000 EUR per month(SDC Slovakia)  
3,000 - 4,000 EUR per month(SDC Bulgaria)

ac7b2e0d.title: Platform Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
ac7b2e0d.description:

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.

* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.  

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Anticipates and develops solutions to address current and future information system needs. Creates process improvements and controls. Serves as the SME in the Request for Proposal (RFP) and vendor selection process for the purchase of software systems. Assesses impacts on the budget and technical requirements associated with implementing new system technologies or upgrading existing system technologies.

Facilitates capacity planning. Remains apprised of project status and communicates issues and resolutions on potential problems.
* Oversees and provides expert advice in the evaluation of software programming and modification ensuring adherence to required procedures, methodologies and/or application standards, including Payment Card Industry (PCI) and security related compliance. Monitors the maintenance of information systems to maintain optimum system capacity levels. Coordinates and monitors the troubleshooting of information systems. Establishes a communication plan to alert users of problems and resolutions.
* Solicits feedback from internal customers and IT teams to understand how well information systems are serving customers and recommends improvements.

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* Relevant Experience or Degree in: Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or related field
* Typically Minimum 8+ Years Relevant Exp
* Four-year college degree and 8 or more years, and/or a high school diploma with 10 or more years professional experience in full life cycle design and development to include IT architecture, banking industry experience, and understanding client requirements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree
* Computer Science or Information Systems

294c0073.title: Hiring Salesforce Health Cloud Developer
294c0073.description:
**Role:** Salesforce Health Cloud Developer

**Experience:** 5+ years  
**Location:** Remote – Pan India  
**Budget:** Up to ₹1.5 LPM  
**Payroll:** Haparz

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Health Cloud Developer with strong hands-on implementation and development experience in Salesforce Health Cloud.

The ideal candidate will have expertise in Salesforce platform development, healthcare data models, patient and member journeys, clinical workflows, and healthcare system integrations. The role involves designing, developing, integrating and supporting secure, scalable healthcare solutions using Salesforce Health Cloud and related Salesforce technologies.

The candidate should be able to demonstrate personal contributions to Health Cloud implementations, including data model configuration, Apex and LWC development, healthcare integrations, security implementation and production support.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop and support Salesforce Health Cloud solutions for patient and member onboarding, care coordination, care management, provider engagement, utilization management and healthcare service workflows.
* Configure and extend the Health Cloud data model, including Person Accounts, patients and members, care plans, care plan activities, care teams, health conditions, medications, clinical encounters, providers and related healthcare records.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, validation rules and asynchronous processes while following bulkification, governor-limit and Salesforce development best practices.
* Build custom interfaces and guided healthcare workflows using LWC and, where applicable, OmniStudio components such as OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors and Integration Procedures.
* Integrate Salesforce Health Cloud with Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), payer, provider, laboratory, pharmacy and other enterprise healthcare systems.
* Implement healthcare interoperability using Health Cloud Business APIs, Salesforce Healthcare APIs, REST/SOAP APIs, HL7 and FHIR R4 integration patterns.
* Work with MuleSoft or other middleware platforms to transform, validate and securely exchange healthcare data between Salesforce and external systems.
* Implement Salesforce security and access controls, including profiles, permission sets, role-based access, sharing rules, field-level security, consent management, encryption-related controls and audit requirements for sensitive health information.
* Support healthcare data migration, mapping, cleansing, data-quality validation and reconciliation from legacy clinical, payer or member systems into Salesforce Health Cloud.
* Develop Apex test classes, unit tests and technical documentation; participate in code reviews, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), release management and production support.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, data discrepancies, application defects and production issues, including root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with product owners, Salesforce architects, business analysts, integration teams, healthcare Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and QA teams to translate healthcare requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivered solutions support applicable healthcare privacy, regulatory, security and data-governance requirements, including HIPAA-aligned practices where relevant.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Minimum 5 years of overall Salesforce development experience, including strong hands-on Salesforce Health Cloud development experience on implementation projects.
* Strong development expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flow, asynchronous Apex, test classes and platform configuration.
* Hands-on knowledge of the Salesforce Health Cloud data model and healthcare workflows, including patient/member onboarding, care plans, care teams, provider relationships and clinical information management.
* Experience with healthcare integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Health Cloud Business APIs, Salesforce Healthcare APIs, Named Credentials, OAuth and middleware platforms.
* Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards, particularly HL7 and FHIR R4, including healthcare data mapping into Salesforce clinical objects.
* Experience implementing Salesforce security, sharing, field-level access, consent, encryption-related controls and audit mechanisms for sensitive healthcare information.
* Experience with healthcare data migration, Data Loader or ETL tools, error handling, data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and CI/CD tools such as Copado, Gearset, Jenkins or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to translate healthcare business requirements into technical designs and explain implementation decisions to functional and technical stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

Good-to-Have Experience

* OmniStudio development using OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors and Integration Procedures.
* Experience with Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics or Agentforce in healthcare use cases.
* Knowledge of healthcare payer processes such as benefits verification, prior authorization, utilization management and claims-related workflows.
* Exposure to HIPAA-aligned delivery practices, protected health information (PHI) handling and healthcare data-governance controls.
* Experience working with high-volume healthcare data, large data volumes and performance optimization.

Preferred Certifications

* Salesforce Health Cloud Accredited Professional or the current equivalent Health Cloud credential.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I; Platform Developer II preferred.
* Salesforce OmniStudio Developer or Consultant, where OmniStudio is part of the implementation.
* Salesforce Integration Architect, Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect credentials are advantageous.

Work Location: Remote

e2273cad.title: Technical Architect
e2273cad.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Project Description:  
The system utilizes specialized LLM agents and Gemini Enterprise solutions to perform automated enterprise data retrieval, multi-step logical reasoning, and knowledge synthesis leveraging tools like NotebookLM and the Google Workspace Ecosystem. The platform integrates robust enterprise security, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) protocols to securely connect disparate data silos (including third-party platforms like Microsoft Entra ID/M365, Salesforce, and Atlassian) while upholding organizational safety, security, and precision standards.

Role:  
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Gemini Enterprise, Agentic AI, and Multi-Agent Systems

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise  
Identify need for Pro Code Vs No Code design based on customer’s problem statement and data sources  
Design Deploy and custom agents using the Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine and integrate with Gemini Enterprise  
Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem (Docs, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery.  
Architect scalable short-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long-term memory architectures across multi-agent interactions.  
Implement end-to-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, Google Cloud services, and 3rd-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID / M365, Salesforce, Atlassian) using IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and service identities.  
Enforce fine-grained Access Control Lists (ACLs), user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries.  
Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and root cause analysis (RCA).  
Architect Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points.  
Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations.  
Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Self-Reflection to enhance agent reliability.  
Establish quantitative evaluation frameworks to measure agent trajectories, tool invocation precision/recall, and reasoning faithfulness.  
Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Must Have Skills  
Core Engineering & Frameworks: Strong proficiency in Python with production-level software engineering practices, along with deep, hands-on experience building multi-agent systems using Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) or comparable agentic frameworks.  
Gemini & Workspace Ecosystem: Solid hands-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the broader Google Workspace Ecosystem (APIs, Add-ons, Drive/Docs connectors).  
Memory & State Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in managing agent session state, short-term context caching, and durable long-term memory backends (vector databases, relational/NoSQL session stores).  
Third Party Tools: Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third-party platforms (e.g., iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity, DocuSign, MS Office Suite, Sharepoint, JIRA) with Gemini Enterprise.  
Auth & Security: Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Service Accounts, Workload Identity Federation) across Google Cloud and 3rd-party SaaS platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, Atlassian).  
ACLs & Permissions: Deep working knowledge of enterprise Access Control Lists (ACLs), identity federation, permission trimming, and role-based access control (RBAC) across heterogeneous data sources.  
Developer Tooling: Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing.  
CI/CD & DevOps: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation.  
Evaluation & Debugging: Practical knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions.  
Client Collaboration: Strong technical communication, consulting acumen, and client-facing collaboration skills within an Agile environment.

Good-to have skills

Experience with inter-agent communication protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures.  
Experience integrating agents with Enterprise Knowledge Graphs, structured ontologies, and hybrid vector search systems.  
Experience with enterprise data security frameworks such as Sensitive Data Protection (SDP/DLP) and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC).

Certifications and Trainings  
Professional Machine Learning Engineer  
Google Skill Boost labs/course  
Introduction to Gemini Enterprise : https://partner.skills.google/course\_templates/1401  
Gemini Enterprise and NotebookLM : https://partner.skills.google/paths/3667  
Getting started with ADK: https://www.skills.google/catalog\_lab/32017  
Deployment: https://www.skills.google/catalog\_lab/32530  
Build and deploy multi agent: https://www.skills.google/course\_templates/1445

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

DevOps - GCP,Python,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),Model Context Protocol (MCP),Agent Orchestration Frameworks,Google Gemini

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Qualifications and Prior Experience  
8+ years of experience in software development, cloud solution architecture, and AI engineering (preferably on Google Cloud Platform).  
Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying production AI agents or enterprise GenAI solutions using ADK, Vertex AI, or Gemini.  
Hands-on experience in customer-facing technical delivery, solutions engineering, or forward-deployed engineering (FDE) roles.  
Familiarity with enterprise Agile development lifecycles, sprint delivery, and stakeholder management

aa2b8740.description:

Tarento is a fast-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose.

**Role: Solution Architecture - Retail & Supply Chain**

**Location**: Bangalore

You will be the solution architect embedded with a global retail client's Integrated Planning team. You'll own the end-to-end architecture for supply chain and inventory initiatives across regions. The role sits between business stakeholders, client architects and delivery teams: you turn complex business problems into robust, scalable designs with practical short-term fixes and long-term target-state solutions.

* + Understand business and operational problems across supply chain, inventory and fulfilment, and translate them into clear architecture solutions.
  + Create and present High-Level Designs (HLDs) covering systems, integration flows, data flows and interfaces, and take them through review and sign-off with client architects and stakeholders.

  + Define both interim solutions and long-term target architecture, with trade-offs, risks and dependencies clearly documented.
  + Work with business, product, delivery and regional teams across Europe, the Americas and APAC to keep architecture aligned with programme timelines and release plans.
  + Support delivery teams through build, testing and rollout by clarifying design intent, resolving integration issues and governing changes.
  + Spot opportunities to apply AI and new technology to the client's business problems, and shape them into proposals.

**Must-have skills**

* + 8+ years in IT, with 4+ years in solution or integration architecture roles.
  + Strong grounding in retail or supply chain domains: inventory, order management, distribution and fulfilment.
  + Hands-on experience with integration patterns (APIs, event-driven/messaging, batch and file-based) and enterprise systems (ERP, OMS, POS, WMS).
  + Proven ability to write clear, sign-off-ready HLDs and present them to senior technical and business audiences.
  + Working knowledge of cloud platforms and data platforms or data lakes.
  + Excellent stakeholder management and communication across geographies.

**Good to have**

* + Experience with Microsoft Dynamics/AX or similar retail ERP landscapes.
  + Exposure to AI/ML use cases in retail or supply chain.
  + Presales or consulting background (proposals, estimations, client pitches).
  + Architecture certification (TOGAF, Azure or AWS Solutions Architect).

**What success looks like**

* + HLDs delivered on time and signed off with minimal rework.
  + Smooth releases with no architecture-driven delays.
  + High client satisfaction and trust from client architects and business leads.

5e333006.title: Solution Architect
5e333006.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
  
  
**The opportunity**
At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
  
  
**We Are Proud Of**

* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

**The role**
As a
**[Solution Architect]**
, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
**12+ YEARS]**
of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are**

* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

**Role Responsibilities**
The architect should be able to understand complex business and technical requirements, evaluate trade-offs, propose multiple viable solution approaches, and clearly articulate the recommended architecture.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration with clients, engineering teams, technical leads, and other architects throughout solution definition and delivery
  
  
**Must Have Qualifications**
To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:
  
  
**Architecture & System Design**
Strong hands-on experience in solution architecture, software architecture, and system design.
  
  
Ability to translate business and functional requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
  
  
Ability to propose multiple solution options, assess trade-offs, and recommend an appropriate approach.
  
  
Strong understanding of architecture and design principles, patterns, and best practices, including SOLID, separation of concerns, domain-driven design concepts, event-driven architecture, and distributed system patterns.
  
  
Good understanding of microservices, APIs, integration patterns, data flows, security, scalability, resiliency, performance, and availability.
  
  
Well versed with technologies including Java/JEE, .Microsoft .Net technologies
  
  
Good understanding of cloud architecture and services, preferably Microsoft Azure /AWS/, or Google Cloud.
  
  
Understanding of cloud-native architecture, containers, serverless technologies, managed services, and cloud integration patterns.
  
  
Ability to make appropriate architectural decisions rather than applying patterns or technologies by default.
  
  
**Architecture Documentation & Modelling**
Strong ability to create clear architecture descriptions and design documentation.
  
  
Experience representing architecture using established approaches such as C4 Model and 4+1 Architectural View Model.
  
  
Ability to produce and review context, container, component, deployment, integration, and sequence views as appropriate.
  
  
Ability to document key architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, constraints, and trade-offs.
  
  
Technical Leadership
  
  
Ability to review and guide architecture spikes and Proof of Concepts (POCs) to validate important architectural decisions.
  
  
Ability to review solution designs and provide practical architectural guidance to development teams.
  
  
Ability to guide engineering teams working in Agile/Scrum environments while maintaining architectural consistency.
  
  
Comfortable working with architects, technical leads, developers, product teams, and other engineering stakeholders.
  
  
**Stakeholder & Communication Skills**
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear and practical language.
  
  
Ability to present and defend solution approaches with client and senior technical stakeholders.
  
  
Comfortable leading architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical workshops.
  
  
Ability to communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Nice To Have Qualifications**
**Modern Technologies**
Awareness of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, AI-assisted development, and AI integration patterns.
  
  
Understanding of where AI is appropriate within an enterprise solution and where deterministic approaches are preferable.
  
  
**Delivery & Organizational Contribution**
Experience supporting pre-sales, solution proposals, technical estimations, RFPs/RFIs, and client presentations.
  
  
Ability to contribute to solution approach, architecture, assumptions, risks, and technical effort during proposal stages.
  
  
Experience participating in technical interviews and architecture assessments.
  
  
Ability to mentor junior architects, technical leads, and senior engineers and help improve architecture practices across teams.
  
  
**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
  
  
**The Benefits**
This is a
**fulltime**
position based in
**Bengaluru**
.
  
  
**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer**

* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.
  
  
**Your application process**
Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.
  
  
⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in
**@valtech.com**
.
  
  
We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.
  
  
**About Valtech**
Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
  
  
At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.
  
  
At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.
  
  
Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

a734fad2.title: Solution Architect
a734fad2.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
  
  
  
  
**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  
  
  
Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
  
  
  
  
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.

FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.
* During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.
* In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.

**Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:**

* Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.
* Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.
* AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI-enabled solutions.
* Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Training and Support: Provide training to customers’ support agents, administrators, and relevant teams, ensuring the proficient use of Freshworks products during deployments.
* Issue Resolution: Liaise with the Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges and implementation issues related to Freshworks products.
* Integrations Design: Create and integrate Freshworks products with other systems and third-party applications to streamline 3rd-party integrations and facilitate data flow.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and architectural documentation, covering system configurations, integrations, and customizations.
* Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, Freshworks product updates, and best practices to continually enhance the capabilities of the customer support ecosystem.

**What success in this role looks like:**

Success in this role means opportunities are accurately scoped, proposed solutions are technically feasible and supportable, delivery teams receive clear and actionable designs, architecture decisions are made quickly, risks are surfaced early, and customers have confidence in you and that the solution will meet their intended business outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional experience in ITSM, ESM, ITOM, ITAM
* Strong technical background with custom script development and presales experience
* Ability to read complex situations with several competing constraints and identify solutions that benefit both the customers and Freshworks
* Excellent listening and presentation skills
* 5+ years working directly with Functional and organizational leaders internally and externally
* Proficient in handling ambiguity and objections
* Skilled in negotiation and objection handling
* Experience with guiding customers in organization change management (OCM) to improve technology adoption is highly desirable.
* Experience navigating difficult technical decisions and communicating tradeoffs to executives, architects, administrators, and delivery teams.

**Required skills:**

* 7+ years of Professional Services experience in software industry in SaaS platforms
* Previous roles in Solution Architect or Domain Architect within ITIL oriented / ITSM systems are advantageous
* A problem-solving innovator with a knack for thinking outside the box
* Proficient at creating architecture diagrams, process maps, data-flow diagrams, and clear design documentation.
* Extensive expertise in Enterprise landscapes across various domains, including ERP systems, Accounting Systems, HRMS, IDAM, and more
* Demonstrated experience in designing customer experience process flows
* Strong understanding of the Cloud Stack and SaaS products
* Proficiency in developing custom apps and REST API-based integrations
* Preferred, though not mandatory, background in Javascript and NodeJS

**Preferred skills:**

* ITIL Certification
* Knowledge of Project Management principals

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

Oracle SCM Cloud Techno-Functional Consultant

- - - - - - - - - - - -

**Role Overview (Order management | Inventory | Pricing | Integrations)**
=========================================================================

We are looking for an experienced Oracle SCM Cloud Techno-Functional Consultant to support the design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization of Oracle SCM Cloud solutions.

The role requires a strong combination of Oracle SCM functional expertise and hands-on technical/integration capabilities, with particular emphasis on Order Management, Order Promising, Inventory Management, Pricing, Shipping, and end-to-end fulfillment processes.

The ideal candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into scalable Oracle Cloud solutions while working closely with business, architecture, integration, and development teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Oracle SCM Cloud Functional Design**
--------------------------------------

* Design, configure, and support Oracle SCM Cloud solutions across:

* Order Management Cloud

* Order Promising

* Inventory Management

* Procurement Cloud

* Advanced Pricing

* Configure and support item masters, organization structures, sourcing rules, shipment methods, picking and shipping rules, and fulfillment models.

* Translate business requirements and solution architecture into robust Oracle SCM Cloud functional and integration specifications.

* Design and support Order Management orchestration and fulfillment processes across transition-state and target-state architectures.

* Design and support credit-check processes and associated SCM/ERP integration points.

* Analyze complex Order-to-Ship scenarios and recommend appropriate Oracle Cloud configurations and integration approaches.

**Technical & Integration Responsibilities**
--------------------------------------------

* Design, develop, and support integrations using:

* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)

* REST APIs

* SOAP Web Services

* FBDI

* Design and troubleshoot integrations between Oracle SCM and:

* External Planning systems

* External Pricing solutions

* External WMS platforms

* Multiple Order Capture channels

* Oracle ERP Cloud

* Analyze and troubleshoot integration payloads, mappings, transaction failures, interface errors, and diagnostic logs across application boundaries.

* Work closely with integration and development teams to resolve functional and technical defects.

* Support Azure Microservices and PostgreSQL-based integration components, where applicable.

* Participate in end-to-end integration testing, deployment, production stabilization, and defect resolution.

**Required Skills & Experience**
================================

* 10+ years of hands-on Oracle application implementation and solution-design experience, with strong exposure to Oracle SCM and ERP processes.

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle SCM Cloud, particularly Order Management, Order Promising, Inventory Management, Pricing, Shipping, and Fulfillment.

* Experience with at least one full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud implementation involving complex SCM and ERP integrations.

* Experience transitioning supply-chain capabilities from legacy applications and/or Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) to Oracle Cloud.

* Strong understanding of Oracle Cloud integration technologies, including OIC, REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, and FBDI.

* Hands-on ability to investigate REST/SOAP payloads, interface mappings, transaction errors, integration failures, and diagnostic logs.

* Strong understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Ship / Order-to-Cash business processes.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving skills.

* Ability to translate business requirements into both functional designs and technical integration requirements.

* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across business, functional, technical, integration, and architecture teams.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**
===================================

* SCM-to-Financials integration knowledge, including Cost Accounting and Subledger Accounting (SLA).

* Familiarity with Azure Microservices and PostgreSQL.

* Experience implementing Oracle SCM Cloud/EBS within a best-of-breed architecture, where planning, pricing, WMS, order capture, and other capabilities are distributed across multiple enterprise applications.

* Experience with complex enterprise integration landscapes involving Oracle Cloud, Oracle EBS, external applications, and middleware platforms.

957c483d.title: Senior Client Delivery Manager
957c483d.company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
957c483d.description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

**Your role at a glance**

The role Senior Client Delivery Manager is a senior role, responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of managed services contract to the client. This role supports the business and protects the company’s reputation by taking responsibility for contract management for local, medium to large complexity contracts. This role works closely with cross functional teams to ensure client expectations are met and exceeded and takes responsibility for service delivery, and contract profitability for their assigned client contracts. These clients require service delivery that are complex to highly complex and bespoke by nature and are typically across multiple sites and/or service offerings.

**What we are looking for**

**Main tasks:**
===============

* Responsible for client satisfaction by ensuring that services are delivered according to agreed service definitions and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Acts as the primary point of contact for client inquiries, escalations, and feedback
* Understands client business needs and objectives to tailor required services accordingly
* Ensures the successful delivery of managed services to clients, meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards
* Collaborates with technical teams to resolve client issues and incidents promptly
* Monitors and assesses client satisfaction regularly through feedback mechanisms
* Takes proactive measures to address client concerns and continuously improve service quality
* Develops account plans and strategies to enhance client engagement and retention
* Identifies opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services
* Manages the implementation of new services, upgrades, and projects for clients
* Coordinates project timelines, resources, and deliverables to ensure successful outcomes
* Ensures that service delivery aligns with contractual agreements and compliance requirements
* Consults with legal team to ensure that all contract escalations are addressed with contract governance
* Monitors and reports on contract performance
* May oversee financial aspects of client accounts, including budgeting and forecasting
* May manage billing and invoicing processes
* Collaborates with technical teams to ensure that client environments are stable, secure, and up-to-date
* Stays informed about industry trends and emerging technologies to provide informed recommendations to clients
* Identifies and mitigates risks associated with service delivery and client relationships
* Develops contingency plans for potential disruptions
* Maintains accurate records, client documentation, and incident reports
* Provides regular reports on service performance and client satisfaction to internal and external stakeholders

**Requirements:**

**Professional skills**

* University degree or equivalent, preferably economics/engineering/computer science or comparable professional experience or related (or equivalent work experience)
* Advanced demonstrated experience in successful delivery of managed services to clients, meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards, with contractual agreements and compliance requirements as well as monitoring contract performance
* 5 + years managing Hyperscale client deliveries
* ITIL certification
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP) is preferred
* Passionate about service delivery with a strong ability to manage a coordinated delivery of service
* Extensive / Strong understanding of respective industry, e.g. Data Center delivery, Cx ing, Fit-Out, connectivity infrastructure
* Business acumen, as well as financial acumen for budgeting, forecasting, and billing
* Familiarity with ITIL or other IT service management frameworks
* High level of competence in dealing with internal and external stakeholders
* Strong competencies in project planning, management and organization
* Applies advanced wide-ranging experience and in-depth professional knowledge to develop and resolve complex models and procedures in creative ways
* Directs the application of existing principles and guides development of new policies and ideas
* Determines own methods and procedures on new assignments

**Soft skills**

* Highly analytical mindset, strong initiative, self-driven with a commitment to succeed
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent client centricity, proven ability to manage client relationships and drive client satisfaction
* Adaptability and a customer-focused mindset
* Ability to work under pressure and has exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
* Independent, structured and conceptual work

**Who we are**

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.
