244a53ec.title: Delivery Lead (Suite)
244a53ec.description:
TITLE
  
  
Delivery Lead
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Delivery Lead is responsible for leading teams to deliver project(s) for clients, and manages schedules, financials, and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery. The Delivery Lead identifies and addresses potential issues and risks that may impact project deliverables, and serves as the point of escalation for project related activities, and is the escalation point for the Customer. The role may be expected to work across multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Responsible for leading teams to deliver project(s) for clients,
* Manages the day-to-day project activities and deliverables, including schedules, financials, and project change requests
* Provides on-site leadership for project team by building and motivating team members to meet project goals, adhering to their responsibilities and project milestones
* Identifies and develops trusted adviser relationship with project and program stakeholders, sponsors and university stakeholders
* Serves as the point of escalation for project related activities, and for the Customer
* Reports on project results, metrics, test and deployment management activities
* Prepares estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project
* Provides status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership
* Understands interdependencies between technology, operations and business needs
* Manages project scope and changes
* Supports formal/informal schedules to manage the engagement contract
* Assists management in defining the Statement of Work
* Sets and continually manages project and program expectations while delegating and managing deliverable with team members and stakeholders
* Develops and delivers progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation and presentations to various audiences, including project team, sponsors, CIO and key stakeholders
* Mentors project team members
* May work across multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Performs other related duties and activities as required
* Leads governance and AI-enabled initiatives across project lifecycle in multiple complex projects
* Experience in using approved AI tools, Co-pilots, agents and automations to improve project planning, scheduling, status reporting, risk sensing, forecasting, resource optimization, requirements analysis and decision support.
* Evaluates whether a business or delivery need is best addressed through AI, conventional automation or process improvement by assessing business value, feasibility, risk and adoption requirements.
* Establishes baselines and measures AI-enabled delivery outcomes, including cycle-time reduction, productivity, forecast accuracy, quality, adoption, risk reduction and business value.
* Applies responsible AI practices covering privacy, security, intellectual property, explainability, auditability, human accountability and approved-tool usage.

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher or equivalent additional years of experience; applicable functional experience in the discipline or a closely related function.
* Practical experience in Services Project Management or a closely related function.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work of moderate to high complexity in a global software, SaaS, technology, insurance technology, or comparable business environment.
* Experience working independently with limited day-to-day instruction and collaborating across teams is required

**Preferred Education And Experience**

* Advanced degree, professional certification, or specialized training relevant to Services Project Management.
* Experience improving processes, tools, reporting, controls, or operating practices within the function.
* Experience partnering with distributed teams and stakeholders across regions, business units, or functional areas

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Applied knowledge of Services Project Management practices, processes, tools, and operating standards.
* Sound analytical judgment and structured problem-solving capability.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, and deliver work against agreed timelines.
* Clear written and verbal communication for technical and business audiences.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work products.
* Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and convert findings into action.
* Process improvement mindset with practical change management awareness.
* Understanding of governance, risk, controls, and policy compliance.
* Customer, partner, or internal service orientation appropriate to the function.
* Adaptability in a dynamic global software company environment.
* Ownership mindset, accountability, and reliable follow-through.
* Professional discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
* Ability to learn new systems, tools, methods, and business processes quickly.
* Inclusive behaviors that support collaboration, trust, and constructive feedback.
* Practical AI literacy as relevant to project delivery and management.
* Hands-on experience with approved AI-enabled project-management tools
* Experience governing AI-enabled delivery across a portfolio or multiple complex projects, including value
* prioritization, responsible-AI controls, adoption metrics and executive reporting.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals.
  
  
We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment.
  
  
We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

72427911.title: Technical Delivery Manager
72427911.description:
Role Overview

N2P Systems is looking for an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the execution and successful delivery of enterprise technology projects and software development initiatives. The position involves overseeing the complete delivery lifecycle, including project planning, scheduling, budget oversight, resource coordination, risk management, and stakeholder alignment. The successful candidate will ensure projects achieve their agreed objectives within established timelines and quality expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Take ownership of enterprise technology projects and software development initiatives throughout their delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and resource allocation strategies.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising developers, architects, QA engineers, DevOps professionals, and business stakeholders.
* Track project execution, identify potential delivery challenges, and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Oversee project scope, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, technical dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Establish delivery governance frameworks, reporting processes, and performance measurement mechanisms.
* Provide regular updates on delivery progress, risks, issues, and escalations to senior management and stakeholders.
* Ensure project execution follows established software development lifecycle practices and relevant delivery methodologies.
* Facilitate Agile and Scrum ceremonies and support continuous improvement initiatives where applicable.
* Collaborate with technical architects and engineering leads to address technical dependencies and delivery challenges.
* Ensure completed deliverables meet agreed quality standards and business requirements.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment and manage expectations through effective communication and coordination.

What We Are Looking For

* 10+ years of experience in IT project delivery, technology programme management, or software delivery management.
* Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end technology project delivery.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Practical experience managing project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and dependencies.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional technology teams.
* Strong stakeholder and client management capabilities.
* Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and traditional project management methodologies.
* Familiarity with project management platforms such as Jira, Microsoft Project, or equivalent tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred & Bonus Experience

* Experience delivering large-scale enterprise technology programmes.
* Exposure to cloud transformation, application modernization, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or equivalent project management credentials.
* Experience managing geographically distributed development teams.

958d2a59.description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**Job Title:**
**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location: ETAP-Delhi**
**Employment Type:**
[ull-time
  
  
**The job**
We are looking for a Service Delivery Manager with deep expertise in utility operations, responsible for end-to-end delivery of RDSS/ADMS projects.
  
  
This role provides sole accountability for project delivery, technical compliance, and client/vendor interface. The Service Delivery Manager will coordinate with the Engineering Manager and engineering teams but remain the single point of ownership for delivery quality, schedule adherence, and technical compliance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical knowledge of power distribution, grid automation, and SCADA/ADMS systems with strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery & Compliance**

* Full ownership of end-to-end delivery for RDSS/ADMS projects in utility/grid environments.
* Ensure strict adherence to:

+ Client-specific technical specifications
+ Distribution system automation standards and grid codes
+ Engineering drawings, SLDs, protection schemes, and compliance documents
+ Contractual obligations and quality standards

* Review and validate engineering deliverables including:

+ SCADA/ADMS system architecture, configurations, and network diagrams
+ ETAP / power flow / short-circuit / protection coordination studies
+ Communication network designs, telemetry integration, and automation logic
+ Technical reports, FAT/SAT documentation, and compliance certificates

* Identify risks, deviations, or non-compliances and drive corrective/preventive actions.

**Client & Vendor Interface**

* Act as primary client and vendor-facing technical lead for project delivery.
* Lead technical review meetings, progress discussions, compliance audits, and design clarifications.
* Manage client escalations, change requests, and technical queries efficiently.
* Represent the organization in FAT/SAT, compliance audits, and project acceptance reviews.

**Engineering Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with the Engineering Manager and internal teams to ensure:

+ Engineering execution aligns with project schedules, compliance, and quality standards
+ Clear technical expectations are communicated and delivered by engineering teams

* Track engineering progress against milestones and ensure timely availability of all deliverables.

**Project Planning, Reporting & Governance**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, and milestone trackers.
* Monitor project health across scope, schedule, quality, and risk dimensions.
* Prepare and present structured project status reports to clients and senior internal management.
* Maintain complete technical documentation, including:

+ Compliance matrices
+ Risk and issue registers
+ Meeting minutes and action trackers
+ Final handover documentation

Ensure adherence to internal delivery frameworks, quality systems, and audit requirements.
  
  
**Essential Requirements**

* Strong domain knowledge in utility/grid operations, distribution automation, RDSS, ADMS, SCADA, and smart grid technologies.
* Hands-on experience with ETAP, power system studies, protection coordination, and distribution network modeling.
* Ability to interpret and validate:

+ Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
+ Protection schemes and relay coordination
+ Telemetry and SCADA/ADMS configurations
+ Compliance with grid codes and utility standards

* Familiarity with power system automation, smart grid communication networks, and data analytics integration.

Proficiency in project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet) and reporting tools
  
  
**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical / Power / Automation / Instrumentation Engineering. Master’s degree preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in utility or grid operations projects, with focus on RDSS/ADMS or SCADA/Automation projects.
* Proven track record as single-point delivery owner for technically complex, client-facing projects.

*I*

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**

1c23f568.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or technical operations.
* Demonstrated experience building, working with, and deploying AI agents and LLM-based technologies (e.g., ADK, Jetski, etc.).
* Experience managing tooling security, access controls, and governance (including WTPs, MDB groups, and access management platforms).
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing relationships across Engineering, Operations, and global Program Management teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Geo Data Operations (GDO) Tools team is focused on building the next generation of operational tooling to scale Google Maps and Geo data production. We are looking for a highly technical, AI-forward Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive our transition toward machine-led operations and agentic workflows, while ensuring our systems maintain the highest standards of security and access governance.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of AI innovation, security, and operational excellence. You will not only manage complex, cross-functional programs but will also be technically in designing and implementing AI agents to solve operational pain points. Additionally, you will own critical aspects of our tooling security, ensuring that access controls, and automation, and data governance scale securely alongside our AI investments.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with the global Program Manager (PgM) team to develop and deliver AI Automation projects from conception to implementation, and seamlessly manage relationships across engineering and operations.
* Be direct with AI technologies (including Jetski, ADK, Gemini, and custom agents) to actively build solutions that solve complex operational pain points and automate manual workflows.
* Lead tooling security initiatives, bringing a deep understanding of access governance, including the management, auditing, and implementation of Workflow Team Policies (WTPs) and MDB groups.
* Act as the connective tissue between Operations, global PgMs, and Engineering. Translate operational bottlenecks into technical requirements and agentic workflows.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

bd3e7c3c.title: Senior Product Program Manager
bd3e7c3c.description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.

  

The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high-quality security solutions on time and within budget.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high-impact initiatives.
* Executive & Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.
* Mentorship & Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company.
* Lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.
* Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution.
* Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI & Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
Drive data-driven insights by leveraging AI-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive-level decision-making with real-time program intelligence.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 10-15 years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large-scale software deployments
* 10-15 years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 6 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi-disciplinary teams.
Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.  

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and providing reasonable accommodations, appropriate support throughout the hiring process and employment, in accordance with applicable local laws. If you require support or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact recruiting@arcticwolf.com .

**On Camera Policy**
====================

* To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.
* Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.
We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

1172700a.title: Senior Program Manager
1172700a.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

HCLTech is looking for an Engineering Mindset Leader to drive Application Development and Transformation-led delivery for the BBC account. This role owns engineering culture, technical governance, and delivery quality across digital platform and modernization workstreams — acting as the senior technical anchor between HCLTech's delivery teams and BBC's technology and product leadership, and ensuring every release reflects a genuine engineering-first mindset rather than a project-completion mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Engineering Mindset & Culture**

* Champion a quality-first, automation-first engineering culture across all AD/Transformation pods on the account.
* Institutionalize clean-code, secure-coding, and rigorous peer-review practices across delivery teams.
* Drive DevSecOps adoption — CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and shift-left security.
* Instill engineering discipline around scale, resilience, and accessibility, given the BBC's public-service scrutiny and traffic spikes during major events.

**Delivery Leadership & Technical Governance**

* Own end-to-end technical delivery for BBC's AD/Transformation workstreams, ensuring on-time, high-quality releases.
* Set up and run architecture governance — design reviews, coding standards, and non-functional requirement sign-off.
* Drive the modernization roadmap — legacy monolith to microservices, cloud-native, API-first architectures.
* Own technical risk, dependency, and technical-debt management across the delivery portfolio.
* Track and report engineering health metrics (velocity, defect leakage, deployment frequency, MTTR) to account and client leadership.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as the primary engineering counterpart to BBC's technology and product leadership.
* Translate BBC's digital transformation goals into actionable engineering roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Represent HCLTech in technical governance forums, steering committees, and architecture councils.
* Build the trusted-advisor relationships that grow HCLTech's engineering footprint within the account.
* Lead delivery from an offshore location, ensuring seamless collaboration with onshore/client stakeholders through structured governance, overlap hours, and communication cadences.

**Team Building, Coaching & Talent**

* Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing engineering team spanning developers, architects, QE, and DevOps.
* Define skilling plans and technical career paths aligned to the BBC account's technology direction.
* Foster ownership, continuous learning, and engineering craftsmanship across the pods.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of platform engineering, observability, and GenAI-assisted SDLC practices.
* Lead pilots for tooling, automation, and modernization accelerators relevant to media/broadcast platforms.
* Contribute learnings back into HCLTech's engineering Centre of Excellence.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Required Skills & Experience**
================================

* 16–20 years in IT with substantial experience in Application Development / Digital Transformation delivery.
* Proven track record leading engineering teams of 20+ engineers in a services or product delivery environment.
* Strong hands-on engineering background (full-stack/backend) — Java, .NET, or Node.js ecosystems.
* Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Strong command of DevSecOps practices — CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), automated testing, and observability.
* Demonstrated experience driving legacy modernization or platform transformation programs at scale.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including direct experience working with UK-based client leadership.
* Solid grounding in Agile/Scaled Agile delivery models.
* Proven track record successfully leading offshore delivery pods for global/onshore clients, with strong asynchronous communication and governance discipline.

**Preferred / Good to Have**
============================

* Prior experience in media, broadcast, streaming, or high-traffic consumer digital platforms.
* Familiarity with content management systems, personalization engines, or streaming/video platforms.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and public-sector-grade compliance requirements.
* Relevant certifications — cloud architect (AWS/Azure), TOGAF, SAFe, or equivalent.
* Exposure to AI/ML-assisted engineering productivity tools.
* Experience in a global delivery / GCC (Global Capability Center) model, with prior offshore leadership for UK/EU/global clients.

50af700e.title: Technical Program Manager- Cybersecurity
50af700e.description:
Technical Program Manager, Security

*Security organization | Program delivery, technical governance, stakeholder leadership*

Role Overview

The Technical Program Manager is responsible for driving complex security programs from planning through implementation, adoption and steady state. This role sits at the intersection of technology, security, business stakeholders and change management. The TPM does not need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but must be technical enough to understand architecture and implementation tradeoffs, challenge weak assumptions, identify delivery and security risks, and keep engineering and business stakeholders moving toward the intended outcome.

What makes this role different

* This is not a queue-management, project-coordinator or template-driven role. The TPM is expected to operate independently, understand the objective behind program, and create the structure needed to deliver it.
* The role requires enough technical depth to engage credibly with security engineers, architects, infrastructure teams and system owners, while maintaining a broader view of business impact, operational risk, communications and change adoption.
* The TPM is expected to respectfully challenge assumptions, surface issues that are being avoided, and call out when a proposed approach is unlikely to meet the intended security or business outcome.
* Success is measured by outcomes and sustained adoption, not simply by whether tasks were completed or a project plan was updated.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead cross-functional security programs from initiation through implementation, stabilization and transition to steady-state ownership.
* Build and maintain the program strategy, roadmap, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and integrated delivery plan.
* Translate security objectives into executable work across engineering, architecture, infrastructure, IAM, operations, compliance, risk and business teams.
* Facilitate working sessions that drive decisions rather than simply document discussions; clearly identify owners, dates and next actions.
* Assess technical implementation approaches and challenge designs, assumptions, sequencing or estimates when they create unacceptable delivery or security risk.
* Identify implementation risks across technology, people, process, communications, operational readiness and change management.
* Develop executive-ready reporting that communicates progress, key risks, decisions needed, tradeoffs and overall program health.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across groups with different priorities and influence without relying solely on formal authority.

* Drive change management and adoption activities so that new controls, technologies or processes become operationally effective, not simply implemented.
* Establish clear readiness criteria for implementation, production launch, handoff and sustained operation.
* Track program outcomes after implementation and drive remediation when the delivered solution is not achieving the intended result.
* Maintain strong program hygiene across RAID logs, decision logs, governance forums, action tracking and executive communications.

Required Experience and Capabilities

* 15+ years of technical program management, technology delivery, security program management or closely related experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading at least two complex technology or security implementations from planning through deployment and stabilization.
* Working knowledge of enterprise technology and security concepts, with enough technical depth to understand architecture, integrations, dependencies, operational constraints and implementation tradeoffs.
* Strong experience coordinating engineers, architects, infrastructure teams, security teams and business stakeholders through complex delivery efforts.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and move decisions forward when stakeholders disagree or priorities conflict.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor a message from engineer-level working sessions to executive-level updates.
* Experience with risk management, change management, operational readiness and organizational adoption as part of technology implementation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish symptoms from root causes and identify when a program is heading off track.

64c7948c.title: Technical Program Manager, GDO Tooling
64c7948c.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or technical operations.
* Demonstrated experience building, working with, and deploying AI agents and LLM-based technologies (e.g., ADK, Jetski, etc.).
* Experience managing tooling security, access controls, and governance (including WTPs, MDB groups, and access management platforms).
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing relationships across Engineering, Operations, and global Program Management teams.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Geo Data Operations (GDO) Tools team is focused on building the next generation of operational tooling to scale Google Maps and Geo data production. We are looking for a highly technical, AI-forward Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive our transition toward machine-led operations and agentic workflows, while ensuring our systems maintain the highest standards of security and access governance.
  
  
In this role, you will sit at the intersection of AI innovation, security, and operational excellence. You will not only manage complex, cross-functional programs but will also be technically in designing and implementing AI agents to solve operational pain points. Additionally, you will own critical aspects of our tooling security, ensuring that access controls, and automation, and data governance scale securely alongside our AI investments.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the global Program Manager (PgM) team to develop and deliver AI Automation projects from conception to implementation, and seamlessly manage relationships across engineering and operations.
* Be direct with AI technologies (including Jetski, ADK, Gemini, and custom agents) to actively build solutions that solve complex operational pain points and automate manual workflows.
* Lead tooling security initiatives, bringing a deep understanding of access governance, including the management, auditing, and implementation of Workflow Team Policies (WTPs) and MDB groups.
* Act as the connective tissue between Operations, global PgMs, and Engineering. Translate operational bottlenecks into technical requirements and agentic workflows.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

12c31cbb.title: Senior Program Manager
12c31cbb.description:
**About the role**

Refyne helps India's workforce access the salary they have already earned. The PMO team is where that promise is kept. We own the client integrations that connect employers' payroll systems to our platform, the delivery cadence of our product and engineering PODs, the programs that run across departments, and the response when something breaks in production.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager who can hold all of it: a portfolio of client integrations, owning the scrum cadence for more than one team, managing programs that span departments, and the incident process behind both the platform and its integrations.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client integrations -**
You sit with the client's HR, payroll and IT teams, work out how their system should talk to ours, write the specification and drive the build with engineering through UAT and cutover. After go-live it stays yours.

* Scope and solution new integrations across APIs, SFTP and file-based exchanges, and write the technical integration document the client builds from.
* Own client configuration end to end: eligibility rules, limits, and translating business logic into technical implementation.
* Monitor integrations in production, triage failures and downtime, conduct RCA and escalate with a clear read on client impact.

**Act as client's technical counterpart -**
Solution calls, demos, business rule questions, infosec questionnaires, due diligence reviews. You are the person on our side who answers without a handoff.

* Act as the primary contact for client technical and project stakeholders through the integration lifecycle.
* Run demos and user journey walkthroughs for stakeholders.
* Collate and close out integration-related infosec and due diligence questionnaires with our security and compliance teams.

**Program planning and tracking-**
Much of what you own cuts across product, engineering, operations, risk and business teams, and leadership is watching the dates.

* Build the plan: scope, milestones, dependencies, owners and a critical path that holds up.
* Track delivery across departments, chase the dependencies nobody has claimed, and hold one honest view of status, risks and blockers.
* Give leadership the overview they need through weekly delivery reporting, program dashboards and the PMO section of the monthly business metrics report.

**Scrum and delivery cadence -**
You run the cadence for several product and engineering PODs and keep them moving.

* Run planning, grooming, standups, retrospectives and release coordination across your PODs.
* Co-ordinate with product and engineering to break requirements into epics and stories with acceptance criteria that hold up, and keep the backlog healthy.
* Clear blockers, protect the sprint from mid-flight scope, and keep velocity and release readiness visible in Jira.

**Incident management -**
When something breaks in production, you run the response and the follow-through.

* Run the incident process end to end: detection, triage, the severity call, bridge coordination and client communication while it is still live.
* Monitor integration and platform health — API failures, sync breaks, downtime — and escalate with a clear read on employee and client impact.
* Close the loop with root cause analysis, preventive actions, and the service and escalation workflows that stop a repeat.

**Documentation and governance -**
Author and maintain the Client Integration Wiki for every client, to our standard template.

* Own the SOPs that govern how configurations are raised, reviewed and changed.
* Mentor juniors and interns, delegating real initiatives with clear ownership and checkpoints.

**Requirements**

* **6-10 years**
  in program and project management, implementation or technical account management, with at least 3 years running client-facing technical delivery.
* **Programs you have run end to end.**
  Planning, dependencies, stakeholders across several functions, leadership reporting, and the hard conversations about timelines.
* **Scrum mastery in practice, not theory.**
  You have run the cadence for more than one team at a time and kept the backlog, the velocity and the release train honest, in Jira or its equivalent.
* **Integrations you have personally shipped.**
  You have written the specification, worked it through with engineering, run the testing and seen a cutover through.
* **Technical fluency.**
  A working understanding of system design, the software development lifecycle, and how a release moves from requirement to production. On the integration side: REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, SFTP and file-based exchanges. You can read an API contract, question a data model and spot what will break in production.
* **Incident experience.**
  You have owned a production issue from detection to resolution, managed the client through it, and written the root cause analysis afterwards.
* **Writing that holds up.**
  You turn a messy requirements call into a document a client's engineer can build from, and an auditor can read a year later.
* **Stakeholder management.**
  You can explain a production issue, push back on a timeline and keep the room calm.
* A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or the equivalent in practice.

**Good to have**

* A project or agile certification such as PMP, CSM, PSM or SAFe.
* Fintech, lending experience.
* ITIL-aligned incident and problem management, and experience standing up a service desk such as Jira Service Management.
* Well versed in using AI to take the grind out of routine and repetitive tasks.

850cdd9a.title: Applied AI Architect ( Global Customers)
850cdd9a.description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**For roles performing work in California:**
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

**Are you a highly motivated, creative individual and passionate about sales and proposals?**
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
**Join our team!**
Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Partner with the best**
To Prepare proposals/bids, contract negotiation and compliance with contract commitments and commercial risk assessment. Leads the development of business plans for a specific product or product line.
  
  
As an
**Integrated Solutions Commercial Advisor ,**
you will also be responsible for:
  
  
  

* Leading all elements of I&S Opportunities through the I&S Process, ensuring all Stage and Decision Gate deliverables are met.
* Leading the opportunity pursuit, engaging and aligning all stakeholders such as Region Leadership, Commercial Operations, I&S leadership, Product Line teams, technical focal points, contracted party focal points, and Baker Hughes support functions to build a winning strategy for proposals or bids.
* Ensuring company processes and procedures are strictly followed, including OFSE Sales and Commercial principles and in particular, I&S Management System content and tools are applied to every Opportunity.
* Contributing to the development and adherence of I&S processes to ensure that project risks are correctly documented, evaluated and mitigated through use of I&S Risk Management Process and tools.
* Drafting the initial Project Plan and all parts thereof, ie Risk Management Plan, Communications Plan, Sourcing Plan, Vendor Management Plan, early Schedule, Quality Plan, Stakeholder Matrix, Project roles & responsibility matrix (RACI), Organizational Structure, and construction of the I&S Cost Model.
* Ensuring commercial models accurately reflect the most likely return on investment and profitability of Baker Hughes by working closely with various internal stakeholders.
* Providing leadership for negotiations with customers, contracted parties, vendors and other relevant parties.
* Performing contract handover through the use of the Service Level Agreement “SLA” component of the Baker Hughes OFSE Commercial and Operational Framework Agreement such as Commercial Operations Framework Agreement “COFA” during Project Mobilization stage to the Project Manager and I&S support teams responsible for the Project through execution stages.

**Fuel your passion!**

* Have a bachelor's degree in engineering, commercial or scientific discipline. Have 12+ years of relevant oil & gas operator or service company experience.
* Have experience leading Integrated Commercial bids
* Have 3+ years of experience in Integrated Projects.
* Have strong understanding of Upstream business environment, including technical and logistical elements.
* Have good knowledge of Well Engineering, Well Construction, Rigs, equipment packages and technical solutions.
* Have excellent leadership, strong interpersonal, influencing, analytical, decision making and planning skills.
* Have demonstrated ability to work in a global matrix organization.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
  
  
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

df3dd8a5.title: Solution Architect (Databricks)
df3dd8a5.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Solution Architect (Databricks)** to lead Databricks Data and AI initiatives. This is a high-impact, multi-faceted role designed for a leader who can balance technical depth with commercial acumen. The role involves helping win new business through high-quality RFP responses, designing cutting-edge architectures, and building intellectual property (accelerators) that will scale the practice. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Databricks, Data Architecture, AI/ML integration, and pre-sales leadership while driving innovation, governance, and successful delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Pre-Sales & RFP Strategy**

1. Lead the technical response for RFPs and RFIs, creating compelling Databricks Lakehouse solution designs, effort estimations, and delivery roadmaps.
2. Participate in client discovery sessions and "Art of the Possible" workshops to identify business pain points and propose Data/AI solutions.
3. Craft technical presentations and demos that differentiate the CoE from competitors.

**2. Technical Architecture (Databricks)**

1. Design and implement end-to-end Lakehouse architectures using Databricks ecosystems including Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, and Lake Flow.
2. Integrate Machine Learning and AI capabilities into data pipelines (e.g., integrating LLMs, vector databases, and Model Serving).
3. Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and cost optimization (FinOps).

**3. Practice Building & Innovation**

1. Drive the creation of Data & AI Accelerators (reusable frameworks, code templates, and automated deployment scripts) to reduce time-to-market for clients.
2. Mentor senior engineers and architects, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
3. Stay ahead of the curve on the Databricks roadmap to ensure the practice remains market-first.

**4. End-to-End Delivery Oversight**

1. Act as the Design Authority on strategic projects, ensuring the initial vision is successfully translated into production.
2. Perform architectural reviews and audits to ensure high-quality, governed, and performant data solutions.

**Technical Qualifications**

1. Deep expertise in the Databricks Lakehouse platform, including Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, DLT, Lakeflow, and distributed computing.
2. Strong proficiency in Spark (PySpark/Scala), Python, and SQL.
3. In-depth knowledge of Spark, Delta Lake, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, and data lake architectures.
4. Hands-on experience architecting solutions utilizing MLflow and Databricks Model Serving.
5. Deep knowledge of Unity Catalog for fine-grained access control and data lineage.
6. Exposure to GCP data services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and Vertex AI is a strong advantage.

**Required Experience**

1. 10+ years of experience in Data Architecture.
2. At least 5+ years of deep experience within Databricks and Spark ecosystems.
3. Experience leading technical bids or pre-sales activities for multi-million-dollar engagements.
4. Databricks Certified Solutions Architect certification preferred.

**Profile Description**

1. Our client is seeking an experienced **Solution Architect (Databricks)** with extensive expertise in Data Architecture, Databricks Lakehouse, and AI-driven data solutions.
2. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of experience in enterprise data platforms and at least 5 years working deeply within the Databricks and Spark ecosystem.
3. This individual will play a strategic role in pre-sales engagements, solution design, architecture governance, and practice development.
4. The candidate should possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with proven experience leading technical bids, conducting client workshops, and delivering scalable, secure, and cost-optimized data platforms.
5. Experience with AI/ML integration, MLflow, Model Serving, Unity Catalog, and modern cloud data services will be highly valued.

**Roles and Responsibilities :**

* Design and develop data solutions using Data Bricks, Delta Lake, and Spark for clients across various industries.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical architecture designs.
* Develop RFPs (Requests for Proposal) and RFIs (Requests for Information) documents to support sales efforts.
* Provide pre-sales support by creating presentations, demos, and proof-of-concepts to showcase proposed solutions.

**Job Requirements :**

* 9-20 years of experience in Solution Architect role with expertise in AIML, Data Architecture, Data Lakes, DataBricks, DTL/PySpark.
* Strong understanding of Technical Architecture principles and ability to apply them effectively.
* Experience working on large-scale projects involving complex data processing pipelines using Scala/Spark technologies.

5a824e1c.title: Solutions Engineer
5a824e1c.description:
**Solutions Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure**
**What You'll Do**

* Partner with Account Executives and sales teams to understand customer priorities, identify opportunities, and shape technical strategies.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure.
* Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, demonstrations, and presentations.
* Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable, differentiated Cisco solutions.
* Develop end-to-end architectures leveraging Cisco's portfolio and relevant technology ecosystems.
* Contribute technical insights to account planning, opportunity development, cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive strategies.
* Stay current on emerging trends across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure and translate insights into customer opportunities.
* Collaborate with portfolio teams, technical specialists, partners, and sales stakeholders to drive customer outcomes.
* Support customer workshops, partner engagements, enablement sessions, and industry events.
* Travel as required for customer, partner, and Cisco engagements across India and internationally.

**Who You'll Work With**
You will be part of a global Cloud and AI Architecture organization, partnering with Account Executives, portfolio sellers, partners, and customers.
  
  
The primary focus will be
**India**
, with opportunities to support broader
**APJC engagements**
and collaborate with global teams.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a customer-focused technical sales professional with strong architecture expertise and a passion for
**data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure**
.
  
  
You can engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders, simplify complex technology concepts, and translate customer challenges into business value. You thrive in a collaborative, matrixed environment and are comfortable influencing across teams to deliver customer outcomes.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technical presales, solutions engineering, or relevant hands-on infrastructure experience data center networking, compute, storage and how compute, storage, and network integrate.
* Deep knowledge and practical experience with the relevant switching and routing protocols and technologies (e.g.,Spanning Tree, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, Multicast, QoS, Network Segmentation, etc).
* Solid understanding of data center networking design fundamentals across traditional 3-tier architecture, VXLAN EVPN, Software Defined Network and Data Center Interconnect.
* Solid understanding of network security in data center including design and implementation of multi-tenancy, N-S/E-W firewall and microsegmentation.
* Excellent presentation skills with the ability to deliver engaging demos, Proof-of-Concept, workshops to both technical and non-technical audiences on infrastructure and modernization topics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with the Cisco data center portfolio (Nexus/ACI, UCS, Intersight, HyperFabric) or comparable competitive platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-ready infrastructure: GPU compute, high-performance fabrics (RoCE/InfiniBand), AI/ML reference architectures (e.g., Cisco + NVIDIA), and storage for AI workloads.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP, CKA/CKAD, or major cloud associate/professional certs)

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

73b4bf6a.title: Director, Solution Architecture
73b4bf6a.description:
**Ready to take your career global?**

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Director, Solution Architecture to join our ever-evolving SMB Tech Architecture team and help shape the future of global commerce.

**What you’ll own**

As a Director, Solution Architect, you will influence the shaping of future products by contributing to the architecture used across multiple products or systems. You will be responsible for

* Works with senior stakeholders in the Business, Product, Technology, and Operations functions to design end-to-end solutions for strategic business initiatives.
* Identifies and allocates architecture resources to drive architectural decisions at an initiative/epic level to advance the IT roadmap, including the assessment of new technologies and technical debt that best fit business / project needs
* Adheres to the solution architecture delivery process and standards.
* Ensures solution architecture meets appropriate Global Payments policies and standards.
* Defines required business capabilities and aligns them with business operating models, technical platforms, technical integrations and underlying infrastructure.
* Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
* Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.

**What you’ll bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.
* Proficiency in most IT business architecture areas including business process design and governance.
* Deep expertise across technology domains (Applications, Data, Infrastructure, Operations and Security)
* Skill in organization, communications, coordination, analytical and people skills
* Skill in leading, supervising and managing effectively under pressure
* Ability to maintain positive working relationship with Global Payments stakeholder and/or client
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives, activities and problem areas
* Ability to delegate projects to qualified subordinates as appropriate
* Ability to lead, direct and manage effectively
* Ability to operate independently
* Ability to exhibit solid decision-making and analytic/creative problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
* Experience in building robust and scalable infrastructure architectures
* Excellent knowledge of software and application design and architecture
* Positive attitude and a strong commitment to delivering quality work.
* Experience operating in an agile environment, using the Scaled Agile Framework.
* Facilitation of workshops involving cross-functional stakeholders
* Team Management skills
* Ability to visualise complex issues

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* General understanding of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF, Zachman, etc.)

* Industry Standard Architecture Training & Certification
* Ability to speak and present to large groups of people
* This is a good opportunity to bring in some of our values and behaviors:

. Think like a client: We care deeply about our clients' success. We ask, listen and learn — curious to understand first. Our passion drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

. Act like an owner: We take accountability — working at pace to own our outcomes. We empower each other to make decisions. We’re innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact.

. Win as one team: We value personal connections — moving forward together with clarity. We build inclusive and global teams — embracing different perspectives and ideas. It’s always ‘we,’ never ‘me.’ We’re determined to succeed together.  
  
**About the team**

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

**What makes a Globalpayer?**

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
