Job Description Key Responsibilities • Lead architecture discovery, solution definition, technical estimation, design reviews, and governance checkpoints for complex DS WMS programs. • Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, product teams, delivery leaders, partners, and engineering teams, bridging business priorities with practical technical execution. • Mentor architects, technical leads, and engineers; identify future technical leaders and foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and engineering excellence. • Conduct architecture forums, code and design reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and workshops to strengthen WMS capability across the DS organization. • Understand customer business objectives, operational flows, non-functional requirements, and constraints to recommend fit-for-purpose WMS solutions. • Own high-level and detailed technical solution designs, including component responsibilities, integration contracts, data flows, deployment topology, error handling, security, monitoring, and support considerations. • Provide technical estimates, delivery assumptions, dependencies, risks, and solution options for proposals, statements of work, change requests, and pre-sales workshops. • Evaluate standard product capabilities before recommending extensions and ensure customizations follow extensibility, maintainability, and upgrade-safety principles. • Guide teams on Java, SQL/PLSQL, MOCA, APIs, messaging, integrations, database design, performance tuning, and secure coding practices relevant to Blue Yonder WMS. • Review architecture, designs, code, test evidence, deployment plans, release notes, and operational documentation; ensure review feedback is resolved before release. • Lead technical risk assessments, root-cause analysis, performance investigations, production-readiness reviews, and resolution of critical delivery or customer escalations. • Define release, rollout, cutover, rollback, and hyper care strategies for upgrades, migrations, enhancements, integrations, and patches. • Collaborate with Product, Cloud, Security, Support, QA, Integration, and Data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions with clear ownership and traceability. • Create reusable reference architectures, accelerators, checklists, and lessons learned that improve consistency, predictability, and quality across DS WMS engagements. • Support client demonstrations, technical workshops, architecture presentations, and executive discussions with clear articulation of solution value, trade-offs, risks, and outcomes. Experience & Competencies: • Demonstrated ability to lead architecture for large, complex, and multi-site WMS programs involving multiple systems and stakeholder groups. • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to compare solution options, explain trade-offs, and recommend an approach based on business value, risk, cost, and maintainability. • Ownership mindset with the ability to guide delivery from discovery through design, build, validation, deployment, and operational stabilization. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex functional, integration, performance, data, and production issues. • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, customer SMEs, program leaders, and executives. • Strong collaboration, facilitation, negotiation, and influencing skills across distributed and cross-functional teams. • Ability to mentor technical teams, provide constructive review feedback, and raise engineering standards through practical guidance. • Commitment to Blue Yonder values, customer success, continuous improvement, responsible innovation, and high-quality delivery. Required Technical Skills: • Deep hands-on experience with Blue Yonder, JDA, or RedPrairie WMS architecture, configuration, extensions, integrations, deployment, and support. • Strong proficiency in Java, SQL, and PL/SQL, with practical experience in data modelling, query optimization, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. • Strong understanding of MOCA, WMS data structures, inbound, inventory, outbound, wave, allocation, replenishment, shipping, and warehouse execution processes. • Experience designing and governing REST APIs, file-based interfaces, message or event-driven integrations, middleware patterns, and error-recovery mechanisms. • Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, design patterns, secure coding, CI/CD, automated quality controls, source-code management, and release governance. • Experience with GitHub or equivalent source-control platforms, Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tools, build tooling, IDEs, and database administration or development tools. • Proficiency with Linux, Unix, and Windows environments, including command-line diagnostics, scripting, application logs, and operational troubleshooting. • Working knowledge of Jira and Agile delivery practices, with the ability to maintain technical traceability from requirements through release. Beneficial / Preferred Technical Skills: • Experience with Blue Yonder WMS modernization, cloud deployment, version uplift, migration, or transition from legacy WMS platforms. • Knowledge of warehouse automation, material-handling equipment, robotics, serialization, label or print systems, and external execution platforms. • Experience with Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies, integration platforms, observability tools, and container or cloud-native deployment concepts. • Understanding of test strategy, automation, performance testing, resilience testing, and production-readiness validation. • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot, while applying appropriate security, IP, quality, and human-review controls. • Relevant architecture, cloud, database, Java, integration, or supply-chain certifications are advantageous. Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is advantageous. Typically 12+ years of enterprise software delivery experience, including significant WMS experience and at least 3 years in a solution or technical architecture leadership role. //ID003

b1187f17.title: Senior Group Technical Architect
b1187f17.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a Solution Architect to lead the architecture of the Agentic Service Management Platform. The ideal candidate combines 15+ years in software engineering and architecture, including 5+ years as the accountable solution architect on large enterprise platforms, with hands-on depth in event-driven, workflow-orchestration, cloud-native and LLM-agent architectures.

The individual is expected to turn ITSM/ESM business needs into scalable, secure and resilient platform designs, to verify them against non-functional requirements, and to influence senior client architecture and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Architecture Ownership & Governance**

* Act as the accountable solution architect for the platform.
* Apply architecture practices: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), design models, SOLID principles, design patterns, domain-driven design and microservices.
* Design applications that scale to high volumes of users and transactions in production.
* Define and verify non-functional requirements for performance, availability, scalability and resilience.

**Event-Driven, Workflow & Integration Architecture**

* Design event-driven / event-sourcing solutions on Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Service Bus or equivalent, including CQRS and read models.
* Design long-running, versioned workflows with SLAs and escalations on engines such as Temporal, Camunda or Cadence, together with rule engines.
* Design API and integration architecture: REST, asynchronous messaging and API gateways integrating enterprise systems.
* Handle structured and unstructured data across relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL, document, vector) databases.

**Cloud, Platform & Security**

* Architect on Azure (AKS, Entra ID, networking and PaaS services) or equivalent.
* Apply Kubernetes, GitOps and DevSecOps practices.
* Apply security by design: OAuth2/OIDC, role- and policy-based authorisation and end-to-end audit trails.
* Work across frontend (ReactJS, Angular) and backend (TypeScript/Node.js, Java, Python) technologies.

**Agentic AI & Service Management**

* Architect LLM-based agents in an enterprise setting: MCP, A2A, RAG, AI gateways, human-in-the-loop and agent evaluation.
* Apply ITSM/ESM processes and ITIL (v4/v5): Service Request, Incident, Problem and Change, SLA/OLA management.
* Present to and influence senior client architecture and business stakeholders.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Top 6 Skills**

* **Enterprise Solution Architecture —** 15+ years in architecture (5+ as accountable solution architect); ADRs, DDD, microservices, SOLID, design patterns.
* **Event-Driven & Workflow Platforms —** Kafka / Event Hubs / Service Bus with CQRS; Temporal, Camunda or Cadence; rule engines.
* **Azure Cloud & Cloud-Native —** AKS, Entra ID, networking and PaaS; Kubernetes, GitOps and DevSecOps.
* **Agentic AI Architecture —** LLM agents in the enterprise: MCP, A2A, RAG, AI gateways, human-in-the-loop, agent evaluation.
* **API, Integration & Security by Design —** REST, async messaging, API gateways; OAuth2/OIDC, policy-based authorisation, audit trails.
* **ITSM / ITIL & Stakeholder Influence —** ITIL v4/v5 processes and SLA/OLA management; influencing senior client architecture and business stakeholders.

**Must Have**

* 15+ years in software engineering and architecture, with 5+ years as the accountable solution architect on large enterprise platforms.
* Should have designed and delivered large applications that have scaled to high volumes of users and transactions in production.
* Should have sound knowledge of architecture practices: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), different design models, SOLID principles, design patterns, domain-driven design and microservices.
* Should have expertise with event-driven / event-sourcing platforms such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Service Bus or equivalent, including CQRS and read models.
* Should have expertise in workflow orchestration engines such as Temporal, Camunda, Cadence or equivalent for long-running, versioned workflows with SLAs and escalations.
* Should have hands-on experience with rule engines.
* Should have expertise in both frontend frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular and backend technologies such as TypeScript/Node.js, Java, Python or equivalent.
* Should have strong cloud experience on Azure (AKS, Entra ID, networking and PaaS services) or equivalent.
* Should have designed API and integration architecture: REST, asynchronous messaging and API gateways, integrating enterprise systems.
* Should have hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GitOps and DevSecOps practices.
* Should be able to handle both structured and unstructured data, with experience in relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL, document, vector) databases.
* Should have applied security by design such as OAuth2/OIDC, role- and policy-based authorisation and end-to-end audit trails.
* Should have practical experience architecting LLM-based agents in an enterprise setting: MCP, A2A, RAG, AI gateways, human-in-the-loop and agent evaluation.
* Should have good understanding of ITSM/ESM processes and ITIL (v4/v5): Service Request, Incident, Problem and Change, SLA/OLA management.
* Should have defined and verified non-functional requirements for performance, availability, scalability and resilience.
* Should have presented to and influenced senior client architecture and business stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Experience replacing a commercial ITSM product, including workflow and data migration.
* Knowledge graphs, ontologies or context platforms for agents.
* Squad-based, product-style delivery with AI-assisted engineering.

**Required Functional Knowledge**

* ITSM/ESM processes and ITIL (v4/v5), including SLA/OLA management.
* Enterprise platform architecture and architecture practices (ADRs, DDD, microservices).
* Event-driven architecture and workflow orchestration.
* Agentic AI architecture: MCP, A2A, RAG, AI gateways and agent evaluation.
* Azure cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes, GitOps and DevSecOps.
* API and integration architecture.
* Security by design and audit trails.

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Apache Kafka,Enterprise Architecture,LLM API Integration,Agentic AI

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

Azure Event Hubs

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Soft Skills & Personal Attributes**

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Able to present to and influence senior client architecture and business stakeholders.
* Able to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

**Personal Attributes**

* Accountable, ownership-oriented architect.
* Structured and analytical decision maker.
* Pragmatic and delivery-focused.

**Experience & Seniority Requirements**

* 15+ years in software engineering and architecture, including 5+ years as a solution architect on enterprise platform builds.
* Designed and delivered large applications scaled to high volumes of users and transactions in production.
* Hands-on across event-driven platforms, workflow engines, rule engines, Azure and Kubernetes.
* Practical experience architecting LLM-based agents in an enterprise setting.
* Experience presenting to and influencing senior client architecture and business stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Certifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Preferred certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), TOGAF; Temporal, CKA/CKAD or AI certifications are a plus.

48df0522.title: Global Technical Expert, Hybrid cloud Platforms
48df0522.description:
**Position Purpose:**  
The Hybrid Cloud Platform Engineer is responsible for the planning, architecture, design, implementation, operation, and optimization of hybrid and multi-cloud platform solutions across AWS and Microsoft Azure. The role partners with application architects, engineering teams, security, networking, and cloud platform teams translate business and application requirements into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure solutions.
  
The engineer will provide technical leadership throughout the application hosting and cloud migration lifecycle while contributing to the organization's overall hybrid cloud strategy, standards, governance, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities:**  
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to
  
  

* Plan, design, develop and support hybrid cloud platform/infrastructure solutions across AWS and Azure, aligned with enterprise architecture, security and application requirements.
* Own cloud platform architecture, landing zones, account/subscription structures, policies and governance guardrails across AWS and Azure.
* Design and maintain integrations with enterprise services such as Entra ID, on-premises networks, Splunk, ServiceNow, security and monitoring platforms.
* Manage the lifecycle of qualified/approved cloud services, including configuration changes and risk/impact assessments for cloud-provider or application-driven changes.
* Evaluate and qualify new AWS/Azure cloud services in collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security and other relevant teams.
* Support application onboarding, solution design and cloud migration, recommending the appropriate compute, storage, database, network and platform services.
* Define and govern IAM, RBAC, privileged access, least-privilege principles and cloud access guardrails across AWS and Azure.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and DevOps automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation/CodePipeline, Azure Bicep/Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices.
* Implement and maintain cloud security governance, working with Security, Application and Vulnerability Management teams to address risks and compliance requirements.
* Design and support hybrid/cloud networking, including VPC/VNet, routing, DNS, firewalls, private connectivity, load balancing and advanced L3/L4 troubleshooting.
* Support deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting of key AWS and Azure platform services, ensuring performance, scalability, reliability and availability.
* Drive resilience and operational excellence, including high availability, backup/DR, observability, cost optimization, platform standardization and continuous improvement.

**What you’ll bring to the role:****Essential Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Platform Engineering and/or Platform Security, preferably in large enterprise environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Microsoft Azure, including design, implementation and support of enterprise-scale public, private and hybrid-cloud platforms.
* Strong knowledge of cloud compute, storage, databases, networking, IAM, security, monitoring and enterprise integration services.
* Experience with cloud platform architecture and governance, including landing zones, account/subscription structures, policies, guardrails and cloud service lifecycle management.
* Strong experience with cloud networking and security, including AWS VPC, Azure Virtual Network, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, IAM/RBAC, privileged access and security controls.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and DevOps automation, including Terraform, CloudFormation/Bicep, Git, CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline and/or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, observability and security tooling, including CloudWatch, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, Splunk and vulnerability/security monitoring solutions.
* Experience supporting application onboarding, cloud migrations and modernization, including integration with enterprise IAM, network, security, monitoring and ITSM services.
* Strong understanding of high availability, resilience, backup/disaster recovery, performance, scalability and cost optimization for cloud platforms.
* Problem solving mindset and advanced troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, security and application deployment issues.
* Ability to create and maintain solution designs, architecture diagrams, technical standards, operating procedures and implementation/test documentation.
* Strong communication, collaboration and ownership, with the ability to work across Architecture, Security, Network, IAM, Application, DevOps and Operations teams and independently drive technical issues to resolution.
* Relevant AWS, Azure and/or Terraform certifications are advantageous.

Why Sandoz?
  
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported! 
  
 
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity& Inclusion:**  
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve.
  
  
#Sandoz

**Overview**
With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
  
  
We’re looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to help customers migrate, modernize and secure their infrastructure, applications, and data on Microsoft Azure, laying the foundation for scalable, production-ready AI solutions. As part of the Cloud + AI Infrastructure team, you’ll deliver engagements focused on migration, modernization, operational excellence and resilient architecture using frameworks like Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework (WAF). f4029682.title: Solution Architect
f4029682.description:
Job Description: Pre-Sales Solution Architect (Data Engineering & Analytics)
  
  
Sigmoid empowers enterprises to make smarter, data-driven decisions by blending advanced data engineering with AI consulting. We collaborate with some of the world's leading data-rich organizations across sectors such as CPG-retail, BFSI, life sciences, manufacturing, and more to solve complex business challenges. Our global team specializes in cloud data modernization, predictive analytics, generative AI, and DataOps, supported by 10+ delivery centers and innovation hubs, including a major global presence in Bengaluru and operations across the USA, Canada, UK, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore, and India.
  
  
Recognized as a leader in the data and analytics space, Sigmoid is backed by Peak XV Partners and has consistently received accolades for innovation and rapid growth. Highlights include being named a
**'Leader' in ISG's Specialty Analytics Services for Supply Chain (2024)**
, a two-time
**'India Future Unicorn'**
by Hurun India, and a four-time honoree on both the
**Inc. 500**
and
**Deloitte Technology Fast 500**
lists.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on, high-ownership
**Pre-Sales Solution Architect**
to lead technical engagements with Fortune 1000 clients. You will be the primary technical advisor, bridging the gap between high-level business strategy and complex, enterprise-grade architecture. As a
**"doer-architect,"**
you will own the architectural integrity of our solutions, lead Proof of Concept (PoC) development, and guide C-level client executives through their data modernization journey.
  
  
This role requires a unique blend of
**"big picture"**
architectural governance and
**"in-the-trenches"**
coding capability. The position also requires significant onshore travel to client locations to facilitate discovery, integration, and on-site technical advocacy.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pre-Sales & Consulting
  
  

* **Strategic Advisory:**
  Lead technical discovery with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders to translate complex business needs into robust, scalable, and cost-effective architectural roadmaps.
* **Deal Ownership:**
  Own the technical response for RFPs/RFIs, creating compelling proposals that clearly articulate technical feasibility, ROI, and delivery approach.
* **Business Case Creation:**
  Develop "Solution Strategy" documents, highlighting trade-offs between different technology stacks and delivery models (T&M vs. Fixed Bid).

Architecture & Design
  
  

* **System Design & Governance:**
  Act as the technical authority for enterprise-grade applications. Design end-to-end architectures (batch & streaming) that prioritize scalability, reliability, and security.
* **NFR and Performance Ownership:**
  Proactively identify and solve for performance issues (concurrency, throughput, data lineage, and compliance/PII).
* **Architecture Advisory:**
  Guide client teams through technology choices, providing credible "push-back" on suboptimal approaches based on first-principles thinking.

Hands-on PoC & Delivery
  
  

* **PoC Leadership:**
  Build and showcase rapid prototypes and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) at the client site to validate technical feasibility and win client confidence.
* **Technical "Doer":**
  Remain hands-on with the code. Step into the most complex components of the solution, designing APIs, defining data models, and optimizing performance (SQL, partitioning, indexing) to unblock teams.
* **Integration:**
  Lead integration efforts onsite, ensuring the solution aligns with client acceptance criteria and effectively bridging the gap between offshore development teams and onsite client stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  15+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, or Software Architecture, with a strong track record in a consulting/services environment.
* **Architecture Maturity:**
  Exposure to System Design and Distributed Architecture. Strong knowledge of data architecture (ingestion, storage, processing).
* **Data Domain:**
  Strong expertise in Cloud Data Stacks (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern Data Warehousing/Lakehouse architectures (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
* **GenAI/LLMOps:**
  Strong experience in Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, LangChain, and prompt engineering.
* **Consulting Presence:**
  Demonstrated ability to articulate complex technical decisions to non-technical executive stakeholders.
* **Pre-Sales Exposure:**
  Proven history of handling complex deals, structured proposal development, and navigating competitive landscapes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on coding proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) or Python with deep SQL expertise.
* Experience with Data Governance/MDM and observability frameworks.
* Performance and scalability benchmarking experience.

**Note:**
*By submitting your application, you consent to being contacted by our Talent Acquisition team via phone call, email, SMS, WhatsApp, or other communication channels regarding your application and relevant career opportunities.*

3895f829.title: Advisor, Software Architecture
3895f829.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Software Architecture
  
  
**What does a successful Software Architecture Advisor do at Fiserv?**
We are looking for a Software Architecture Advisor to help shape the design and modernization of high-throughput payment processing and financial clearing platforms. In this role, you will define architecture patterns, guide engineering standards and support the delivery of highly available, fault-tolerant and scalable solutions across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
You will bring deep experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture, cloud-native design and payment domain integration. Success in this role means enabling strong technical decisions, improving platform resilience and scalability, and partnering across engineering, product and infrastructure teams to support modern, efficient and secure payment systems.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and lead end-to-end architecture for transaction processing and payment clearing platforms
* Design highly available, fault-tolerant and low-latency systems that support high transaction volumes
* Establish architecture patterns, design standards and technical direction for cloud-native modernization initiatives
* Lead framework and engineering standards using modern Java, Spring Boot and reactive programming approaches
* Drive architectural decisions related to microservices design, service decomposition and governance
* Support integration with payment gateways, clearing houses and financial networks including ACH, SWIFT and RTGS
* Ensure architecture supports compliance, fraud detection and other risk control integrations
* Oversee containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms
* Support deployment architecture across public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* Design and optimize relational and NoSQL data models, including document schemas aligned to application access and query patterns
* Provide hands-on guidance in the use of AI models and AI-assisted development approaches to support engineering productivity and solution design
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews and technical design sessions across engineering teams
* Mentor engineering squads and help resolve complex design, performance and delivery challenges
* Partner with product, engineering, DevOps and platform teams to align business needs with technical strategy
* Drive continuous improvement in architecture practices, scalability, resiliency and engineering quality

**What You Will Need To Have**

* 10 to 12+ years of experience in software engineering
* 4+ years of experience in enterprise or solution architecture roles
* Strong experience designing high-throughput, low-latency and fault-tolerant enterprise systems
* Strong hands-on experience with modern Java, including JDK 11, 17 or 21, and Spring Boot
* Experience with reactive programming and modern distributed application design patterns
* Experience designing microservices-based architectures and governance models
* Experience integrating with payment gateways, clearing houses and financial transaction systems
* Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployment across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies, including MongoDB
* Experience designing database schemas and query patterns for high-performance applications
* Hands-on experience working with AI large language models or other AI models for development-related use cases
* Strong communication, technical leadership and stakeholder collaboration skills

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience in payment processing, clearing, settlement or financial transaction platforms
* Familiarity with ACH, SWIFT, RTGS and other payment network integration patterns
* Experience with event-driven architecture and streaming technologies
* Knowledge of compliance, fraud detection and security design considerations in financial systems
* Experience leading cloud modernization or platform transformation initiatives
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and guiding architecture across multiple teams
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

afac32f0.title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
afac32f0.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or equivalent

* AWS or other cloud certification
* Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery or IT lifecycle
* Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements

cb5e037d.title: Application Architect-AWS Cloud Migration
cb5e037d.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Architect specializing in AWS Cloud Migration, you will lead the design and delivery of cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP. You will guide the development of migration strategies, tools, and network requirements for hybrid cloud platforms.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Lead Migration Architecture Design: Develop and implement migration architecture solutions for multi-cloud environments, ensuring seamless integration with AWS and other cloud platforms.
* Design Migration Strategy: Collaborate with the team to create effective migration strategies, selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Adopt Migration Methodology: Lead the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Provide Technical Expertise: Offer significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* Map Client Requirements: Utilize deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Migration Solution Design: Experience with designing and delivering cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP, with a focus on hybrid cloud platforms.
* Migration Strategy Development: Experience in developing effective migration strategies, including selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Migration Methodology Adoption: Experience leading the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Technical Expertise in Migration: Experience providing significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* AWS Platform Knowledge: Deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Deep Knowledge of Azure: Experience with Azure platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into Azure-specific services and configurations.
* Familiarity with ICP: Exposure to ICP platform and service catalog, with understanding of how to integrate ICP with other cloud platforms.
* Containerization Expertise: Experience with containerization methods and tools, including selecting the right approach for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.

73e27810.title: Cloud Solution Architecture
73e27810.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions-Core (MCAPS) accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.
  
  
The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across Account Team Unit, Specialist Team Unit, and Customer Support Unit to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.
  
  
Within the SfMC team, we support multiple technologies and multiple products being used by our customers via a single team. We are building a dedicated team with diversified skill set so we can deliver an excelled support experience to our customers, all under one roof. CSA’s on our team usually come with a depth of experience in one or two technologies. Within SMC, you will have that opportunity to expand your skill set, learn new technologies and grow your leadership in the technology you excel at, all without being isolated into a particular feature of a particular product. You will deal with high profile customers directly under the radar of executive management and may occasionally get an email or two from them directly!
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide architectural reviews and technical guidance to Support for Mission Critical (SfMC) customers, focusing on the reliability, security, and performance.
* Take end-to-end ownership and accountability of technical deliverables, ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes and Microsoft’s best practices.
* Identify architectural risks, design gaps, and operational inefficiencies across services.
* Engage with SfMC stakeholders to drive architectural validation, incident prevention, and workload health improvements through proactive engagements and deep technical assessments.
* Collaborate closely with Microsoft engineering and support teams to address escalations, share feedback, and align solutions with platform evolution.
* Drive creation and reusability of IP including scripts, tools, and technical documentation to support scalable SfMC engagements.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineers, influencing long-term technical strategy for stability, resilience, and innovation.

  
  
Business Impact
  
  

* Identifies and anticipates issues and advises customers/partners to operate and optimize performance in accordance with Microsoft best practices. Adapts methodology and applies governance to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks. Adheres to quality assurance standards and calculates risks while ensuring excellence in the design and/or delivery of solutions. Leverages standard tools to ensure accurate engagement hygiene.
* Drives customer/partner relationships to anticipate, identify, escalate, and work to resolve technical blockers to accelerate consumption and solution implementations (e.g., by application of technical capabilities). Routes non-technical issues for removal by the appropriate party. Applies broad business and technical knowledge across various architecture or other Microsoft solutions to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified technical constraints. Shapes and enhances customers' requirements.
* Proactively uses knowledge of the products, services, and value propositions of Microsoft and its competitors in customer/partner conversations to identify growth opportunities based on knowledge of customer/partner needs. Contributes to increase in consumption and aligns with Customer Success Account Management or other Account Team members on customer/partner priorities to drive growth in consumption via cost optimization, operational excellence performance efficiency, and security. Drives architecture design, resiliency reviews, and technical optimization that result in production deployment application and increase customer/partner usage and consumption. Ensures that the customer/partner's application has as few points of failure as possible. Consults and provides thought leadership for technical solution design, development, and deployment and supports the customer/partner throughout implementation to achieve value outcomes and Microsoft's Customer Promise.
* Understands industry trends and the competitor's architecture solutions and identifies Microsoft's strengths over competitive solutions to drive conversations with customers/partners and convince them of solution.

**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Preferred Qualifications**
7+ years experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external).
  
  
7+ years experience working on technical projects.
  
  
**Technical Skills And Knowledge Requirements**

* Exchange Online: Architecture, mail flow, connectors, transport rules, mailbox management, permissions, hybrid configuration, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, migrations, security, compliance and troubleshooting.
* SharePoint Online / OneDrive: Architecture, site topology, hub sites, information architecture, permissions, external sharing, storage governance, migrations, document libraries, metadata, Microsoft Lists, Teams integration and troubleshooting.
* Microsoft Teams: Architecture, collaboration, channels, meetings, webinars, policies, guest access, federation, governance, security, compliance, integrations, migration and troubleshooting.
* Microsoft Teams Phone and Voice: Voice architecture, Calling Plans, Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN connectivity, dial plans, voice policies, number management, auto attendants, call queues, Teams Rooms, QoS and troubleshooting.
* Microsoft Entra ID: Identity architecture, authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, hybrid identity, directory synchronization, enterprise applications, app registrations, RBAC, privileged access, identity protection and troubleshooting.
* Microsoft Purview: Architecture, compliance management, sensitivity labels, information protection, DLP, retention policies and labels, eDiscovery, audit logging, data lifecycle management and information governance across Microsoft 365.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot: Architecture, licensing, deployment prerequisites, Microsoft Graph grounding, M365 app integrations, security, permissions, data governance, oversharing risks, readiness assessments, adoption monitoring, agents and extensibility.

**Preferred Certifications**
MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator
  
  
MS-700: Managing Microsoft Teams
  
  
SC-300: Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
  
  
SC-400: Microsoft Information Protection and Compliance
  
  
MD-102: Endpoint Administrator
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

60557be5.description:
**Job Summary**
Professional services(Design architecture implementation etc)Design and optimize enterprise infrastructure architectures for hybrid work environments with a primary focus on robust cloud storage and resilient network designs. Apply extensive experience to create scalable secure and high performing solutions that enable digital delivery while aligning with organizational goals and improving societal access to reliable technology services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect end to end infrastructure solutions that integrate cloud storage with existing enterprise systems to deliver scalable secure and highly available platforms for critical business applications.
* Design comprehensive network topologies that ensure resilient connectivity bandwidth optimization and low latency to support day shift operations in a hybrid work model.
* Develop detailed infrastructure blueprints and technical documentation that guide implementation teams and ensure accurate alignment with architectural standards and business outcomes.
* Coordinate with cloud and network engineering teams to validate designs and ensure smooth deployment of storage and connectivity components across data centers and cloud environments.
* Optimize cloud storage architectures by defining tiering strategies access patterns capacity planning and data lifecycle approaches to balance performance cost and reliability.
* Implement robust security controls across infrastructure designs by incorporating encryption access management segmentation and monitoring to protect data and services.
* Assess existing infrastructure landscapes and perform gap analyses to recommend modernization strategies that enable digital delivery capabilities and improve technology resilience.
* Evaluate new infrastructure technologies and tools for cloud storage and network design by conducting feasibility assessments and recommending adoption paths that align with enterprise strategy.
* Collaborate with digital enablement teams to ensure infrastructure solutions support application delivery pipelines observability frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Define non functional requirements for infrastructure solutions including availability performance scalability and recovery targets to ensure reliable service for internal and external stakeholders.
* Guide capacity and demand planning activities by translating business growth projections into infrastructure requirements for storage network resources and supporting services.
* Establish governance practices for configuration management infrastructure standards and lifecycle management to maintain consistency and reduce operational risk in hybrid environments.
* Drive continuous improvement of infrastructure architecture by analyzing operational metrics incident patterns and user feedback to refine designs and enhance overall reliability.

**Qualifications**

* Utilize extensive experience in cloud storage technologies to design solutions that address data durability performance and compliance in complex enterprise settings.
* Apply strong expertise in network designing to configure routing switching security zones and connectivity models that support distributed workforces and critical workloads.
* Draw on background in digital enablement and delivery to create infrastructure foundations that accelerate application deployment and support modern delivery practices.
* Leverage many years of infrastructure architecture experience to align solution designs with enterprise standards regulatory requirements and long term technology roadmaps.
* Employ knowledge of hybrid work models to design infrastructure that supports secure remote access collaboration tools and consistent user experiences across locations.
* Use advanced skills in documentation and communication to convey architectural decisions design trade offs and implementation guidelines to technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Apply familiarity with observability and monitoring solutions to ensure infrastructure designs support proactive issue detection performance tuning and service reliability.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent cloud and network focused credentials.

60e9032a.title: Infrastructure Specialist-Cloud Platforms
60e9032a.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement Cloud Resources: Oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.
* Ensure High Availability: Continuously monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Right-size resources, develop cost-effective solutions, and monitor usage patterns to optimize cloud costs.
* Automate Processes: Use automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Services Proficiency: Experience with cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, along with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* DevOps Practices: Experience with DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), and applying these practices to cloud infrastructure management.
* Automation Tools: Experience using automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, and ability to manage and execute cloud migration plans.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Cloud Security Best Practices: Experience with implementing and enforcing cloud security measures to ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations, including data encryption, access controls, and threat detection.
* Advanced Cloud Automation: Experience with advanced automation tools and scripting languages, such as Python or PowerShell, to automate complex cloud infrastructure tasks and workflows.

d23327e5.title: Cloud Engineer
d23327e5.description:
We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.
  
  
If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a Information Systems Engineer in the Cloud and Information Services Division at SAS, you will help transform our existing architecture to new public cloud architecture with a focus on Azure. You will join a team that works closely with our internal and external customers to meet evolving business and technical requirements as we reshape our infrastructure as a highly optimized, secure, scalable, performant, reliable, and resilient architecture. This will require you to perform a range of activities as you design, implement, maintain, and continuously automate a large cloud-based computing environment. In addition, you will provide technical guidance to team members and, when called upon, serve as a technical liaison between internal departments. The ideal candidate is passionate about new technologies and keeps current with trends in the cloud platform and infrastructure space, while always searching for ways to improve our architecture as technology evolves.
  
  
**Experience: 5-7 Years**
**Responsibilities Would Include**

* To engage with Pre-Sales, Sales, and SAS Cloud support teams to understand key customer requirements
* To provide overall Engineering support for the hosting environment, including direct support for hosting customer escalations and as a member of the hosting on-call support team.
* To work with the Compliance team for audit evidence, CIS benchmarks, and other compliance requirements for our regulated hosting environments
* To work with Azure APIs for automation/integration of standard, supported services
* Assess complex technical and business requirements and take ownership of projects with minimal guidance
* Exercise your ability to adapt and react to complex issues in a timely manner as our business needs and objectives evolve.
* Reduce technical debt by creating automation for day-to-day operations.

**What We’re Looking For**

* You’re curious, passionate, authentic, and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.
* You have a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent work experience.
* Public Cloud expertise with at least

+ 5+ years of experience in designing enterprise solutions/services.
+ 2+ years of experience with an industry leading public cloud provider or equivalent certification.
+ 2+ years of experience in systems support and consulting.
+ 2+ years of experience in Linux.
+ 1+ year of experience in deploying and managing Kubernetes.

* In-depth experience in all major aspects of Information Technology (servers/compute, network, storage).
* Experience in deploying and managing containerized services.
* Development experience in a major scripting or compiled programming languages.
* Experience using source control solutions like GitHub or GitLab.

**The nice to haves**

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert or other Azure related certifications.
* Experience with large-scale, multi-platform enterprise systems.
* Familiarity with automation through interaction with remote APIs (REST).
* Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux and/or Windows Server Technologies.
* Experience with LDAP, ADFS, SAML, or other Identity and Access Management Solutions.
* Experience with on-prem hypervisor technologies.
* Experience with WAN technologies and how they interact with public cloud solutions.
* Ability to maintain focus in a fast-paced environment.

*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact*
*Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*
Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

393e52d1.title: TechOps1-DE-CloudOpsAMS-SAP AMS SDM-Manager
393e52d1.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Team Manager - TechOps - Application Management - Consultant**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP Team Manager to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 8-10 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP functional areas preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment
* Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting
* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams
* Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support within the SAP domain expert module for incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onshore model.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* Experience with both S/4HANA and ECC
* Strong knowledge of SAP integration points with other SAP cross modules like FICO, MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.
* SAP Certification in any functional domain
* Experience in good Team management skills, People skills, communication, soft skills etc
* Expertise in working with Onshore teams with good co-ordination and collaboration

**What you will do:**

* Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement
* Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP solutions and designs.
* Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.
* Mentor and train junior SAP functional and technical Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of hundreds of professionals.
* Opportunities to work with EY SAP application maintenance, practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What working at EY offers:**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

caa32696.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

Accountable end-to-end for delivering the fixed-price, milestone-based SOW on time, on scope and to IT&S acceptance. Acts as the Provider's primary point of contact with the IT&S Project Manager and governs the onshore (Nashville) / offshore (India) delivery team across the 38-week engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the integrated project plan across Mobilization and Discovery, Foundation, four delivery waves, end-to-end validation, and hypercare/handover.
* Track and drive the seven contractual milestones (Week 2 through Week 38) and associated payment milestones; proactively manage risks to avoid milestone penalties.
* Run program governance: weekly status, RAID log, steering committee reporting, and go/no-go readiness reviews for each wave cutover.
* Manage the change-control process for scope deviations, new jobs or sources, and HCA-caused delays (access, documentation, governance approvals, blackout periods).
* Coordinate HCA dependencies — DBAs, Data Office, security/IAM, network, Stonebranch administrators, report and finance/GL owners, and business testers.
* Plan cutover calendars (Tuesday–Thursday, outside month-end blackouts), soak periods, and same-day rollback readiness.
* Manage deliverable acceptance per the Master Agreement and ensure complete evidence packs, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer artifacts.
* Lead resourcing, onboarding, and performance of the Provider team; escalate to the Account Director and Integrated Service Delivery Director as required.

----------------------------------

* Proven delivery of fixed-price data warehouse or cloud data platform migrations, ideally on GCP/BigQuery.
* Strong command of milestone-based commercial models, change control, and SOW/MSA governance.
* Experience managing onshore/offshore teams for US healthcare clients.
* Working knowledge of data engineering, ETL modernization (SSIS to cloud), testing, and cutover/rollback planning.
* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and escalation handling.

add78be5.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
  
  
Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

* You are responsible for handling finance clients in different industries and across Finance and Accounts. You will own client engagements/contracts across geographies & provide transition support for establishing processes, metrics identifications and reporting.
* Establish and maintain a robust tracking mechanism for key indicators of the operations to support decision-making.
* Responsible for achieving transformation at a high level of change management experience, including challenging, inspiring, and leading the team.
* Responsible for tracking and driving all process parameters ‘critical to quality’ for process delivery.
* Assist management with career development activities for team members, team leaders and managers, including performance management, feedback, and training.
* Ensure adequate mentorship and training of team members to ensure process objectives and Customer requirements are met.

**Preferred Education**

a2a98c65.title: Program Manager - Engineering & Automation Projects , GESI-IN
a2a98c65.description:
**Description**
The Program Manager – Automation & Engineering Projects drives end-to-end project governance for automation, capacity, and Innovation Lab initiatives within the GESI-IN (PMO/Ops Eng/Automation) team. This role is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of approved OP1/OP2 intake requests, maintaining the India Product Development System (IPDS) master tracker, and ensuring project health through continuous risk analysis and timely escalation. The Program Manager owns launch readiness planning with backward-scheduled timelines, coordinates cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners, and delivers executive-level business review narratives (WBR, MBR, QBR). Additionally, the role produces monthly newsletters, event-driven flash reports, and leads weekly project reviews and gate-review logistics to maintain cadence and accountability across all active programs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Tracking all approved OP(OP1 & OP2) Intake requests (ATL/BTL Category) through Laminar intake flow on Capacity, automation initiatives, Innovation Lab, Study & assessment/any other category that requires GESI-IN (Ops Eng/Automation) team’s delivery.
* End to end monitor and control of project through continuous risk analysis at each phases by leveraging Source. Timely escalation of leadership support through proper technical write up & WP doc.
* Own the Innovation lab’s master project tracker — India Product Development System (IPDS) phase, milestones, dev-cycle time, RAG status and payback for every active project. Keep it current and audit-ready.
* Create and maintain tracker of launch (ETA: Go-Live) backward updated status for timely actions/support.
* Business Review Docs: Owning end to end details & quality of all automation/capacity/IL charters for narratives for all business review docs (WBR, MBR & QBR).
* Monthly Innovation Lab Newsletter — project progress, wins, look ahead and team spotlights.
* Issue event-driven flash reports for gate outcomes, milestone hits and critical blockers for leadership attention.
* Coordinate across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners to keep cross-functional commitments on track.

A day in the life
  
  
A typical day begins with a standup reviewing project health dashboards on GES Source, flagging any RAG status shifts or emerging risks across active Engineering projects and automation charter. Mid-morning is spent updating tracker, aligning milestone timelines, and preparing concise escalation notes for leadership. After lunch, cross-functional syncs with Operations, RME, Finance, and vendor partners keep launch commitments on track. The afternoon wraps up drafting business review narratives or newsletter updates, followed by a gate-review prep session to finalize agendas and close out action items before end of day.
  
  
**About The Team**
GESI-IN (Global Engineering Services & Innovation – India) is the team that delivers for Amazon's India network expansion and consolidation. The team partners with Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and all other cross functional teams to design, develop and deploy engineering solutions, capacity programs, and automation charters that improve safety, quality, and throughput at scale. The team takes ideas from concept through pilot to network-wide rollout. You will join a fast-paced, data-driven group that values deep-dive problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and a bias for action to deliver measurable impact on the ground.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
* Experience in preventative maintenance systems
